milestones.headline_zh: 中控 JX-100 DCS 在巨化投运，打破外资流程控制垄断
milestones.headline_en: SUPCON JX-100 DCS commissioned at Juhua — breaks foreign process-control monopoly
milestones.before_gap_zh: 1990年代前流程工业 DCS 由 Emerson/Yokogawa/Honeywell 主导，国产系统市占不足 30%，价格高昂
milestones.before_gap_en: Before the 1990s, process DCS was Emerson/Yokogawa/Honeywell dominated with <30% domestic share and high import prices
milestones.achievement_zh: 推出国内首套 1:1 热冗余 DCS 架构；1993 年底 JX-100 在浙江巨化锦纶装置投运，实现冗余切换与连续控制，价格约为进口三分之一
milestones.achievement_en: Shipped China's first 1:1 hot-standby DCS architecture; JX-100 commissioned at Juhua caprolactam unit late 1993 with redundant failover at ~one-third import price
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高端现场仪表、大型乙烯全套集成经验仍部分依赖进口；海外标杆项目少于欧美厂商
milestones.still_missing_en: High-end field instruments and mega-ethylene integration partly imported; fewer overseas reference projects than US/EU vendors

sources.title: 中控技术发展史

milestones.headline_zh: CAXA 发布国产二维 CAD「电子图板97」
milestones.headline_en: CAXA ships domestic 2D CAD 'Electronic Drawing Board 97'
milestones.before_gap_zh: 1990年代国产二维 CAD 多为科研课题成果，缺少可规模商业化的机械行业 CAD 产品
milestones.before_gap_en: 1990s domestic 2D CAD was mostly research output without scalable commercial mechanical CAD products
milestones.achievement_zh: 北航雷毅团队发布自主二维 CAD「电子图板97」，具备参数化绘图、国标图框与机械图库，成为机械行业最早规模化商用的国产二维 CAD 之一
milestones.achievement_en: Beihang team led by Lei Yi shipped Electronic Drawing Board 97 with parametric drafting, GB title blocks, and mechanical symbol libraries — among the earliest scaled domestic 2D MCAD products
milestones.still_missing_zh: 三维高端曲面、大型装配与自主几何内核仍落后国际 MCAD；PLM 深度弱于 Siemens Teamcenter
milestones.still_missing_en: 3D Class-A surfaces, large assemblies, owned geometry kernel still trail international MCAD; PLM depth trails Siemens Teamcenter

sources.title: CAXA 发展历程

milestones.headline_zh: 柏楚发布 FSCUT 激光切割控制系统与 CypCut 工艺软件
milestones.headline_en: Bochu ships FSCUT laser motion-control stack and CypCut process software
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2012 年前平面激光切割运控由进口板卡与闭源工艺包主导，国产厂商缺少可量产的随动控制+排样+加工闭环方案
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2012, flat-bed laser motion control was import board + closed process stacks; no domestic vendor shipped production-grade follow-control, nesting, and machining loop
milestones.achievement_zh: 2012 年进入激光赛道后推出 FSCUT 系列板卡/总线数控系统、BCS100 电容调高器与 CypCut 激光切割软件，形成「控制卡+调高+工艺」一体化国产激光切割运控栈
milestones.achievement_en: 2012 laser pivot: FSCUT board/bus CNC, BCS100 capacitive height follower, and CypCut process software — first integrated domestic laser-cutting motion-control stack
milestones.still_missing_zh: 超高功率厚板五轴轨迹、三维激光切割仍部分依赖进口系统；海外直接收入占比低
milestones.still_missing_en: Ultra-high-power thick plate and 3D laser paths partly import-dependent; low direct overseas revenue

sources.title: 柏楚电子招股说明书

milestones.headline_zh: 华天 CrownCAD 公测：国内首款自主云 CAD 几何栈（DGM+DCS）
milestones.headline_en: Hoteam CrownCAD beta: first owned domestic cloud CAD geometry stack (DGM+DCS)
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产三维 CAD 长期为桌面单机+第三方内核，缺少可在线协同、源代码可控的云原生 B-rep 建模与约束求解器
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic 3D CAD was desktop + third-party kernels with no source-controlled, cloud-native B-rep modeler and constraint solver for online collaboration
milestones.achievement_zh: 2020-04 CrownCAD 公测上线：基于自研 DGM 三维几何建模引擎与 DCS 约束求解器，浏览器端完成零件/装配/工程图建模与多人协同，适配国产芯片与操作系统
milestones.achievement_en: 2020-04 CrownCAD public beta: owned DGM B-rep engine + DCS constraint solver enable browser-based parts/assemblies/drawings and multi-user collaboration on domestic CPUs/OS
milestones.still_missing_zh: 插件生态、离线大型装配性能、企业级权限审计仍弱于 SolidWorks/Onshape 成熟客户群
milestones.still_missing_en: Plugin ecosystem, offline large-assembly performance, enterprise governance still trail mature SolidWorks/Onshape bases

sources.title: CrownCAD DGM+DCS 自主云 CAD 发布
机械工程学报：国产几何内核综述（DGM）

milestones.headline_zh: 拓竹 X1 + AMS 多色多材料系统与 Bambu Studio 一体化切片上线
milestones.headline_en: Bambu X1 + AMS multi-material system ships with integrated Bambu Studio slicing
milestones.before_gap_zh: 消费级 FDM 多色换料依赖手动或简陋脚本，国产 slicer 在高速与多材料编排上缺乏标杆产品
milestones.before_gap_en: Consumer FDM multi-color relied on manual swaps or crude scripts; no domestic slicer benchmark for speed and multi-material orchestration
milestones.achievement_zh: X1 系列集成 AMS 四料槽自动换料与 RFID 耗材识别；Bambu Studio 原生编排多色/多材料 G-code、远程监控与运动学优化，形成闭环高速 3D 打印软件栈
milestones.achievement_en: X1 integrates AMS 4-slot auto filament swap + RFID spool ID; Bambu Studio natively orchestrates multi-color/material G-code, remote monitoring, and kinematic optimization — closed high-speed 3D print software stack
milestones.still_missing_zh: 工业级 AM 数据准备（修复/排版/仿真）仍由 Magics/Netfabb 主导；Bambu 生态对第三方硬件依赖 Orca 社区分支
milestones.still_missing_en: Industrial AM prep (repair/nesting/simulation) still led by Magics/Netfabb; Bambu ecosystem relies on Orca fork for third-party hardware

sources.title: Bambu Lab X1 Series

milestones.headline_zh: 华大九天模拟全流程工具链通过国内头部晶圆厂验证
milestones.headline_en: Empyrean analog full-flow toolchain validated at leading China foundries
milestones.before_gap_zh: 模拟/混合信号设计长期由 Cadence Virtuoso 垄断，国产工具缺少可支撑量产流片的完整原理图–版图–验证闭环
milestones.before_gap_en: Analog/mixed-signal design was Cadence Virtuoso territory; domestic tools lacked schematic–layout–verification loops for production tape-outs
milestones.achievement_zh: Aether 原理图/版图与 ALPS 电路仿真等工具形成模拟全流程，年报披露已在多家国内头部晶圆厂完成工艺验证并进入客户量产项目
milestones.achievement_en: Aether schematic/layout plus ALPS circuit simulation form a full analog flow; annual reports cite validation at multiple leading China foundries with production customer projects
milestones.still_missing_zh: 先进节点数字实现（P&R/签核）仍弱于国际三巨头；模拟 IP 生态与海外 EDA 仍有差距
milestones.still_missing_en: Advanced-node digital implementation (P&R/signoff) still lags the big three; analog IP ecosystem gap vs global EDA

milestones.headline_zh: 华大九天数字后端 Argus/Aether 通过 28nm 物理验证里程碑
milestones.headline_en: Empyrean digital backend hits 28nm physical-verification milestone
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产数字后端工具此前无法支撑 28nm 级 DRC/LVS 签核，先进数字流片必须采购 Innovus/ICC2
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic digital backends could not sign off 28nm DRC/LVS; advanced digital tape-outs required Innovus/ICC2
milestones.achievement_zh: 年报披露物理验证 Argus DRC/LVS 获 Samsung Foundry 28nm 认证，布局布线工具进入成熟工艺验证阶段
milestones.achievement_en: Annual report: Argus DRC/LVS certified at Samsung Foundry 28nm; place-and-route entering mature-node validation
milestones.still_missing_zh: 7nm 以下 P&R 竞争力有限；客户仍以成熟工艺为主，先进节点市占可忽略
milestones.still_missing_en: Weak below 7nm P&R; customer base mostly mature nodes with negligible advanced-node share

sources.title: 华大九天2024年年度报告

milestones.headline_zh: 华为 MetaERP 替换 Oracle，覆盖 100% 业务场景
milestones.headline_en: Huawei MetaERP replaces Oracle across 100% business scenarios
milestones.before_gap_zh: 集团级 ERP 高端市场由 SAP/Oracle 垄断，国产用友/金蝶难以支撑全球化多法人复杂核算
milestones.before_gap_en: Tier-1 group ERP was SAP/Oracle turf; domestic Yonyou/Kingdee struggled with global multi-entity accounting complexity
milestones.achievement_zh: 2023-04-20 完成 MetaERP 全量切换：基于欧拉 OS + GaussDB 自研数据层重建财务/供应链/制造核心模块，月结/季结/年结零故障运行
milestones.achievement_en: 2023-04-20 full MetaERP cutover: rebuilt finance/supply-chain/manufacturing cores on Euler OS + GaussDB data layer; zero-fault month/quarter/year close
milestones.still_missing_zh: 外部行业复制仍处早期；复杂制造业 MES/PLM 深度集成不如 SAP S/4HANA 成熟生态
milestones.still_missing_en: External industry replication still early; deep MES/PLM integration trails mature SAP S/4HANA ecosystem

sources.title: 华为 MetaERP 新闻稿

milestones.headline_zh: 概伦 SDEP 器件模型自动提取平台通过三星先进工艺认证
milestones.headline_en: Primarius SDEP model-extraction platform certified on Samsung advanced nodes
milestones.before_gap_zh: SPICE 模型交付高度依赖工程师经验，国产平台难以进入国际头部晶圆厂标准工具链
milestones.before_gap_en: SPICE model delivery relied on senior engineers; few domestic platforms entered top foundry standard flows
milestones.achievement_zh: 三星代工厂采用 SDEP 自动提取平台，官方称模型提取效率提升 50%+，缩短 DTCO 迭代周期；BSIMProPlus 已用于 3nm 级工艺研发
milestones.achievement_en: Samsung Foundry adopted SDEP with 50%+ extraction efficiency gains per vendor; BSIMProPlus used down to 3nm R&D
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全流程数字 EDA 仍缺位；制造类 EDA 收入规模远小于华大九天/国际巨头
milestones.still_missing_en: No full digital EDA stack; manufacturing EDA revenue still far below Empyrean and global leaders

sources.title: 三星代工厂采用概伦 SDEP

milestones.headline_zh: 中望发布 Overdrive 几何内核与 ZGS 约束求解器
milestones.headline_en: ZWSOFT ships Overdrive kernel and ZGS constraint solver
milestones.before_gap_zh: 多数国产三维 CAD 租赁第三方内核（ACIS/Parasolid），源代码不可控，高端装备领域存在断供风险
milestones.before_gap_en: Most domestic 3D CAD leased third-party kernels (ACIS/Parasolid) without source control — supply-cut risk in high-end equipment
milestones.achievement_zh: 正式发布自主 Overdrive B-rep 几何内核、ZGS 三维约束求解器与 IPX 参数化引擎；Linux 信创版覆盖龙芯/鲲鹏/飞腾，实现源代码级可控的三维 MCAD 底座
milestones.achievement_en: GA release of owned Overdrive B-rep kernel, ZGS 3D constraint solver, and IPX parametric engine; Linux builds on Loongson/Kunpeng/Phytium — source-level controlled 3D MCAD foundation
milestones.still_missing_zh: 大型装配、曲面 A 级质量、与 PLM/MBD 深度集成仍落后 CATIA/NX；海外高端客户渗透有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Large assemblies, Class-A surfaces, deep PLM/MBD integration still trail CATIA/NX; limited penetration with overseas tier-1 OEMs

sources.title: 中望软件2024年度产品发布会

milestones.headline_zh: 浩辰 CAD Linux 版完成主流国产 OS/芯片全适配
milestones.headline_en: GstarCAD Linux completes mainstream domestic OS/CPU ports
milestones.before_gap_zh: 信创场景缺少可编辑 DWG 的纯国产 Linux CAD，用户只能运行 Windows 虚拟机
milestones.before_gap_en: IT-innovation stacks lacked native Linux DWG CAD — users ran Windows VMs
milestones.achievement_zh: 浩辰发布 Linux 版 CAD，完成统信 UOS/麒麟 OS 与龙芯/飞腾/鲲鹏 CPU 组合适配，支持 DWG 原生编辑、OFD 国标加密与二次开发 API
milestones.achievement_en: GstarCAD Linux ports to UOS/Kylin on Loongson/Phytium/Kunpeng with native DWG editing, OFD encryption, and extension APIs
milestones.still_missing_zh: 三维装配、钣金展开、CAM 集成弱于中望/SolidWorks；大企业 PLM 集成案例少
milestones.still_missing_en: 3D assembly, sheet-metal, CAM integration trail ZWSOFT/SolidWorks; few enterprise PLM integrations

milestones.headline_zh: 广联达 GGP/GSolid 图形平台获信通院自主可控测评 S 级
milestones.headline_en: Glodon GGP/GSolid graphics platform earns CAICT self-reliance grade S
milestones.before_gap_zh: 建筑 BIM 底层几何/渲染长期依赖国外引擎授权，信创场景无法做到内核级自主
milestones.before_gap_en: Building BIM relied on licensed foreign geometry/render engines — no kernel-level autonomy for IT-innovation deployments
milestones.achievement_zh: GGP 图形平台历经 20+ 年研发，几何建模/渲染/参数化/约束求解全栈自主，通过信通院泰尔测评 S 级；适配鸿蒙/麒麟/统信，支撑 BIM 正向设计与造价算量
milestones.achievement_en: 20+ years on GGP with owned geometry, rendering, parametric, and constraint stack; CAICT grade S; HarmonyOS/Kylin/UOS ports for BIM authoring and quantity takeoff
milestones.still_missing_zh: 超大型基建多专业实时协同、国际 IFC 互操作深度、复杂幕墙 Class-A 曲面仍弱于 Revit+Bentley 组合
milestones.still_missing_en: Mega-infrastructure multi-discipline realtime collab, deep IFC interoperability, complex facade Class-A surfaces still trail Revit+Bentley stacks

sources.title: 广州市自主可控应用与发展白皮书

milestones.headline_zh: 中控发布流程工业时序大模型 TPT，落地百余套装置
milestones.headline_en: SUPCON launches process-industry time-series model TPT on 100+ units
milestones.before_gap_zh: 流程工业优化依赖人工经验+碎片化 APC 模型，缺少跨装置、跨工况的统一 AI 时序基座
milestones.before_gap_en: Process optimization relied on expert rules and fragmented APC models — no cross-unit time-series AI foundation
milestones.achievement_zh: 发布流程工业时序大模型 TPT（Time-series Pre-trained Transformer），在氯碱/热电/石化等装置完成闭环优化验证；镇海炼化油品切换由 6–7h 缩至 2h 内
milestones.achievement_en: Shipped process-industry time-series foundation model TPT (Time-series Pre-trained Transformer) with closed-loop validation in chlor-alkali/thermal/petrochemical units; Zhenhai refinery product switch cut from 6–7h to under 2h
milestones.still_missing_zh: TPT 2 仍处商业早期；开源 LLM 无法直接替代 OT 级闭环控制的安全认证与确定性
milestones.still_missing_en: TPT 2 still early commercial; open LLMs cannot replace OT-grade closed-loop safety certification and determinism

milestones.headline_en: Huazhong CNC-9 with on-board AI improves machining precision 10–20%
milestones.before_gap_zh: 高档五轴数控系统长期被西门子 840D、发那科 30i 垄断，国产系统市占不足 10%
milestones.before_gap_en: High-end 5-axis CNC was Siemens 840D / Fanuc 30i dominated; domestic share under ~10%
milestones.achievement_zh: 华中 9 型数控系统集成国产 AI 芯片，在涡旋压缩机零件五轴加工中较国外系统精度提升 10–20%，已配套十余类千台五轴机床
milestones.achievement_en: CNC-9 integrates domestic AI accelerator; scroll-compressor 5-axis parts 10–20% more precise vs foreign systems; deployed on 1000+ machines across 10+ machine classes
milestones.still_missing_zh: 航空发动机叶片级可靠性累计运行小时、全球 OEM 认证仍落后；数控系统出口规模有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Aero-engine blade reliability hours and global OEM qualifications still lag; limited CNC export scale

milestones.headline_zh: 华大九天 ALPS 电路仿真获三星晶圆代工 4nm 工艺认证
milestones.headline_en: Empyrean ALPS SPICE simulator certified on Samsung Foundry 4nm
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产晶体管级电路仿真工具此前最高仅通过 5nm 认证，4nm 先进节点仍依赖 Synopsys/Cadence 生态
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic transistor-level SPICE tools had topped out at 5nm certification; 4nm nodes still relied on Synopsys/Cadence stacks
milestones.achievement_zh: 2024 半年报披露 ALPS 继 8nm、5nm 后获 Samsung Foundry 4nm 工艺认证，并获 ISO 26262 TCL3 / IEC 61508 T2，可支撑 ASIL-D 车规芯片设计
milestones.achievement_en: 2024 interim report: ALPS certified at Samsung Foundry 4nm after 8nm/5nm, plus ISO 26262 TCL3 / IEC 61508 T2 for ASIL-D automotive flows
milestones.still_missing_zh: 数字实现（布局布线/签核）仍弱于国际三巨头；国内先进节点量产流片仍以进口 EDA 为主
milestones.still_missing_en: Digital implementation (P&R/signoff) still lags the big three; domestic advanced-node tape-outs still run mostly on imported EDA

sources.title: 华大九天2024年半年度报告

milestones.headline_zh: 华大九天发布 Argus 3DIC 物理验证平台，覆盖 Chiplet/2.5D/3D 全流程
milestones.headline_en: Empyrean ships Argus 3DIC PV platform for chiplet / 2.5D / 3D flows
milestones.before_gap_zh: 异构集成三维芯片协同设计到 Signoff 长期由 Calibre 等进口工具垄断，国产 EDA 无全流程方案
milestones.before_gap_en: Heterogeneous 3DIC co-design-to-signoff was Calibre-led; no domestic full-flow EDA equivalent
milestones.achievement_zh: 发布 Argus 3DIC 物理验证平台，覆盖异构集成三维芯片从协同设计到 Signoff 的 DRC/LVS 流程；3D 数据编织技术将验证周期从约 2 周缩至 1–2 天（厂商披露）
milestones.achievement_en: Shipped Argus 3DIC PV covering heterogeneous 3DIC co-design-to-signoff DRC/LVS; 3D data-weaving cuts cycle from ~2 weeks to 1–2 days per vendor
milestones.still_missing_zh: 竞争声明需客户量产流片验证；数字实现全流程仍弱于 Synopsys/Cadence
milestones.still_missing_en: Competitive claims need customer tape-out validation; full digital implementation still trails Synopsys/Cadence

milestones.headline_zh: 数码大方发布 MEGA Kernel 自主 CAD 几何引擎
milestones.headline_en: CAXA ships MEGA Kernel owned CAD geometry engine
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产 CAD 厂商长期租赁第三方内核，源代码不可控，高端装备领域存在断供风险
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic CAD vendors leased third-party kernels without source control — supply-cut risk in high-end equipment
milestones.achievement_zh: 2026-03-30 发布新一代 MEGA Kernel：支持多几何表达（B-rep/NURBS/网格）与工程级精度约束，作为 CAXA 三维 CAD/PLM 统一几何底座；同步开放 PLM 平台 1000+ API
milestones.achievement_en: 2026-03-30 GA of MEGA Kernel with multi-representation geometry (B-rep/NURBS/mesh) and engineering-grade precision constraints as unified CAXA 3D CAD/PLM foundation; open PLM platform with 1000+ APIs
milestones.still_missing_zh: 大型装配性能、国际 OEM 认证案例仍少于 Siemens NX/CATIA
milestones.still_missing_en: Large-assembly performance and international OEM qualifications still trail Siemens NX/CATIA

sources.title: CAXA 2027 发布会

milestones.headline_zh: 3D3S 通过建设部科技成果鉴定，确立国产空间钢结构有限元分析商用地位
milestones.headline_en: 3D3S passes MOHURD S&T achievement appraisal—establishes commercial domestic FEM for spatial steel structures
milestones.before_gap_zh: 1990年代末至2000年代初，网架、网壳、门式刚架等空间钢结构建模、荷载组合与整体稳定分析在工程界普遍依赖 STAAD.Pro、SAP2000 等进口通用有限元软件
milestones.before_gap_en: In the late 1990s–early 2000s, modeling, load combination, and global stability analysis for spatial steel (trusses, shells, portal frames) relied on imported general FEM such as STAAD.Pro and SAP2000
milestones.achievement_zh: 同济大学李国强团队研制的 3D3S 空间钢结构设计分析系统通过建设部科技成果鉴定并产业化推广，形成面向空间钢结构的自主有限元分析内核，可在该细分领域替代进口通用结构求解器
milestones.achievement_en: The Tongji Li Guoqiang team's 3D3S spatial-steel design/analysis system passed MOHURD S&T achievement appraisal and entered commercial rollout, delivering an owned FEM kernel for spatial steel that could substitute imported general structural solvers in this niche
milestones.still_missing_zh: 复杂节点非线性、国际规范包、通用多物理场耦合仍弱于国际头部产品
milestones.still_missing_en: Complex joint nonlinearity, international code packs, and general multiphysics coupling remained weaker than leading foreign tools

milestones.before_gap_en: Steel projects required both correct analysis and Chinese GB checks (loads, stability, connections); imported tools needed manual spreadsheets or side calculations and lacked an integrated compliant design chain
milestones.achievement_zh: 3D3S Design / 3D3S CAD 等版本被列入中国工程建设标准化协会发布的《建筑结构软件选用名录》，在多层/轻钢/门式刚架/网架/网壳等场景被设计院与审图机构作为合规国产方案采信
milestones.achievement_en: 3D3S Design / 3D3S CAD were listed in the CECS-published Building Structural Software Selection Catalog, accepted by design institutes and reviewers as a compliant domestic option for multi-story/light steel/portal-frame/truss/shell work
milestones.still_missing_zh: 欧/美规范审图、外资业主指定国际求解器审查链接受度仍低于在位进口软件
milestones.still_missing_en: EU/US code review acceptance and foreign-owner mandates for international solvers remained lower than incumbent imports

milestones.before_gap_zh: 工程实践长期采用「SAP2000/STAAD 计算 + Excel 节点验算 + AutoCAD 翻图」三段式流程，进口软件无原生中国钢结构施工图与节点大样输出
milestones.before_gap_en: Practice was a three-step chain of SAP2000/STAAD analysis + Excel connection checks + AutoCAD drafting; imports lacked native Chinese steel construction drawing and connection detailing output
milestones.achievement_zh: 3D3S Design 将门式刚架、网架等典型钢结构的参数化建模、整体分析、构件与连接国标验算及施工图/材料表输出集成于单一国产平台，显著替代进口分析软件+二次出图组合
milestones.achievement_en: 3D3S Design integrated parametric modeling, global analysis, member/connection GB checks, and construction drawings/BOM for portal frames and trusses in one domestic platform—displacing import-solver plus secondary drafting workflows
milestones.still_missing_zh: 复杂异型节点三维实体建模、与国际 BIM（IFC/Revit）深度互操作仍弱于 AutoCAD+import-solver 生态
milestones.still_missing_en: Complex 3D joint solids and deep BIM (IFC/Revit) interoperability remained weaker than the AutoCAD + import-solver ecosystem

milestones.headline_en: Cable-membrane form-finding and nonlinear analysis matures—substitutes import specialty workflows
milestones.before_gap_zh: 索膜、张弦桁架等柔性空间结构找形、初始态与几何非线性分析在大型项目中多依赖 ANSYS 或国外索膜专用程序
milestones.before_gap_en: Form-finding, initial-state, and geometric nonlinear analysis for cable-membrane and tension structures often relied on ANSYS or foreign specialty programs on large projects
milestones.achievement_zh: 3D3S 发布并工程化索膜结构找形、初始应力态与几何非线性分析模块，在体育场馆、景观膜结构等项目中形成可审图的国产替代方案
milestones.achievement_en: 3D3S shipped production-grade cable-membrane form-finding, initial prestress state, and geometric nonlinear analysis—delivering reviewable domestic alternatives for stadium and landmark membrane projects
milestones.still_missing_zh: 风致动力耦合、膜材本构高级失效准则与全球大型膜结构第三方认证案例仍少于国际专用软件
milestones.still_missing_en: Wind-induced dynamic coupling, advanced membrane constitutive failure criteria, and global third-party certification cases remained fewer than international specialty tools

milestones.headline_en: Early rollout of GB 50017-2017 updated steel design code support
milestones.before_gap_zh: 新版《钢结构设计标准》GB 50017-2017 实施后，进口通用软件对中国新稳定公式、抗震与构造条款更新滞后，设计院需人工换算
milestones.before_gap_en: After GB 50017-2017 took effect, imported general tools lagged on new Chinese stability, seismic, and detailing rules—forcing manual conversions in design offices
milestones.achievement_zh: 3D3S Design 在国标换版窗口期完成新版稳定、强度与构造验算规则升级，使钢结构专项设计可继续以国产平台满足审图合规，而非等待进口软件补丁
milestones.achievement_en: 3D3S Design upgraded stability, strength, and detailing checks for the new GB 50017-2017 code cycle, letting steel specialists stay on a domestic compliant platform instead of waiting for import patches
milestones.still_missing_zh: AISC/Eurocode 等国际规范并行设计、外资项目双规范审查包仍弱于 RFEM/SAP2000
milestones.still_missing_en: Parallel AISC/Eurocode design and dual-code review packs for foreign projects remained weaker than RFEM/SAP2000

milestones.headline_zh: 阿里云发布 ET 工业大脑，建成面向制造的工业数据智能中台

milestones.before_gap_en: Large manufacturers relied on foreign IIoT platforms such as GE Predix, Siemens MindSphere, and PTC ThingWorx—or heavy custom integration—for cross-line data aggregation and cloud industrial intelligence
milestones.achievement_zh: 2017 杭州云栖大会发布 ET 工业大脑，提供工业数据中枢、算法模型市场与可视化分析，将光伏、橡胶、钢铁等标杆场景接入统一云化工业智能栈
milestones.achievement_en: At the 2017 Computing Conference, Alibaba shipped ET Industrial Brain with an industrial data hub, algorithm marketplace, and analytics—onboarding flagship sectors including PV, rubber, and steel onto one cloud industrial-intelligence stack
milestones.still_missing_zh: 底层 DCS/PLC、高端 MES 与 OT 协议栈仍多由 Emerson/Yokogawa/Siemens 等外资或国产工控伙伴承担；平台 OT 连接深度依赖集成商
milestones.still_missing_en: Underlying DCS/PLC, high-end MES, and OT protocol stacks still largely from Emerson/Yokogawa/Siemens or domestic OT partners; platform OT connectivity remains integrator-dependent

milestones.achievement_zh: 作为 ET 工业大脑首发标杆之一，正泰新能源电池片产线部署云端视觉算法与产线数据联动，实现缺陷自动识别、归因与工艺反馈
milestones.achievement_en: As a launch reference for ET Industrial Brain, Chint New Energy deployed cloud vision models tied to line data for automated defect detection, root-cause tagging, and process feedback
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高速线扫相机、光学与部分边缘推理硬件仍常采 Basler/Cognex 等国际品牌；全栈自主机器视觉软硬件未完全替代
milestones.still_missing_en: High-speed line cameras, optics, and some edge inference hardware still often use Basler/Cognex; full-stack domestic machine-vision hardware/software not fully replaced

milestones.before_gap_en: Large-scale cotton spinning smart scheduling and order-energy coordination relied on SAP MII/MES, Rieter/USTER digital suites, or import consulting packages
milestones.achievement_zh: 天虹纺织与阿里云合作建设万锭级智能纺纱车间，以工业大脑汇聚机台、能耗与订单数据，实现云端排产优化与供应链协同，成为工信部智能制造示范引用案例
milestones.achievement_en: Tianhong partnered with Alibaba to build 10k-spindle intelligent workshops; Industrial Brain aggregated machine, energy, and order data for cloud production scheduling and supply-chain coordination—later cited as an MIIT smart-manufacturing exemplar
milestones.still_missing_zh: 单机纺机控制系统与高端专件仍依赖立达、萨维奥等外资设备生态；工业大脑主要替代上层计划与协同软件层
milestones.still_missing_en: Machine-level spinning controls and premium components still depend on Rieter/Saurer ecosystems; Industrial Brain mainly substitutes the upper planning/coordination software layer

milestones.headline_zh: Bambu Studio 原生支持 AMS 四料槽自动换料与多色/多材料 G-code 编排
milestones.headline_en: Bambu Studio ships native AMS 4-slot auto toolchange and multi-color/material G-code orchestration
milestones.before_gap_zh: 消费级 FDM 多色打印依赖 PrusaSlicer+MMU、Mosaic Palette 等国外软硬件组合；国产切片软件（Creality Print、FlashPrint 等）无等效的原生多材料换料与废料塔/冲刷编排能力
milestones.before_gap_en: Consumer FDM multi-color relied on foreign stacks like PrusaSlicer+MMU or Mosaic Palette; domestic Chinese slicers (Creality Print, FlashPrint, etc.) lacked equivalent native multi-material toolchange and purge/wipe-tower orchestration
milestones.achievement_zh: 随 X1 系列发布，Bambu Studio 在切片阶段完成 AMS 四色料盘映射、换料序列、冲刷体积与 RFID 耗材参数联动，实现软硬件闭环的多色/多材料工作流
milestones.achievement_en: Launched with the X1 series, Bambu Studio maps four AMS spools at slice time, generates toolchange/purge sequences, and syncs RFID spool profiles—closing the loop for multi-color/material workflows
milestones.still_missing_zh: 工业级批量排版、零件修复与工艺仿真仍由 Materialise Magics、Autodesk Netfabb 等国际软件主导；第三方打印机完整 AMS 体验依赖 OrcaSlicer 社区分支
milestones.still_missing_en: Industrial batch nesting, mesh repair, and build simulation remain led by Materialise Magics and Autodesk Netfabb; full AMS workflows on third-party printers depend on the OrcaSlicer community fork

milestones.before_gap_en: While Creality Cloud existed domestically, end-to-end slice-to-queue-to-mobile-monitor stacks were mainly delivered by Ultimaker Digital Factory, Prusa Connect, and OctoPrint internationally; few Chinese vendors offered a comparably mature official closed loop
milestones.achievement_zh: X1 上市时 Bambu Studio 账号体系与 Bambu Handy、打印机 LAN/云链路联动，支持远程发起打印、摄像头直播、进度与告警推送，形成国产 slicer 少见的官方云原生运维路径
milestones.achievement_en: At X1 launch, Bambu Studio account services linked with Bambu Handy and printer LAN/cloud paths for remote print start, camera live view, and progress/alert push—an uncommon official cloud-native ops path for a domestic slicer
milestones.still_missing_zh: 企业级多站点权限、审计与 MES/ERP 对接弱于工业软件；私有化部署与数据驻留选项有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Enterprise multi-site RBAC, audit trails, and MES/ERP integration remain weak vs industrial software; limited private-cloud and data-residency options

milestones.achievement_en: MakerWorld, Bambu’s official model and print-profile platform, links with Bambu Studio accounts and printer configs so users can import profiled models and start prints—shortening the download-to-part collaboration chain
milestones.still_missing_zh: 开放第三方 CAD/PLM 协作接口与版本管理仍弱；平台内容治理与版权工具不及成熟国际社区十年积累
milestones.still_missing_en: Open third-party CAD/PLM collaboration APIs and revision control remain limited; platform moderation and IP tooling trail mature international communities

milestones.headline_zh: 宝钢总厂生产管制系统上线，国产钢铁 L3/MES 雏形
milestones.headline_en: Baosteel plant-wide production control system goes live as domestic steel L3/MES precursor
milestones.before_gap_zh: 1990 年代国内大型钢厂产线计划下发、调度与生产实绩汇总多依赖 IBM 主机/Oracle 数据库叠加 Honeywell、Siemens 等外资 L2/L3 集成包或进口咨询总包，难以按宝钢多产线工艺快速迭代
milestones.before_gap_en: In the 1990s, large Chinese steel mills relied on IBM mainframe/Oracle stacks plus Honeywell/Siemens L2/L3 integration packages or imported consulting for scheduling and production reporting—hard to iterate for Baosteel's multi-line processes
milestones.achievement_zh: 宝信前身（宝钢自动化部）研制并投运宝钢总厂生产管制系统，贯通炼铁—炼钢—轧制链路的计划、调度与实绩一体化管控；公司沿革将其表述为国产钢铁制造执行/三级计算机系统的起点
milestones.achievement_en: Baosight's predecessor (Baosteel Automation Dept.) developed and deployed Baosteel's plant-wide production control system integrating planning, scheduling, and actuals across ironmaking-steelmaking-rolling—cited in corporate history as the origin of domestic steel MES/L3
milestones.still_missing_zh: DCS/PLC 与一级数据采集仍大量进口；系统尚未产品化为可对外复制的商用 MES
milestones.still_missing_en: DCS/PLC and Level-1 data acquisition remained largely imported; the stack was not yet a commercial off-the-shelf MES for external customers

milestones.before_gap_en: Around 2000, domestic steel greenfield/expansion MES selections often referenced Siemens SIMATIC IT Production, SAP MII/ME, or Rockwell FactoryTalk ProductionCentre; steel process models and local ERP/order-system integration were costly and slow

milestones.still_missing_zh: 宝钢系以外钢厂导入仍有限；与 SAP/Oracle ERP 的标准接口与行业包成熟度不及进口 MES 生态

milestones.headline_zh: 宝钢 1580mm 热轧产线 iMES 投运，热轧 MES 国产化
milestones.headline_en: Baosteel 1580mm hot-strip iMES go-live displaces import hot-rolling MES
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国内新建宽幅热轧机组的 MES 与质量追溯常采购 Siemens SIMATIC IT 或 SAP MII 叠加进口 L2 自动化，热轧排程、质量 SPC 与卷号全流程追溯依赖外资原厂授权与长期服务
milestones.before_gap_en: New wide hot-strip mills often procured Siemens SIMATIC IT or SAP MII atop imported L2 automation; hot-rolling scheduling, quality SPC, and coil-level traceability required foreign OEM licensing and long-term support
milestones.achievement_zh: 宝信 iMES 在宝钢 1580 热轧工程投运，覆盖热轧计划/调度、实绩采集、质量设计与卷号追溯，公开案例将其作为打破热轧 MES 进口依赖的标杆项目
milestones.achievement_en: Baosight iMES went live on Baosteel's 1580 hot-strip project covering hot-rolling planning/scheduling, actuals acquisition, quality design, and coil traceability—widely cited as a benchmark breaking import dependence for hot-rolling MES
milestones.still_missing_zh: 热轧数学模型、部分高端仪表与驱动仍依赖进口；跨厂复制高度依赖宝钢工艺知识库
milestones.still_missing_en: Hot-rolling mathematical models and some high-end instruments/drives remained imported; cross-mill replication depended heavily on Baosteel process know-how

milestones.headline_zh: 湛江钢铁一期建成投产，宝信全栈 MES 支撑新一代智慧钢厂
milestones.headline_en: Zhanjiang Steel phase-1 start-up with full-stack Baosight MES for greenfield smart steel plant
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国际 greenfield 智慧钢厂参考架构常采用 Siemens Opcenter/SIMATIC IT + SAP ERP/MII 或 IBM/Accenture 工业 4.0 咨询总包，MES 与工厂数据平台多为外资组合方案
milestones.before_gap_en: International greenfield smart-steel reference architectures typically combined Siemens Opcenter/SIMATIC IT + SAP ERP/MII or IBM/Accenture Industry 4.0 EPC; MES and plant data platforms were mostly foreign bundles
milestones.achievement_zh: 2015-09 湛江钢铁一期（炼铁—炼钢—热轧）建成投产；宝信承担制造 MES、数据采集与工厂信息化总集成，集团及媒体通稿将其定位为按 Industry 4.0 理念新建的数字化钢厂，未采用进口 MES 总包
milestones.achievement_en: Zhanjiang Steel phase-1 (ironmaking-steelmaking-hot rolling) started production in 2015-09; Baosight delivered manufacturing MES, data acquisition, and plant IT integration—official and press coverage positioned it as a greenfield digital steel plant built to Industry 4.0 principles without an imported MES EPC
milestones.still_missing_zh: 部分核心工艺控制与大型驱动仍外资；数字孪生实时仿真深度与跨基地复制能力仍在演进
milestones.still_missing_en: Some core process controls and large drives remained foreign; digital-twin real-time simulation depth and cross-site replication were still evolving

milestones.headline_zh: 宝武集团制造管理系统多基地推广，替代子公司外资 MES
milestones.headline_en: Baowu unified manufacturing management system rollout replaces foreign MES at subsidiaries
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2016 宝武合并后，武钢、梅山等子公司并存多套 MES/L3（含 Siemens SIMATIC IT、SAP MII 及早期定制系统），集团级排产协同、质量一贯制与订单兑现缺乏统一国产平台
milestones.before_gap_en: After the 2016 Baowu merger, subsidiaries such as WISCO and Meishan ran multiple MES/L3 stacks (including Siemens SIMATIC IT, SAP MII, and legacy custom systems); group-level scheduling coordination, quality continuity, and order fulfillment lacked a unified domestic platform
milestones.achievement_zh: 宝信在宝武集团内推广统一制造管理系统/iMES 模板；年报与集团智能制造项目披露显示至 2018 年前后完成武钢有限等基地 MES 切换或升级，核心产线 MES 实现国产化归一
milestones.achievement_en: Baosight rolled out a unified manufacturing management system/iMES template across Baowu; annual reports and group smart-manufacturing disclosures indicate WISCO and other bases completed MES cutover/upgrades around 2018, consolidating mission-critical MES on a domestic stack
milestones.still_missing_zh: 非钢行业与海外基地 MES 仍多外资；集团外市场化份额与 Siemens Opcenter 全球生态仍有差距
milestones.still_missing_en: Non-steel segments and overseas sites still often use foreign MES; external market share and ecosystem breadth remain behind Siemens Opcenter globally

milestones.headline_zh: 柏楚推出 FSCUT 数控系统与 CypCut 激光切割工艺软件，形成国产一体化平板激光加工栈
milestones.headline_en: Bochu ships FSCUT CNC and CypCut laser process software as first integrated domestic flat-bed laser stack
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2012 年前国内平板激光机普遍采购德国倍福（Beckhoff）、意大利 PA 等进口板卡/总线数控与闭源工艺包，国产厂商缺少可量产的「运动控制+切割工艺」闭环方案
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2012, Chinese flat-bed laser OEMs relied on imported Beckhoff, PA, and similar board/bus CNC plus closed foreign process stacks; no domestic vendor offered a production-grade motion-plus-process closed loop
milestones.achievement_zh: 柏楚 2012 年正式进入激光切割领域，推出 FSCUT 系列激光切割控制系统与 CypCut 激光切割软件，并与自研 BCS100 调高器协同，首次在国内实现可批量交付的国产平板激光切割运控+CAM 一体化方案
milestones.achievement_en: Bochu entered laser cutting in 2012 with the FSCUT motion-control family and CypCut process CAM, coordinated with the in-house BCS100 height follower—the first domestically mass-deliverable integrated flat-bed laser control plus CAM stack in China
milestones.still_missing_zh: 整机品牌机（通快、百超等）仍绑定原厂 TruTops/BySoft；超高功率厚板、五轴坡口等高端工艺当时仍落后于进口标杆
milestones.still_missing_en: Branded OEM machines (Trumpf, Bystronic) still shipped with TruTops/BySoft; ultra-high-power thick plate and 5-axis bevel processes still trailed import benchmarks

sources.title: 柏楚电子首次公开发行股票并在科创板上市招股说明书

milestones.headline_zh: BCS100 电容调高器量产，打破激光切割头随动调高器进口依赖
milestones.headline_en: BCS100 capacitive height follower reaches production, breaking import dependence for laser head tracking
milestones.before_gap_zh: 平板激光切割需实时随动保持喷嘴—板材间距；此前国内设备多配套 Precitec 等进口电容调高器，与国产数控系统耦合成本高
milestones.before_gap_en: Flat-bed laser cutting requires real-time standoff tracking; Chinese machines mostly paired Precitec-class imported capacitive followers with high integration cost to domestic CNC
milestones.achievement_zh: 招股说明书披露柏楚自研 BCS100 电容调高器，与 FSCUT/CypCut 深度集成，实现切割头高度实时跟踪与工艺闭环，使国产激光机可在不调进口调高模块的情况下完成量产交付
milestones.achievement_en: The IPO prospectus documents the in-house BCS100 capacitive follower deeply integrated with FSCUT/CypCut for real-time head-height tracking, enabling mass production without imported follower modules
milestones.still_missing_zh: 极端反射材料、超高速飞切等工况下，传感器与算法精度仍追赶进口高端调高方案
milestones.still_missing_en: Sensor and algorithm precision on highly reflective materials and extreme fly-cut regimes still chase top-tier imported followers

milestones.headline_zh: 国产中功率平板激光切割控制系统市占突破六成，进口倍福/PA 方案被大规模替代
milestones.headline_en: Domestic mid-power flat-bed laser control share exceeds 60%, displacing Beckhoff/PA stacks at national scale
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2016 年前后进口倍福、PA、西门子数控仍占据国内平板激光机控制系统主要份额，国产工艺软件缺乏装机规模
milestones.before_gap_en: Around 2016, imported Beckhoff, PA, and Siemens CNC still held the bulk of China's flat-bed laser control installs; domestic process CAM lacked deployment scale
milestones.achievement_zh: 招股说明书（2018 年数据）披露：柏楚在中功率平板激光切割机控制系统中国市场占有率约 65%，CypCut 随 FSCUT 成为邦德、迪能、奔腾等国产激光机厂标配，实现该细分赛道由进口主导转为国产主导
milestones.achievement_en: The 2019 IPO prospectus (2018 data) states ~65% China share in mid-power flat-bed laser control; CypCut with FSCUT became default on major domestic OEM lines (e.g. Bodor, DNE, Pent), flipping the segment from import- to domestic-led
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高端原装进口整机仍用原厂软件；柏楚海外直接收入占比低，国际标杆客户少于通快/百超生态
milestones.still_missing_en: High-end imported OEM machines still run factory software; Bochu's direct overseas revenue share remains low with fewer global reference accounts than Trumpf/Bystronic ecosystems

milestones.headline_zh: FSCUT5000 + CypCut 支持万瓦级光纤激光厚板切割，填补国产高端功率段工艺空白
milestones.headline_en: FSCUT5000 with CypCut supports 10kW+ fiber laser thick-plate cutting, closing domestic high-power process gap
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2019 年前万瓦级光纤激光器国产化后，厚板高速稳定切割仍多依赖进口数控与工艺包，国产软件在熔池管理、穿孔与拐角工艺上难以支撑连续生产
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2019, after domestic 10kW-class fiber lasers appeared, stable thick-plate high-speed cutting still leaned on imported CNC and process packs; domestic CAM struggled on melt-pool, pierce, and corner strategies for continuous production
milestones.achievement_zh: 柏楚 2020 年推出面向万瓦级激光切割的 FSCUT5000 控制系统，CypCut 配套厚板、高功率切割工艺策略，使国产激光装备可在 12kW 及以上功率段实现可量产加工
milestones.achievement_en: Bochu launched the FSCUT5000 control system for 10kW-class cutting in 2020 with CypCut thick-plate/high-power process strategies, enabling production-grade machining at 12kW and above on domestic machines
milestones.still_missing_zh: 20kW+ 超厚板航空级精度、复杂三维坡口与坡口+旋转轴联动仍弱于进口高端方案
milestones.still_missing_en: 20kW+ ultra-thick aerospace-grade accuracy and complex 3D bevel with rotary-axis coordination still trail top imported stacks

milestones.headline_zh: CypNest 套料软件与 CypCut 工艺一体交付，替代 SigmaNEST/Lantek 在国产激光机上的标配地位
milestones.headline_en: CypNest nesting ships integrated with CypCut process, displacing SigmaNEST/Lantek as default on domestic laser lines
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产激光产线套料长期依赖 SigmaNEST、Lantek Expert 等进口软件，与国产切割工艺参数分离，材料利用率优化与加工路径需二次对接
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic laser lines relied on imported SigmaNEST and Lantek Expert nesting disconnected from domestic cutting recipes, requiring secondary post-processing to align nest layouts with machine process parameters
milestones.achievement_zh: 柏楚发布 CypNest 板材套料软件，与 CypCut/HypCut 共享工艺数据库与加工后置，实现「套料—切割—余料管理」同一厂商闭环，在柏楚生态装机机上替代进口套料成为默认选项
milestones.achievement_en: Bochu released CypNest sheet nesting integrated with CypCut/HypCut via a shared process database and post-processor, closing nest-to-cut-to-remnant workflow under one vendor and replacing imported nesting as the default on Bochu-ecosystem machines
milestones.still_missing_zh: 非柏楚第三方控制器兼容性、钢结构 CloudNest 场景与国际大型板材服务中心案例仍少于 Lantek
milestones.still_missing_en: Third-party non-Bochu controller compatibility, steel-structure CloudNest scenarios, and international large service-center references still trail Lantek

milestones.headline_en: Bochu ships proprietary 2D sheet-nesting software CypNest
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国内平面激光下料线专业套料长期采购 Lantek Expert、SigmaNEST、JETCAM 等进口 CAM，与国产 FSCUT/CypCut 运控栈割裂，需二次后处理
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic flat-bed laser lines bought imported nesting CAM (Lantek Expert, SigmaNEST, JETCAM) separate from domestic FSCUT/CypCut motion stacks, requiring extra post-processing
milestones.achievement_zh: 推出自主研发 CypNest 平面套料软件，支持真形排样、共边切割与余料管理，并与 CypCut/FSCUT 形成「套料—切割—运控」一体化国产流程
milestones.achievement_en: Shipped owned CypNest with true-shape nesting, common-line cutting, and remnant management, forming an integrated domestic nest-to-cut-to-motion workflow with CypCut/FSCUT
milestones.still_missing_zh: 非柏楚生态第三方机床需单独验证；钢结构/船舶厚板复杂坡口套料仍常见 FastCAM/Lantek
milestones.still_missing_en: Third-party non-Bochu machines need separate validation; heavy steel/marine bevel nesting still often uses FastCAM/Lantek

milestones.headline_en: Bochu laser-control ecosystem share leads; nesting software scales as import-bundle substitute
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2018 年前国内中低功率平面激光产线普遍采用「进口或第三方套料 + 进口/杂牌运控」方案，国产厂商缺少可量产的套料—切割闭环
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2018, mid/low-power flat-bed laser lines commonly ran imported or third-party nesting plus import/generic motion control; no domestic vendor shipped production-grade nest-to-cut loops
milestones.achievement_zh: 招股说明书披露 2018 年发行人在中低功率平面激光切割控制系统市场份额约 60%，应用软件（含 CypNest 套料）随 FSCUT 在主流激光设备厂商标配，实质替代原 Lantek/SigmaNEST 独立授权模式
milestones.achievement_en: IPO discloses ~60% share in mid/low-power flat-bed laser CNC in 2018; application software (including CypNest nesting) bundled with FSCUT as OEM default, substantially replacing standalone Lantek/SigmaNEST licensing
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高端万瓦厚板、三维五轴激光套料仍部分依赖进口；海外直接销售占比低
milestones.still_missing_en: Ultra-high-power thick plate and 3D five-axis nesting partly import-dependent; low direct overseas sales

milestones.headline_en: Bochu launches CloudNest cloud nesting for steel structures
milestones.before_gap_zh: 钢结构多工程套料与协同排产长期依赖桌面版进口套料或手工拆图，缺少与国产激光切割栈深度集成的云化方案
milestones.before_gap_en: Multi-project steel-structure nesting and collaborative scheduling relied on desktop imported nesting or manual takeoff, lacking cloud solutions deeply integrated with domestic laser-cutting stacks
milestones.achievement_zh: 在 CypNest 基础上推出 CloudNest 钢构云套料版本，支持钢结构场景云端套料与多终端协同，延伸国产套料自桌面单机向云部署
milestones.achievement_en: Extended CypNest with CloudNest steel-structure cloud nesting for multi-terminal collaboration, moving domestic nesting from desktop-only toward cloud deployment
milestones.still_missing_zh: 企业级 MES/排产深度仍弱于 Lantek Integra；云方案主要服务柏楚客户群
milestones.still_missing_en: Enterprise MES/scheduling depth still trails Lantek Integra; cloud offering mainly serves Bochu customer base

milestones.headline_en: CAXA begins MEGA Kernel R&D—domestic 3D MCAD beyond pure third-party B-rep licensing
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2000 年代初国产三维 MCAD 几乎全部依赖 Parasolid/ACIS 等进口 B-rep 内核授权，源代码不可控，存在断供与审计风险
milestones.before_gap_en: Early 2000s domestic 3D MCAD almost entirely relied on licensed Parasolid/ACIS B-rep kernels without source control—supply-cut and audit risk
milestones.achievement_zh: 数码大方自 2003 年起研发 MEGA Kernel，后续形成 MEGA / Parasolid / ACIS 可切换多内核架构，支撑 CAXA 2D/3D/CAPP/CAM 产品线
milestones.achievement_en: CAXA started MEGA Kernel R&D in 2003, later forming a switchable MEGA/Parasolid/ACIS multi-kernel stack powering CAXA 2D/3D/CAPP/CAM products
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高端 Class-A 曲面、万零件级装配性能仍落后 CATIA/NX；部分高端场景仍可切换 Parasolid/ACIS
milestones.still_missing_en: Class-A surfacing and 10k+ part assembly performance still trail CATIA/NX; some high-end flows still switch to Parasolid/ACIS

milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic CAD/PLM stacks were largely closed; enterprise customization and MES/ERP integration trailed Teamcenter Open API and other import PLM ecosystems
milestones.achievement_zh: 2026-03-30 发布会同步推出开放 PLM 平台，披露 1000+ API，支撑设计–工艺–制造数据链可编程集成

milestones.headline_zh: CHITUBOX Basic 发布，国产消费级 LCD/DLP 光固化切片替代 Creation Workshop 默认工作流
milestones.headline_en: CHITUBOX Basic launch replaces Creation Workshop as default domestic LCD/DLP resin slicing workflow
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2018 年前国产 LCD 光固化装机普遍捆绑或推荐美国 Creation Workshop/NanoDLP 等海外切片栈，缺少可规模化预置国产机型参数、中文界面与本土商业支持的树脂切片产品
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2018, domestic LCD resin printers largely shipped with or recommended US stacks such as Creation Workshop/NanoDLP; no scalable domestic slicer offered localized presets, Chinese UI, and local commercial support
milestones.achievement_zh: 深圳 CBD-Tech 发布免费 CHITUBOX Basic，与 ELEGOO、Anycubic、Phrozen 等国产光固化机型深度预置，形成「导入—支撑—切片—打印」国产闭环，成为国产消费级光固化事实标准切片器
milestones.achievement_en: Shenzhen CBD-Tech shipped free CHITUBOX Basic with deep presets for ELEGOO, Anycubic, Phrozen and other domestic resin printers, establishing an end-to-end domestic slice-to-print workflow and de-facto standard slicer for consumer MSLA in China
milestones.still_missing_zh: 工业级大批量 Nesting、高级网格布尔与 Magics 级 QA 报告仍依赖海外软件
milestones.still_missing_en: Industrial batch nesting, advanced mesh booleans, and Magics-grade QA reporting still rely on foreign software

milestones.headline_zh: 国产树脂切片器集成一键自动支撑，缩小与 Lychee/PreForm 支撑自动化差距
milestones.headline_en: Domestic resin slicer adds one-click auto support, closing automation gap vs Lychee/PreForm
milestones.before_gap_zh: 树脂件可打印性高度依赖手动布支撑或海外切片器（Lychee Slicer、PreForm）的自动支撑；国产独立切片产品长期缺乏同等成熟度的树状/接触点自动生成
milestones.before_gap_en: Resin printability relied on manual supports or foreign slicers (Lychee Slicer, PreForm) with mature auto-support; standalone domestic slicers lacked comparable tree/contact-point automation
milestones.achievement_zh: CHITUBOX 在 Basic 版集成自动支撑生成、密度与接触点调节，使用户在单一国产 slicer 内完成支撑—切片全流程，无需回退 Creation Workshop 或购买海外 Pro 版
milestones.achievement_en: CHITUBOX Basic integrated auto-support generation with density and contact-point controls, enabling full support-to-slice workflow in one domestic slicer without reverting to Creation Workshop or foreign Pro tiers
milestones.still_missing_zh: 镂空件交叉支撑、可剥离性仿真与工业支撑策略仍弱于 Lychee Premium 与 Materialise Magics
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-support for hollow parts, peel-force simulation, and industrial support strategies still trail Lychee Premium and Materialise Magics

milestones.headline_en: CHITUBOX Pro ships integrated hollowing, drain holes and mesh repair — replaces Meshmixer + foreign slicer combo
milestones.before_gap_zh: 树脂手办/齿科/珠宝镂空与排料孔通常需 Autodesk Meshmixer 或 Materialise Magics 预处理后再导入 PreForm/Creation Workshop 切片
milestones.before_gap_en: Resin hollowing and drain holes for figurines, dental and jewelry typically required Autodesk Meshmixer or Materialise Magics preprocessing before slicing in PreForm/Creation Workshop
milestones.achievement_zh: CHITUBOX Pro 将 hollowing、drain-hole punching 与基础网格修复嵌入切片主流程，国产用户可在单栈完成前处理与切片
milestones.achievement_en: CHITUBOX Pro embedded hollowing, drain-hole punching, and basic mesh repair in the main slice workflow, letting domestic users complete prep and slicing in one stack
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高级布尔、厚壁/抽壳策略与工业校验报告仍落后于 Magics
milestones.still_missing_en: Advanced booleans, thick-wall/hollowing strategies, and industrial validation reports still trail Magics

milestones.headline_en: CHITUBOX Pro multi-model auto layout closes small-batch production packing gap
milestones.before_gap_zh: 多零件自动摆盘与阵列复制是 PreForm、Magics 等海外软件的成熟能力；国产 slicer 长期仅支持手动拖拽
milestones.before_gap_en: Multi-part auto packing and array duplication were mature in foreign software such as PreForm and Magics; domestic slicers long supported only manual drag placement
milestones.achievement_zh: CHITUBOX Pro 提供 build plate 多模型自动布局与复制阵列，面向珠宝、齿科等小批量光固化场景减少人工摆盘
milestones.achievement_en: CHITUBOX Pro added automatic multi-model layout and copy/array on the build plate for jewelry, dental and other small-batch resin production
milestones.still_missing_zh: 大型工业件 3D Nesting、碰撞优化与 MES 联动仍远弱于 Magics
milestones.still_missing_en: Large-part 3D nesting, collision optimization, and MES integration remain far weaker than Magics

milestones.before_gap_en: Early domestic resin printers used fragmented .photon/.cbddlp formats; slice exchange was dominated by foreign private formats from Creation Workshop/PreForm
milestones.achievement_zh: CHITUBOX 推动 CTB（后 CTBv4 加密）成为 ELEGOO、Anycubic 等主流国产机型默认输出，海外 Lychee 等竞品反向增加 CTB 导出以兼容中国硬件
milestones.achievement_en: CHITUBOX drove CTB (later encrypted CTBv4) as default output for mainstream domestic brands such as ELEGOO and Anycubic; foreign competitors like Lychee added CTB export to interoperate with Chinese hardware
milestones.still_missing_zh: 开放 documented SDK、云协同 API 仍弱于 Oqton/GrabCAD 类工业平台
milestones.still_missing_en: Open documented SDK and cloud collaboration APIs remain weaker than industrial platforms such as Oqton/GrabCAD

milestones.before_gap_en: Mass-customization shop-floor execution and order-to-line coordination in appliances relied on Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk, SAP ME, and foreign system integrators
milestones.achievement_zh: 海尔正式发布COSMOPlat工业互联网平台，将互联工厂中验证的C2M执行与排产能力产品化，成为日后外溢品牌'天智工'MES的内核来源

milestones.still_missing_en: 2017 was primarily platform launch and Haier-internal connected-factory proof; the Tianzhigong external brand and cross-industry routing packs matured later

milestones.headline_en: Haier COSMOPlat named in MIIT's first dual-cross industrial internet platform cohort
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2019年前，大型制造企业跨工厂、跨品类的工业云底座与数据中台采购多指向西门子 MindSphere、GE Predix、PTC ThingWorx 等外资工业互联网平台或重度定制集成
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2019, enterprise cross-plant industrial cloud foundations were procured mainly from Siemens MindSphere, GE Predix, PTC ThingWorx, or heavy custom integration
milestones.achievement_zh: 工信部公布首批5家「双跨」工业互联网平台，海尔卡奥斯与阿里云、富士康、徐工汉云、树根互联并列入选，国产工业互联网平台首次进入国家级跨行业基础设施白名单
milestones.achievement_en: MIIT listed five first-batch dual-cross platforms; Haier COSMOPlat joined Alibaba, FII, HANYUN, and RootCloud, placing a domestic IIoT platform on the national cross-industry infrastructure whitelist
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全球应用商店生态、多区域合规云运营与外资全栈数字化线程（PLM/MES/ERP）深度互操作仍弱于 MindSphere/ThingWorx
milestones.still_missing_en: Global app-store ecosystem, multi-region compliant cloud ops, and deep interoperability with foreign PLM/MES/ERP digital threads still trail MindSphere/ThingWorx

milestones.headline_en: Haier Qingdao central-AC connected factory on COSMOPlat joins WEF Global Lighthouse Network

milestones.before_gap_en: Order-driven scheduling, design-to-manufacturing coordination, and shop-floor execution in benchmark appliance lines were long referenced against Siemens, SAP, and Rockwell import MES/digital suites
milestones.achievement_zh: 世界经济论坛认定该厂以卡奥斯实现用户参与的大规模定制与端到端柔性制造，其产线级执行调度由国产平台承载，构成天智工类MES能力的国际标杆验证
milestones.achievement_en: WEF recognized the plant for COSMOPlat-powered user-involved mass customization and end-to-end flexible manufacturing, with shop-floor execution scheduling on a domestic platform—international proof of Tianzhigong-class MES capability
milestones.still_missing_zh: 灯塔认定集中于海尔自有标杆产线；外向型客户在高复杂度核企级多工厂排产与异构ERP深度耦合方面仍弱于进口MES
milestones.still_missing_en: Lighthouse proof is concentrated in Haier-owned benchmark lines; external customers still trail import MES on complex enterprise multi-plant scheduling and heterogeneous ERP coupling

milestones.headline_zh: 海澜之家与海尔签署战略合作，服装行业导入卡奥斯大规模定制智造平台
milestones.headline_en: HLA signs strategic pact with Haier to deploy COSMOPlat mass-customization platform in apparel
milestones.before_gap_zh: 服装行业订单排产、尺码版型协同与车间执行多依赖进口ERP加外资MES或手工台账，缺少可复制的国产大规模定制执行系统
milestones.before_gap_en: Apparel order scheduling, size/pattern coordination, and shop-floor execution often relied on import ERP plus foreign MES or manual ledgers, without a replicable domestic mass-customization execution stack
milestones.achievement_zh: 海澜之家公告与海尔集团签署战略合作框架协议，引入卡奥斯平台开展服装大规模定制与智能制造协同，标志天智工类MES能力首次规模化外溢至非家电行业
milestones.achievement_en: HLA disclosed a strategic cooperation framework with Haier Group to adopt COSMOPlat for apparel mass customization and smart manufacturing—first large-scale export of Tianzhigong-class MES beyond Haier's appliance base
milestones.still_missing_zh: 服装行业工艺路线与尺码矩阵复杂度高于单一家电品类；平台在缝制设备层仍依赖外资专机生态
milestones.still_missing_en: Apparel routing and size-matrix complexity exceed single-category appliances; the platform still depends on foreign specialized sewing-equipment ecosystems at the machine layer

milestones.before_gap_zh: 专用车/房车小批量多品种产线的工单追溯、过程质检与订单协同长期依赖进口MES或人工报工加Excel，缺少国产可交付方案
milestones.before_gap_en: Specialty RV low-volume/high-mix lines relied on import MES or manual reporting plus spreadsheets for work-order traceability and in-process QC, with few deliverable domestic alternatives
milestones.achievement_zh: 威海康派斯与卡奥斯合作建设旅居车大规模定制智联工厂，以天智工类执行系统打通订单、工序、质检与交付追溯，成为卡奥斯MES外拓装备制造业的公开案例
milestones.achievement_en: Weihai Coachman partnered with COSMOPlat to build a connected RV mass-customization plant; Tianzhigong-class execution linked orders, operations, QC, and delivery traceability—a published COSMOPlat MES export case in equipment manufacturing
milestones.still_missing_zh: 房车行业单厂规模有限；复杂总装线高级排程、与外资焊装/涂装专机深度联机仍不如成熟进口MES
milestones.still_missing_en: RV plants are limited in scale; advanced final-assembly scheduling and deep coupling with foreign welding/painting OEM cells still trail mature import MES

milestones.headline_zh: 创想三维发布自有品牌 Creality Slicer（Ultimaker Cura 分支），成为全系 FDM 官方默认切片工作流
milestones.headline_en: Creality ships branded Creality Slicer (Ultimaker Cura fork) as the official default slicing workflow for its full FDM lineup
milestones.before_gap_zh: 创想三维连续多年位居全球消费级 FDM 出货量前列，但用户出厂后仍需自行下载国外 Ultimaker Cura 并手动导入社区机型配置，缺少中文界面、本土售后文档与官方预置工艺的一体化国产 slicer
milestones.before_gap_en: Despite leading global consumer FDM shipments, Creality users still had to download foreign Ultimaker Cura and manually import community machine profiles—no integrated domestic slicer with Chinese UI, local support docs, and official presets
milestones.achievement_zh: 创想发布基于 Cura 引擎的 Creality Slicer，预置 Ender/CR 全系参数包与中文界面，随整机装机量规模化替代「通用 Cura + 手动配置」路径，成为国产消费级 FDM 装机量最大品牌的事实标准切片器
milestones.achievement_en: Creality released Cura-engine-based Creality Slicer with preloaded Ender/CR profiles and Chinese UI, scaling with printer shipments to replace the generic Cura + manual-profile path as the de-facto slicer for the world's largest consumer FDM install base
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高级变层厚、有机树支撑与开源插件生态仍弱于 PrusaSlicer；跨品牌打印机兼容性有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Adaptive layers, organic tree supports, and open plugin ecosystem still trail PrusaSlicer; limited cross-brand printer compatibility

milestones.headline_en: ChiNext IPO prospectus discloses proprietary slicer as core ecosystem asset, establishing domestic substitution path vs foreign general-purpose slicers in education and government
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国内学校、创客空间与政府采购 3D 打印实训设备时，软件栈长期依赖 Ultimaker Cura 等国外通用切片器，缺少与国产整机深度绑定、可本地化交付的官方 slicer 产品叙事
milestones.before_gap_en: Schools, makerspaces, and government 3D-printing procurements relied on foreign general slicers like Ultimaker Cura, lacking an officially bundled domestic slicer narrative tightly coupled to Chinese hardware
milestones.achievement_zh: 创想三维（300866.SZ）在创业板招股说明书中将切片软件列为自主研发与整机配套的核心能力，随上市披露形成「国产硬件 + 国产 slicer」闭环，支撑教育市场大规模装机后的本土化软件交付
milestones.achievement_en: Creality (300866.SZ) listed on ChiNext with its prospectus positioning slicing software as a core self-developed companion to printers, formalizing a domestic hardware-plus-slicer closed loop for large-scale education deployments
milestones.still_missing_zh: 招股文件未将切片算法定位为工业级数据准备（修复/排版/仿真）替代；高端工艺仍对标国际开源与工业软件
milestones.still_missing_en: Prospectus does not position slicing as industrial data-prep (repair/nesting/simulation) substitution; advanced process libraries still benchmark against international open-source and industrial tools

milestones.headline_zh: Creality Cloud 与 Creality Print 联动，实现切片—队列—手机远程监控的国产官方云闭环
milestones.headline_en: Creality Cloud links with Creality Print for an official domestic slice-to-queue-to-mobile remote-monitoring cloud loop
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产 Wi-Fi 打印机远程管理此前主要依赖 OctoPrint 插件生态或 Ultimaker Digital Factory、Prusa Connect 等国际云方案，缺少与创想全系机型深度预置的官方国产云切片运维栈
milestones.before_gap_en: Remote management for domestic Wi-Fi printers mainly relied on OctoPrint plugins or international clouds (Ultimaker Digital Factory, Prusa Connect), lacking an official Chinese cloud slice-and-ops stack pre-integrated across Creality machines
milestones.achievement_zh: 随 CR-6 SE 等 Wi-Fi 机型上市，Creality Cloud 移动端与 Creality Print 账号体系打通，支持远程发起打印、进度查看与多机状态管理，形成国产 slicer 少有的官方云原生运维路径
milestones.achievement_en: With Wi-Fi models such as CR-6 SE, Creality Cloud mobile app integrated with Creality Print accounts for remote print start, progress viewing, and multi-printer status—an uncommon official cloud-native ops path for a domestic slicer
milestones.still_missing_zh: 企业级多站点权限、审计与 MES/ERP 对接弱于工业软件；私有化部署与数据驻留选项有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Enterprise multi-site RBAC, audit trails, and MES/ERP integration remain weak vs industrial software; limited private-cloud and data-residency options

milestones.headline_zh: Creality Slicer 统一更名为 Creality Print 并整合 Halot 光固化切片，FDM 与 LCD 树脂在同一国产 slicer 闭环
milestones.headline_en: Creality Slicer rebranded to Creality Print with integrated Halot resin slicing—FDM and LCD resin in one domestic slicer loop
milestones.before_gap_zh: 创想 Halot 光固化用户需额外安装 ChiTuBox、Creation Workshop 等第三方切片器；FDM 与树脂工艺分散在不同软件栈，无法形成品牌级统一国产工作流
milestones.before_gap_en: Creality Halot resin users needed separate third-party slicers (ChiTuBox, Creation Workshop); FDM and resin workflows were split across stacks with no unified domestic brand workflow
milestones.achievement_zh: 创想将官方 slicer 品牌统一为 Creality Print，在 4.x 系列中内置 Halot 光固化机型预置、支撑与切片参数，使用户在单一国产官方工具内完成树脂 slice-to-print，减少对海外树脂 slicer 的默认依赖
milestones.achievement_en: Creality unified its official slicer brand as Creality Print 4.x, adding built-in Halot resin presets, supports, and slice parameters so users complete resin slice-to-print in one official domestic tool, reducing default reliance on foreign resin slicers
milestones.still_missing_zh: 树脂镂空、交叉支撑与齿科插件仍弱于 CHITUBOX Pro、Lychee Premium；工业级 Nesting 仍依赖 Materialise Magics
milestones.still_missing_en: Resin hollowing, cross-support, and dental plugins still trail CHITUBOX Pro and Lychee Premium; industrial nesting still relies on Materialise Magics

milestones.headline_zh: Creality Print 随 K1 系列发布配套高速 CoreXY 工艺预设，国产 slicer 进入 600 mm/s 级消费级高速 FDM 工艺链
milestones.headline_en: Creality Print ships K1-series high-speed CoreXY profiles, bringing a domestic slicer into 600 mm/s-class consumer high-speed FDM workflows
milestones.before_gap_zh: 500–600 mm/s 级 CoreXY 高速打印的运动学优化、振动补偿与压力提前量校准此前主要由 PrusaSlicer、Klipper 等国际开源栈或国外整机厂商私有配置主导，国产 slicer 普遍停留在传统 Cartesian 低速预设
milestones.before_gap_en: 500–600 mm/s CoreXY motion tuning, vibration compensation, and pressure advance were dominated by international stacks (PrusaSlicer, Klipper) or foreign OEM closed profiles; domestic slicers mostly offered low-speed Cartesian presets
milestones.achievement_zh: 2023 年 6 月 K1/K1 Max 上市时，Creality Print 同步发布高速预设、加速度与挤出同步策略，与创想自研运动控制固件对齐，使国产官方 slicer 在消费级高速 FDM 工艺链上具备与 PrusaSlicer/Klipper 对标的可交付能力
milestones.achievement_en: At the June 2023 K1/K1 Max launch, Creality Print released matched high-speed presets, acceleration, and extrusion-sync strategies aligned with Creality motion firmware—giving the official domestic slicer deliverable consumer high-speed FDM capability comparable to PrusaSlicer/Klipper stacks
milestones.still_missing_zh: 开源社区可深度调校的运动学参数与插件生态仍弱于 PrusaSlicer+Klipper；多色 CFS 编排成熟度滞后于 Bambu Studio+AMS
milestones.still_missing_en: Deep community-tunable kinematics and plugin ecosystem still trail PrusaSlicer+Klipper; multi-color CFS orchestration maturity lags Bambu Studio+AMS

milestones.before_gap_en: Automotive and consumer-electronics Class-A surfacing and industrial styling were dominated by foreign CAID tools such as Autodesk Alias, ICEM Surf, and CATIA ICEM; domestic vendors lacked a production-grade cloud-native styling tool

milestones.still_missing_zh: OEM 量产车型公开案例仍少于 Alias/ICEM；A 级曲面工程交接与 PLM 深度集成待验证
milestones.still_missing_en: Fewer public OEM production vehicle references than Alias/ICEM; Class-A engineering handoff and deep PLM integration remain unproven

milestones.headline_zh: CrownStyling 上线：国产首款云原生工业造型平台
milestones.headline_en: CrownStyling GA: first domestic cloud-native industrial styling platform
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产三维 CAD 虽有 CrownCAD 等云 MCAD，但无浏览器端云原生工业造型（CAID）工作流；汽车造型仍依赖外资桌面 Alias/ICEM
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic 3D CAD had cloud MCAD (CrownCAD) but no browser-based cloud-native industrial styling (CAID) workflow; automotive styling still depended on foreign desktop Alias/ICEM stacks
milestones.achievement_zh: CrownStyling 以 CrownCAD DGM 几何栈为基础，以 SaaS 形态提供云原生 NURBS/SubD 造型、协同浏览（SView）与 CrownCAD 工程数据衔接
milestones.achievement_en: CrownStyling builds on CrownCAD DGM as SaaS cloud-native NURBS/SubD styling with SView collaboration and engineering handoff into CrownCAD
milestones.still_missing_zh: 离线大模型性能、企业级权限审计与插件生态仍弱于成熟国际云/桌面 CAID 栈
milestones.still_missing_en: Offline large-model performance, enterprise governance, and plugin ecosystem still trail mature international cloud/desktop CAID stacks

sources.title: CrownStyling launch news (站长之家)
CrownCAD official platform

milestones.headline_zh: 自研 DCS 几何约束求解器随 CrownCAD 落地
milestones.headline_en: Owned DCS geometric constraint solver ships with CrownCAD
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产 CAD 参数化约束求解长期依赖 D-Cubed 等国外组件或嵌入在国外内核授权栈中，缺少可随自主云几何引擎一起交付的国产约束求解器
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic CAD parametric constraint solving relied on foreign components such as D-Cubed or foreign kernel license stacks, without an owned solver co-delivered with a domestic cloud geometry engine
milestones.achievement_zh: CrownCAD 公测同步发布 DCS（Dimensional Constraint Solver）几何约束求解器，与自研 DGM 内核配套，支撑云端正向参数化建模
milestones.achievement_en: CrownCAD public beta released the DCS (Dimensional Constraint Solver) geometric constraint solver alongside the owned DGM kernel, enabling cloud-native parametric modeling
milestones.still_missing_zh: 复杂装配约束、高级设计表与方程式驱动能力成熟度仍待大客户量产验证
milestones.still_missing_en: Complex assembly constraints, advanced design tables, and equation-driven design maturity remain to be proven in large-account production use

sources.title: CrownCAD DGM+DCS 自主云 CAD 发布
机械工程学报：国产几何内核综述（DGM）

milestones.headline_zh: CrownCAD 浏览器端多人实时协同设计上线
milestones.headline_en: CrownCAD ships browser-based multi-user real-time collaborative design
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产研发设计协同长期依赖 Teamcenter/3DEXPERIENCE 或 HOOPS 轻量化看图方案，缺少与自主三维建模内核一体的在线协同 CAD
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic R&D collaboration relied on Teamcenter/3DEXPERIENCE or HOOPS-based lightweight viewers, without an owned online collaborative CAD tied to a domestic modeling kernel
milestones.achievement_zh: CrownCAD 2020 公测将自研 DGM 建模与版本管理结合，支持多用户在线协同编辑零件与装配，填补国产云协同 MCAD 空白
milestones.achievement_en: The 2020 CrownCAD beta combined owned DGM modeling with versioning for multi-user online co-editing of parts and assemblies, closing a gap in domestic cloud collaborative MCAD
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨企业供应链协同 API、与主流 PLM 深度联邦仍弱于 Onshape/PTC Cloud
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-enterprise supply-chain collaboration APIs and deep federation with mainstream PLM still trail Onshape/PTC Cloud

sources.title: CrownCAD DGM+DCS 自主云 CAD 发布
CrownCAD

milestones.headline_zh: 中建「建造宝」在全集团施工项目规模化上线，替代进口现场管理工具链
milestones.headline_en: CSCEC 'Jianzaobao' mobile platform scaled across group projects, displacing imported field-management stacks
milestones.before_gap_zh: 大型承包商项目现场质量、安全、劳务、物料等数据采集长期依赖进口项目管理/现场协同软件或碎片化自建系统，数据难以上收至集团层
milestones.before_gap_en: Mega-contractor site QA, safety, labor, and materials capture relied on imported PM/field-collaboration suites or fragmented custom systems with poor group-level rollup
milestones.achievement_zh: 中建电商在中建集团数字化峰会上发布移动端「建造宝」，将现场检查、劳务实名制、物料验收等施工全要素采集统一到国产移动平台，并在中建系统内快速推广
milestones.achievement_en: CSCEC E-Commerce launched mobile 'Jianzaobao' at the group's digital summit, unifying site inspections, labor real-name registration, and material acceptance on a domestic mobile stack and rolling it out across CSCEC projects
milestones.still_missing_zh: 平台以施工数据采集与过程管理为主，不替代 Revit/TEKLA 等外资 BIM 建模内核；对外商业化与第三方总包渗透率有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Platform focuses on site data capture and process control, not Revit/TEKLA-class authoring kernels; limited external commercialization beyond the CSCEC ecosystem

metrics.value: 2019 集团发布后在内部项目快速铺开

sources.title: 云筑网（中建电商）— 建造宝/智慧工地产品入口

milestones.headline_zh: 中建八局「智慧工地」平台实现塔吊/环境/视频等 OT 数据汇聚，替代外资智慧工地方案
milestones.headline_en: CSCEC 8th Bureau smart-site platform aggregates crane/env/video OT data, displacing foreign smart-construction offerings
milestones.before_gap_zh: 智慧工地物联网数据（塔吊、扬尘、视频监控、人员定位）多采用外资楼宇/工业物联网套件或项目级孤立硬件，难以在中建体系内标准化复制
milestones.before_gap_en: Smart-site IoT (tower cranes, dust monitoring, CCTV, personnel tracking) relied on foreign building/industrial IoT suites or isolated project hardware, hard to standardize across CSCEC
milestones.achievement_zh: 中建八局上线自主「智慧工地」云平台，将塔机监测、环境监测、视频监控、劳务实名制等现场传感器数据统一接入国产云侧平台，并在八局承建项目中规模化复用
milestones.achievement_en: CSCEC 8th Bureau shipped its own smart-site cloud, ingesting tower-crane, environmental, video, and labor IoT feeds into a domestic cloud platform reused at scale on 8th Bureau projects
milestones.still_missing_zh: 边缘协议网关与高端楼宇自控仍部分依赖进口器件/软件；平台深度绑定八局体系，集团级统一标准晚于子公司先行
milestones.still_missing_en: Edge protocol gateways and high-end BMS layers still partly import-dependent; platform originated in 8th Bureau before full group-wide standardization

metrics.value: 八局体系内数百个项目级智慧工地复制

sources.title: 中国建筑股份有限公司2020年年度报告
中国建筑官网 — 智能建造/数字产业专题

milestones.headline_zh: 中建三局「星璇」智能建造平台在超高层项目落地，国产替代外资进度—模型联动方案
milestones.headline_en: CSCEC 3rd Bureau 'Xingxuan' intelligent construction platform deployed on super-tall projects, domestic substitute for foreign schedule–model linkage
milestones.before_gap_zh: 超高层施工进度模拟与装备调度长期依赖 Primavera/Synchro 等外资计划工具叠加国外装备控制软件，难以与国产 BIM 交付链闭环
milestones.before_gap_en: Super-tall schedule simulation and equipment dispatch relied on Primavera/Synchro-class foreign planners plus imported equipment-control stacks, poorly closed with domestic BIM delivery chains
milestones.achievement_zh: 中建三局发布并投运「星璇」智能建造平台，将 BIM、进度计划、塔吊/布料机等装备调度联动，在武汉绿地中心等一批超高层项目形成可复制的国产智能建造闭环
milestones.achievement_en: CSCEC 3rd Bureau released 'Xingxuan', linking BIM, schedules, and tower-crane/placing-equipment dispatch into a replicable domestic intelligent-construction loop on super-tall projects including Wuhan Greenland Center
milestones.still_missing_zh: 通用型施工企业级计划引擎深度仍不及 Primavera P6 全球生态；装备调度场景偏超高层/重点工程
milestones.still_missing_en: General enterprise scheduling depth still trails the global Primavera P6 ecosystem; equipment orchestration skews to super-tall flagship jobs

metrics.value: 武汉绿地中心等超高层标杆项目

milestones.headline_zh: 中建「数字建造」一体化平台与「中建通」协同体系覆盖全集团项目交付链
milestones.headline_en: CSCEC integrated 'Digital Construction' stack and 'CSCEC Connect' collaboration cover the group project-delivery chain
milestones.before_gap_zh: 集团级工程项目协同、文件流转与移动端办公长期依赖 Microsoft/Oracle 生态或分散采购的国外协作套件
milestones.before_gap_en: Group-wide project collaboration, document routing, and mobile office relied on Microsoft/Oracle ecosystems or ad hoc foreign collaboration suites
milestones.achievement_zh: 中国建筑首届数字化发展高峰论坛发布「十四五」数字化蓝图并展示数字建造一体化能力；同期「中建通」在集团内形成国产移动协同底座，与 BIM、智慧工地模块联动
milestones.achievement_en: At its first Digital Development Summit, CSCEC unveiled the 14th Five-Year digital blueprint and integrated digital-construction capabilities; 'CSCEC Connect' became the domestic mobile collaboration backbone linked to BIM and smart-site modules
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨企业供应链协同仍大量依托云筑网等场景平台；国际项目多方协作接口与外资业主常用系统互操作性不足
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-enterprise supply-chain collaboration still leans on YZW-style platforms; interoperability with foreign owner systems on international jobs remains weak

metrics.value: 中建通在中建全系统员工与项目组织推广

sources.title: 中国建筑官网 — 智能建造/数字产业专题
中国建筑股份有限公司2020年年度报告

milestones.headline_zh: 鼎捷发布新一代离散制造 ERP 平台 T100
milestones.headline_en: Digiwin launches T100 next-generation discrete-manufacturing ERP platform
milestones.before_gap_zh: 两岸电子、机械及汽配中端制造企业的 BOM/MRP/生产计划长期由 SAP Business One、Oracle JD Edwards 或鼎捷旧版 Workflow 分散承载，缺少统一云化制造数据模型
milestones.before_gap_en: Mid-market electronics, machinery and auto-parts makers in Greater China relied on SAP Business One, Oracle JD Edwards or legacy Digiwin Workflow for BOM/MRP/production planning without a unified cloud manufacturing data model
milestones.achievement_zh: 鼎捷在 2013 年伙伴大会上正式发布 T100，以统一制造主数据、BOM 多阶展算、MRP 与生产工单为核心，定位替代外资中端制造 ERP 的自主平台
milestones.achievement_en: At its 2013 partner summit Digiwin officially released T100 with unified manufacturing master data, multi-level BOM explosion, MRP and shop orders—positioned as a domestic platform replacing foreign mid-market manufacturing ERP
milestones.still_missing_zh: 超大型集团多法人合并、全球共享服务中心与复杂 intercompany 核算仍弱于 SAP S/4HANA；高端客户标杆数量少于 SAP/Oracle
milestones.still_missing_en: Multi-entity group consolidation, global shared services and complex intercompany accounting remain weaker than SAP S/4HANA; fewer tier-1 reference wins than SAP/Oracle

sources.title: Digiwin T100 企业智能云平台

milestones.headline_zh: 鼎捷软件创业板上市，招股说明书将 T100 列为对标 SAP/Oracle 的自主 ERP 战略产品
milestones.headline_en: Digiwin ChiNext IPO prospectus positions T100 as domestic ERP strategy vs SAP/Oracle
milestones.before_gap_zh: 招股说明书披露，当时中国制造业经营管理软件市场仍由 SAP、Oracle、微软等外资品牌主导，本土厂商在高端集团财务与复杂制造一体化场景缺乏资本市场认可的规模化替代案例
milestones.before_gap_en: The IPO prospectus stated China's manufacturing management software market was still led by SAP, Oracle and Microsoft, with domestic vendors lacking capital-market-validated large-scale replacement cases for group finance plus complex manufacturing integration
milestones.achievement_zh: 鼎捷软件（300378.SZ）于 2014 年 1 月披露招股说明书并登陆创业板，明确 T100 为云时代核心产品线，覆盖财务总账、应收应付、成本核算与制造业务一体化，作为国产制造 ERP 替代外资方案的主打平台
milestones.achievement_en: Digiwin Software (300378.SZ) filed its ChiNext IPO prospectus in January 2014 and listed on ChiNext, naming T100 as its cloud-era core line covering GL, AR/AP, costing and integrated manufacturing as the flagship domestic manufacturing-ERP alternative to foreign suites
milestones.still_missing_zh: 招股书亦提示外资品牌仍占据高端市场份额；全球化多币种合并、跨国税务与大型央企集团管控深度不及 SAP/Oracle
milestones.still_missing_en: The prospectus also noted foreign brands still held high-end share; global multi-currency consolidation, cross-border tax and large SOE group governance depth trailed SAP/Oracle

sources.title: 鼎捷软件首次公开发行股票并在创业板上市招股说明书

milestones.headline_zh: 鼎捷发布 Athena 工业互联网平台，T100 全面云化部署
milestones.headline_en: Digiwin ships Athena industrial-internet platform with full T100 cloud deployment
milestones.before_gap_zh: 制造企业中端云 ERP 长期由 Oracle NetSuite、SAP Business ByDesign/S/4HANA Cloud 及微软 Dynamics 365 主导，本土厂商缺少可订阅、可运维的制造云 ERP 量产平台
milestones.before_gap_en: Mid-market cloud manufacturing ERP was dominated by Oracle NetSuite, SAP Business ByDesign/S/4HANA Cloud and Microsoft Dynamics 365; domestic vendors lacked a production-grade subscription manufacturing cloud ERP platform
milestones.achievement_zh: 2018 年鼎捷用户大会发布 Athena 智慧企业云平台，T100 以云原生多租户架构上线，支持订阅制交付与工业互联网数据连接，形成对外资云 ERP 的国产制造云替代路径
milestones.achievement_en: At the 2018 Digiwin user conference the company launched the Athena smart-enterprise cloud platform with T100 on a cloud-native multi-tenant architecture, subscription delivery and industrial-internet connectivity—establishing a domestic cloud manufacturing-ERP alternative to foreign suites
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全球化多区域数据中心、与海外总部 SAP 实例的双向集成及 ISV 生态规模仍落后于 NetSuite/SAP Cloud
milestones.still_missing_en: Global multi-region data centers, bidirectional integration with overseas HQ SAP instances and ISV ecosystem scale still trail NetSuite/SAP Cloud

sources.title: 鼎捷 Athena 智慧企业云平台

milestones.headline_zh: 鼎捷与华为达成全面合作，T100 入驻鲲鹏生态并完成信创栈适配
milestones.headline_en: Digiwin–Huawei strategic pact puts T100 on Kunpeng ecosystem with IT-innovation stack adaptation
milestones.before_gap_zh: 制造 ERP 典型部署长期绑定 x86 服务器、Linux/Windows 操作系统与 Oracle/SQL Server 数据库，信创政策推动下缺少经鲲鹏+国产 OS+国产数据库验证的量产 ERP 栈
milestones.before_gap_en: Manufacturing ERP deployments were typically bound to x86 servers, Linux/Windows and Oracle/SQL Server databases; under China's IT-innovation push there was little production-proven ERP stack validated on Kunpeng + domestic OS + domestic databases
milestones.achievement_zh: 2021 年鼎捷与华为签署全面合作协议，T100 完成鲲鹏处理器、欧拉操作系统及华为云上的兼容验证与联合方案发布，可在全国产软硬件栈上替代原先 Oracle 数据库+外资 OS 的 ERP 部署模式
milestones.achievement_en: In 2021 Digiwin signed a comprehensive cooperation agreement with Huawei; T100 completed compatibility validation on Kunpeng CPUs, EulerOS and Huawei Cloud with joint solution releases, enabling ERP deployment on an all-domestic hardware/software stack replacing prior Oracle DB + foreign-OS patterns
milestones.still_missing_zh: 超大规模集团级高可用集群、与 SAP 存量系统的在线双轨迁移工具链及海外分支机构合规部署经验仍有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Hyperscale group HA clusters, online dual-run migration toolchains from SAP estates and overseas branch compliance deployments remain limited

sources.title: 鼎捷软件与华为签署全面合作协议

milestones.headline_zh: 鼎捷 T100 与达梦 DM8 完成兼容互认证，ERP 生产排程可运行于国产数据库
milestones.headline_en: Digiwin T100 completes DM8 compatibility certification—production scheduling ERP runs on domestic database
milestones.before_gap_zh: 离散制造 ERP 的生产排程、工单与在制品数据层普遍依赖 Oracle 或 SQL Server 数据库，信创环境下缺少经互认证、可量产的国产数据库后端方案
milestones.before_gap_en: Discrete-manufacturing ERP production scheduling, work-order and WIP data layers commonly relied on Oracle or SQL Server; no mutually certified, production-ready domestic-database backend existed for IT-innovation environments
milestones.achievement_zh: 鼎捷 T100 与达梦数据库 DM8 完成产品兼容性互认证，生产计划、工单排程与车间执行数据可稳定运行于国产数据库，为制造企业在信创替换中替代 Oracle 数据库承载 ERP 提供可交付路径
milestones.achievement_en: Digiwin T100 completed product compatibility mutual certification with Dameng DM8 so production planning, work-order scheduling and shop-floor execution data run stably on a domestic database—providing a deliverable path to replace Oracle Database as the ERP backend in IT-innovation migrations
milestones.still_missing_zh: 超大规模并发排程性能调优、与外资 MES/APS 的深度实时集成及多工厂全球排程优化仍弱于 SAP PP/DS 成熟组合
milestones.still_missing_en: Hyperscale concurrent scheduling performance tuning, deep real-time integration with foreign MES/APS and global multi-plant scheduling optimization remain weaker than mature SAP PP/DS combinations

sources.title: 达梦数据库与鼎捷软件产品兼容性互认证证书

milestones.headline_zh: ALPS 获 ISO 26262 TCL3 / IEC 61508 T2 车规功能安全认证
milestones.headline_en: ALPS achieves ISO 26262 TCL3 / IEC 61508 T2 automotive functional-safety certification
milestones.before_gap_zh: ASIL-D 车规芯片设计所需的工具级功能安全（TCL）认证长期由进口 Synopsys/Cadence 仿真工具独占，国产 SPICE 无同等资质
milestones.before_gap_en: Tool-level functional-safety (TCL) certification for ASIL-D automotive IC design was limited to imported Synopsys/Cadence simulators; no domestic SPICE held equivalent credentials
milestones.achievement_zh: ALPS 获 ISO 26262 TCL3 与 IEC 61508 T2 认证，可支撑 ASIL-D 级车规芯片晶体管级电路仿真签核
milestones.achievement_en: ALPS certified to ISO 26262 TCL3 and IEC 61508 T2, enabling transistor-level circuit simulation signoff for ASIL-D automotive IC flows
milestones.still_missing_zh: 车规全流程（数字/模拟协同安全验证、完整 ISO 26262 工具链）仍不完整
milestones.still_missing_en: Full automotive flow (mixed-signal safety co-verification, complete ISO 26262 tool chain) remains incomplete

sources.title: 华大九天2024年半年度报告

milestones.headline_zh: 招股说明书披露 Argus 物理验证进入多家 Foundry 商业化应用
milestones.headline_en: IPO prospectus documents Argus PV in commercial use at multiple foundries
milestones.before_gap_zh: 数字芯片流片 DRC/LVS 签核长期由 Calibre、IC Validator 等进口工具垄断，国产工具难以进入晶圆厂参考流程
milestones.before_gap_en: Digital tape-out DRC/LVS signoff was dominated by imported Calibre and IC Validator; domestic tools rarely entered foundry reference flows
milestones.achievement_zh: 深交所招股说明书披露：物理验证工具 Argus 已在三星、中芯国际等多家国内外晶圆制造企业实现商业化应用，成为可替代进口方案的国产物理签核工具
milestones.achievement_en: SZSE IPO prospectus states Argus physical verification was commercially deployed at Samsung, SMIC, and other domestic and global foundries as a domestic signoff alternative to imported tools
milestones.still_missing_zh: 同期布局布线仍处产业化推广早期；先进节点签核与全流程数字实现仍弱于 Synopsys/Cadence
milestones.still_missing_en: Place-and-route was still in early commercial rollout; advanced-node signoff and full digital implementation still lagged Synopsys/Cadence

sources.title: 华大九天首次公开发行股票并在创业板上市招股说明书

milestones.headline_zh: EMQX 公开验证单集群 1 亿并发 MQTT 连接，达到当时全球 MQTT broker 规模纪录
milestones.headline_en: EMQX publicly benchmarks 100M concurrent MQTT connections on one cluster — then a world-record scale for MQTT brokers
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2018 年前中国大型车联网/运营商物联网接入普遍依赖 HiveMQ、IBM MessageSight、AWS IoT Core 等国外商业 MQTT/云接入栈，国产侧缺少经第三方公开压测、可对标国际厂商的亿级并发消息接入平台
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2018, large Chinese telematics and carrier IoT ingress relied on foreign commercial MQTT/cloud stacks (HiveMQ, IBM MessageSight, AWS IoT Core); no domestically controlled platform had published third-party-scale benchmarks at 100M-connection class
milestones.achievement_zh: 映云科技（EMQ）在 EMQX 3.x 上完成并公布 1 亿并发 MQTT 连接集群压测（基于 Erlang/OTP 分布式架构），证明国产开源 MQTT broker 在接入规模上可与国际头部产品同台对标
milestones.achievement_en: EMQ (Yingyun) completed and published a 100-million concurrent MQTT connection cluster benchmark on EMQX 3.x (Erlang/OTP distributed architecture), demonstrating a domestically controlled open-source MQTT broker could match international leaders on ingress scale
milestones.still_missing_zh: 欧美企业级直销渠道、合规认证生态与 HiveMQ/AWS 仍有差距；超大规模场景运维工具链与托管云成熟度落后
milestones.still_missing_en: US/EU enterprise direct sales, compliance ecosystem still trail HiveMQ/AWS; ops tooling and managed-cloud maturity lag at hyperscale

sources.title: EMQX sets new record for 100 million MQTT connections

milestones.headline_zh: EMQX Neuron 发布：国产多协议工业网关软件，将 Modbus/OPC UA/S7 等 OT 数据统一接入 MQTT
milestones.headline_en: EMQX Neuron ships: domestic multi-protocol industrial gateway software unifying Modbus/OPC UA/S7 OT data into MQTT
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2022 年前中国产线/能源现场数采与协议转换长期由 Kepware KEPServerEX、Matrikon OPC、Ignition MQTT 模块等国外闭源网关主导，国产方案多为项目定制驱动，缺少与 MQTT 平台一体化的可产品化多协议网关
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2022, Chinese plant/energy OT acquisition and protocol conversion was dominated by foreign closed gateways (Kepware KEPServerEX, Matrikon OPC, Ignition MQTT modules); domestic options were mostly bespoke drivers without a productized multi-protocol gateway integrated with an MQTT platform
milestones.achievement_zh: 映云科技发布 EMQX Neuron 工业连接网关（插件化南向驱动 + 北向 MQTT/Sparkplug），在单一国产软件栈内实现 PLC/仪表多协议采集并对接 EMQX，形成可替代国外 OPC/Modbus 网关的国产 OT 接入层
milestones.achievement_en: EMQ released EMQX Neuron industrial connectivity gateway (plugin southbound drivers + northbound MQTT/Sparkplug), enabling multi-protocol PLC/instrument acquisition in one domestic software stack feeding EMQX — a substitutable domestic OT ingress layer for foreign OPC/Modbus gateways
milestones.still_missing_zh: 长尾 PLC/专有现场总线驱动覆盖仍少于 Kepware；大型 DCS 深度集成与全球现场服务网络不足
milestones.still_missing_en: Long-tail PLC/fieldbus driver coverage still trails Kepware; deep DCS integration and global field-service network remain thin

milestones.before_gap_en: Early Xinchuang rollout left IIoT messaging in government/SOE deployments choosing foreign middleware (IBM MQ, Tibco) on x86+CentOS or forfeiting MQTT 5 clustering; no certified high-concurrency MQTT enterprise edition existed on domestic OS + domestic CPU

milestones.achievement_en: EMQX officially announced compatibility tests on Kunpeng/Feiteng processors and UnionTech UOS等 Xinchuang hardware/software, enabling full-stack domestic deployment of a MQTT messaging platform and breaking combined dependence on foreign middleware plus foreign OS in that segment
milestones.still_missing_zh: 信创目录入列与行业测评案例仍少于传统国外中间件；跨厂商信创组合矩阵的自动化认证覆盖有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Xinchuang catalog listings and sector evaluation cases still fewer than legacy foreign middleware; automated certification matrix across vendors remains limited

milestones.achievement_en: BIMFACE shipped full REST APIs and Web SDK for upload, translation, viewing, and clash — letting domestic apps embed BIM on in-country cloud

milestones.before_gap_en: Multi-party online collaboration and model versioning on domestic mega-projects mainly used Autodesk BIM 360 / BIM 360 Docs foreign cloud CDEs

milestones.achievement_en: BIMFACE extended project collaboration, markup, versioning, and access control — deployed for domestic cloud BIM coordination on projects including Beijing Daxing International Airport
milestones.still_missing_zh: 国际总包合同要求的 ACC/BIM Collaborate Pro 工作流与全球分包链对接仍占优
milestones.still_missing_en: ACC/BIM Collaborate Pro workflows and global subcontractor chains still dominate international EPC contracts

milestones.before_gap_zh: 政务与央企信创终端上无法运行基于国外中间件的 BIM 云协同，BIM 可视化在国产化替代清单中长期缺位
milestones.before_gap_en: Government and SOE xinchuang endpoints could not run BIM cloud collaboration on foreign middleware — BIM visualization was missing from domestic substitution catalogs
milestones.achievement_zh: 广联达推动 BIMFACE 在国产操作系统与信创浏览器环境完成适配验证，使 BIM 协同可纳入国产化替代采购
milestones.achievement_en: Glodon validated BIMFACE on domestic OS and xinchuang browser stacks, enabling BIM collaboration in domestic substitution procurement
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全栈信创（国产芯片+数据库+中间件）大规模生产案例仍少于传统 x86+Windows
milestones.still_missing_en: Full-stack xinchuang (domestic CPU/DB/middleware) production deployments still fewer than legacy x86+Windows

milestones.headline_zh: 广联达 GGP/GSolid 图形平台获信通院泰尔自主可控测评 S 级
milestones.headline_en: Glodon GGP/GSolid graphics platform earns CAICT Tel self-reliance grade S
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产 BIM 参数化构件/族编辑长期依赖国外几何内核（ACIS/Parasolid 类）或 Revit/Archicad 等国外 authoring 引擎，信创场景无法在约束求解与参数驱动层面实现内核级自主
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic BIM parametric components/families relied on licensed foreign geometry kernels (ACIS/Parasolid class) or foreign authoring engines (Revit/Archicad)—no kernel-level autonomy for constraints and parametric driving in xinchuang deployments
milestones.achievement_zh: GGP 图形平台实现几何建模、渲染、参数化与约束求解全栈自主，通过信通院泰尔测评 S 级；适配鸿蒙/麒麟/统信，为广联达 BIM 正向设计与参数化构件库提供国产 Revit Family Editor 类底层能力
milestones.achievement_en: GGP delivers owned geometry, rendering, parametrics, and constraint solving; passed CAICT Tel grade S; ports to HarmonyOS/Kylin/UOS—providing a domestic Revit Family Editor–class foundation for Glodon forward BIM and parametric component libraries
milestones.still_missing_zh: 视觉编程节点生态仍弱于 Dynamo/Grasshopper；GDL 级开放脚本与 Revit API 插件生态差距大；IFC 族参数 round-trip 深度不足
milestones.still_missing_en: Visual-programming node ecosystem still trails Dynamo/Grasshopper; GDL-class open scripting and Revit API plugin depth remain gaps; IFC family parametric round-trip still shallow
