milestones.headline_zh: 广联达发布 BIM 2.0 白皮书：构件级参数数据驱动设计–造价–施工一体化
milestones.headline_en: Glodon BIM 2.0 white paper: component-level parametric data across design–cost–construction
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国内 BIM 长期停留在模型可视化与碰撞检查，缺少可驱动造价/施工的构件级参数数据统一模型与交换标准，族库数据难以脱离 Revit/Bentley 生态独立流转
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic BIM stayed at visualization and clash detection without unified component-level parametric data models and exchange standards—family-library data could not flow independently outside Revit/Bentley ecosystems
milestones.achievement_zh: 2026 工程数智大会发布 BIM 2.0：以 DATA+AI 驱动设计/成本/施工/运维一体化，强调构件级数据、统一交换标准与自主图形平台信创全栈——对标国际 CDE + 参数化族库联邦的国产路线
milestones.achievement_en: At 2026 Engineering Digital Intelligence Congress, Glodon released BIM 2.0: DATA+AI across design/cost/construction/O&M with component-level data, unified exchange standards, and owned graphics on xinchuang—domestic route vs international CDE + parametric family federation
milestones.still_missing_zh: 白皮书属战略发布，非可审计的族库分发市占证明；Dynamo/Grasshopper 级 visual programming 仍缺；deep Open BIM/IFC 互操作未达 Solibri/Revit 组合
milestones.still_missing_en: White paper is strategic release, not audited family-library market share; no Dynamo/Grasshopper-class visual programming; deep Open BIM/IFC interoperability still below Solibri/Revit stacks

milestones.headline_zh: 浩辰 CAD 8 发布：自研 2D DWG 平台内核世代切换

milestones.before_gap_zh: 2013 年前国产二维 CAD 多依赖 IntelliCAD/ODA 类授权或衍生栈，规模化、高性能 DWG 编辑能力由 Autodesk AutoCAD 等国外平台垄断
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2013, domestic 2D CAD largely relied on IntelliCAD/ODA-class licensed stacks; scalable high-performance DWG editing was monopolized by foreign platforms such as Autodesk AutoCAD
milestones.achievement_zh: 浩辰 CAD 8 全球发布，标志着新一代自研二维平台；公司披露 2D 核心技术自主可控，形成可规模商用的国产 DWG 编辑底座
milestones.achievement_en: GstarCAD 8 global launch marked a new owned 2D platform generation; company disclosures describe proprietary 2D core technology forming a scalable domestic DWG editing foundation
milestones.still_missing_zh: 三维 B-rep 内核未自研（3D 模块依赖 Spatial ACIS 等授权）；高端曲面、大型装配仍弱于 CATIA/NX/SolidWorks
milestones.still_missing_en: No owned 3D B-rep kernel (3D modules license Spatial ACIS); Class-A surfaces and large assemblies still trail CATIA/NX/SolidWorks

milestones.before_gap_zh: 行业垂直 CAD 插件长期绑定 Autodesk ObjectARX/AutoCAD，迁移至国产 CAD 需全量重写；无中国平台提供 ARX 级代码兼容二次开发
milestones.before_gap_en: Vertical CAD add-ons were locked to Autodesk ObjectARX/AutoCAD; switching to domestic CAD required full rewrites — no Chinese platform offered ARX-class code-compatible extension APIs
milestones.achievement_zh: 2009 年 GRX 二次开发平台与垂直套件全球发布；官方迁移文档宣称 ARX 应用基本无需改码即可在 AutoCAD 与浩辰双平台编译运行，并持续提供 Windows/Linux 多架构 GRX SDK
milestones.achievement_en: 2009 global release of GRX extension platform and vertical suites; official migration docs claim ARX apps port with minimal code changes to run on both AutoCAD and GstarCAD, with ongoing Windows/Linux multi-arch GRX SDKs
milestones.still_missing_zh: 非 ARX 二进制完全兼容；复杂 ObjectARX 应用仍需重编译与调优；全球插件商店生态规模仍远小于 Autodesk
milestones.still_missing_en: Not full ARX binary compatibility; complex ObjectARX apps still need recompile/tuning; global plugin-store ecosystem far smaller than Autodesk's

milestones.achievement_en: 2020 GstarCAD Linux edition shipped; later unified-kernel releases completed Loongson/Phytium/Kunpeng CPU and multi-distro Linux ports with GRX/LISP/.NET/Python APIs aligned to Windows
milestones.still_missing_zh: 钣金展开、三维装配、大企业 PLM 集成深度仍弱于 ZW3D/SolidWorks；AutoCAD 无对等 Linux 桌面版但 Windows 专业功能仍更完整
milestones.still_missing_en: Sheet-metal, 3D assembly, and enterprise PLM integration trail ZW3D/SolidWorks; AutoCAD has no Linux desktop peer but Windows pro feature depth remains greater

milestones.before_gap_en: Mobile/cloud DWG viewing was dominated internationally by Autodesk AutoCAD mobile and A360; no Chinese CAD vendor matched that global scale
milestones.achievement_zh: 官方发展历程披露看图王/DWG FastView 用户从 2019 年 3000 万增长至 2024 年累计 1 亿+，覆盖 175+ 国家，形成国内看图王与国际 DWG FastView 双品牌云 CAD 矩阵

milestones.headline_zh: 海尔洗衣机互联工厂入选世界经济论坛全球灯塔工厂，以卡奥斯大规模定制数字孪生替代刚性产线模式
milestones.headline_en: Haier connected washing-machine plant joins WEF Global Lighthouse Network on COSMOPlat mass-customization digital twin
milestones.before_gap_zh: 家电大规模混线定制长期依赖西门子/罗克韦尔自动化硬件叠加进口 MES（如 Siemens Opcenter、Rockwell FactoryTalk）与 SAP 计划层拼装，缺少用户订单驱动的端到端数字孪生闭环
milestones.before_gap_en: High-mix appliance customization relied on Siemens/Rockwell automation plus import MES (Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk) and SAP planning layers, without user-order-driven end-to-end digital twin closure
milestones.achievement_zh: 青岛海尔洗衣机互联工厂成为家电行业首家全球灯塔工厂，基于卡奥斯实现用户参与设计、柔性排产与产线数字孪生联动，验证国产工业互联网平台可承担原先由外资制造软件栈主导的大规模定制场景
milestones.achievement_en: Qingdao Haier connected washing-machine plant became the first home-appliance Global Lighthouse, using COSMOPlat for user-involved design, flexible scheduling, and line digital-twin coupling—proving a domestic IIoT stack could own mass-customization scenarios previously led by foreign manufacturing software
milestones.still_missing_zh: 底层 PLC/驱动、高端仿真与海外工厂合规部署仍部分依赖西门子、ABB 等外资工控；平台对外中立交付能力弱于海尔内生场景
milestones.still_missing_en: Underlying PLC/drives, high-end simulation, and overseas compliant deployment still partly depend on Siemens/ABB; neutral third-party delivery remains weaker than Haier-internal scenarios

metrics.label_zh: WEF 案例宣称制造效率提升

milestones.headline_zh: 2017汉诺威工业博览会全球发布卡奥斯COSMOPlat用户全流程参与的大规模定制工业互联网
milestones.headline_en: COSMOPlat globally launched at Hannover Messe 2017 as user-participatory mass-customization IIoT
milestones.before_gap_zh: 跨企业、跨用户的订单—设计—制造协同多依赖 PTC Windchill/ThingWorx、GE Predix 生态或 SAP+外资 MES 的项目制集成，缺少可复制的国产平台化「用户即创造者」协作层
milestones.before_gap_en: Cross-enterprise order–design–make collaboration depended on PTC Windchill/ThingWorx, GE Predix ecosystems, or SAP plus foreign MES project integration—no replicable domestic platform layer for user-as-creator collaboration
milestones.achievement_zh: 海尔在汉诺威工业博览会正式发布卡奥斯，以 U+N（用户+节点）模式将用户需求、生态企业与制造资源接入同一工业互联网平台，形成可对外复制的国产协作式工业云
milestones.achievement_en: Haier officially launched COSMOPlat at Hannover Messe with a U+N (users + nodes) model linking user demand, ecosystem firms, and manufacturing resources on one IIoT platform—a replicable domestic collaborative industrial cloud
milestones.still_missing_zh: 非家电行业生态伙伴规模、开发者/API 治理成熟度仍落后于 PTC ThingWorx 应用商店
milestones.still_missing_en: Ecosystem partner scale outside home appliances and developer/API governance maturity still trail the PTC ThingWorx marketplace

milestones.headline_en: Haier North Macedonia connected refrigerator plant goes live—first large-scale COSMOPlat C2M scheduling replication in a European greenfield factory
milestones.before_gap_zh: 海外绿地家电工厂数字化通常采购西门子/罗克韦尔产线控制加进口 MES 与 SAP 计划层，由中国工业互联网平台整厂输出柔性排产与订单驱动制造尚属空白
milestones.before_gap_en: Greenfield overseas appliance plants typically procured Siemens/Rockwell line control plus import MES and SAP planning; turnkey export of Chinese IIoT flexible scheduling was still rare
milestones.achievement_zh: 卡奥斯赋能的北马其顿基切沃互联工厂建成投产，将用户大规模定制、柔性排产与设备互联能力从中国制造基地复制到欧洲，替代传统「外资自动化+进口 MES 集成商」交付路径
milestones.achievement_en: The COSMOPlat-enabled Kičevo connected refrigerator plant entered production, replicating user-driven mass customization, flexible scheduling, and equipment connectivity from China to Europe—substituting the traditional foreign automation plus import-MES integrator delivery path
milestones.still_missing_zh: 欧洲数据合规、本地供应链 IT 异构集成与多品牌设备互操作仍依赖部分西门子/施耐德组件
milestones.still_missing_en: EU data compliance, local supply-chain IT heterogeneity, and multi-vendor equipment interoperability still rely partly on Siemens/Schneider components

milestones.headline_zh: 联合国工发组织与海尔签署合作，选定卡奥斯为面向发展中国家的工业互联网数据采集与赋能平台
milestones.headline_en: UNIDO partners with Haier, selecting COSMOPlat as IIoT data-acquisition and enablement platform for developing economies
milestones.before_gap_zh: 发展中国家中小企业产线设备上云与工况采集长期依赖西门子 MindSphere、GE Predix 或跨国咨询方提供的进口云连接方案
milestones.before_gap_en: SME equipment clouding and condition-data acquisition in developing economies long relied on Siemens MindSphere, GE Predix, or import consulting-led connectivity packages
milestones.achievement_zh: 联合国工业发展组织与海尔集团签署合作，推动卡奥斯向「一带一路」等市场输出设备互联、数据采集与产能协同能力，成为获多边机构背书的国产工业互联网替代选项
milestones.achievement_en: UNIDO signed cooperation with Haier to promote COSMOPlat equipment connectivity, data acquisition, and capacity collaboration in Belt-and-Road markets—establishing a multilateral-endorsed domestic IIoT alternative
milestones.still_missing_zh: 多边项目落地规模、边缘协议广度与 PI/MindSphere 级过程历史库深度仍不足
milestones.still_missing_en: Multilateral deployment scale, edge protocol breadth, and PI/MindSphere-class process historian depth remain limited

milestones.headline_zh: 黑格获授权自主 DLP 光固化切片方法专利，为 HPS 工业切片引擎奠定算法底座
milestones.headline_en: HeyGears granted proprietary DLP photopolymer slicing patent, anchoring the HPS industrial slicing engine
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2018 年前国内工业 DLP/SLA 产线普遍依赖 Materialise Magics、3D Systems 3D Sprint 或进口设备捆绑海外切片栈完成层厚/曝光路径规划，缺少可量产交付的国产工业切片内核
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2018, domestic industrial DLP/SLA lines largely relied on Materialise Magics, 3D Systems 3D Sprint, or foreign hardware-bundled slicers for layer and exposure-path planning, with no mass-deployable domestic industrial slicing core
milestones.achievement_zh: 广州黑格科技「一种光固化3D打印的切片方法及装置」发明专利 CN108918830A 公开/授权，将掩膜投影 DLP 切片流程固化进自研 HPS，使 UltraCraft 产线不再依赖进口切片软件完成基础光固化切片
milestones.achievement_en: Guangzhou HeyGears' patent CN108918830A for photopolymer 3D-print slicing codified mask-projection DLP slicing into the in-house HPS stack, enabling UltraCraft production lines to complete baseline photopolymer slicing without imported slicer dependence
milestones.still_missing_zh: 开放 CAD 格式互操作、Magics 级网格布尔/修复工具链及跨品牌打印机通用切片仍缺位
milestones.still_missing_en: Open CAD interoperability, Magics-class mesh boolean/repair toolchains, and vendor-agnostic slicing across third-party printers remain gaps

milestones.headline_zh: UltraCraft A2D 齿科量产方案发布，HPS 集成多模型批量化排版
milestones.headline_en: UltraCraft A2D dental mass-production launch ships HPS with multi-model batch nesting
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国内齿科技工所批量种植冠/模型生产长期采用 EnvisionTEC Perfactory/Vida + Materialise Magics 手工/半自动排版，国产设备侧缺少与硬件深度耦合、可规模化量产的专用排版切片栈
milestones.before_gap_en: Chinese dental labs mass-producing crowns/models relied on EnvisionTEC Perfactory/Vida plus Materialise Magics semi-manual nesting; domestic hardware lacked a tightly coupled, production-scale dedicated nesting-and-slicing stack
milestones.achievement_zh: 黑格在 TCT Asia 2019 发布面向齿科量产的 UltraCraft A2D，配套 HPS 在单一国产栈内完成多牙模/冠桥件的批量化平台排版与切片下发，开始替代「进口 DLP 机 + Magics」默认工作流
milestones.achievement_en: HeyGears launched the dental mass-production UltraCraft A2D at TCT Asia 2019 with HPS enabling batch platform nesting and slice dispatch in one domestic stack, beginning to displace the default imported-DLP-plus-Magics workflow
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨材料/跨机型的通用 nesting 优化、与海外 MES/技工所开放生态对接仍弱于 Materialise Magics + Streamics
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-material/cross-machine generic nesting optimization and open integration with foreign MES/lab ecosystems still trail Materialise Magics + Streamics

milestones.headline_zh: 黑格支撑结构生成专利落地 HPS，工业齿科/珠宝件可脱离海外支撑工具
milestones.headline_en: HeyGears support-generation patent productized in HPS, reducing reliance on foreign support tools for industrial dental/jewelry parts
milestones.before_gap_zh: 高复杂度工业光固化件（薄壁冠桥、珠宝镂空件）支撑设计长期依赖 Materialise Magics、Netfabb 或手工 Meshmixer 预处理后再导入海外切片器
milestones.before_gap_en: Complex industrial photopolymer parts (thin-wall crown bridges, jewelry lattices) depended on Materialise Magics, Netfabb, or manual Meshmixer prep before importing into foreign slicers
milestones.achievement_zh: 「一种三维打印支撑结构的生成方法」专利 CN110734082B 由广州黑格智造申请并公开，支撑自动生成算法嵌入 HPS 切片流程，用户可在国产栈内完成支撑—切片—打印闭环
milestones.achievement_en: Patent CN110734082B for 3D-print support-structure generation filed by Guangzhou HeyGears Intelligent Manufacturing was published and embedded into the HPS slice workflow, enabling support-to-slice-to-print closure in a domestic stack
milestones.still_missing_zh: 可剥离性/残根应力仿真、镂空交叉支撑策略与 Magics 工业支撑模板库仍有差距
milestones.still_missing_en: Peel-force/residual-stress simulation, lattice cross-support strategies, and Magics industrial support template libraries remain gaps

sources.title: CN110734082B — Google Patents

milestones.headline_zh: UltraCraft 4K 量产系统发布，HPS 支撑 4K 幅面齿科大批量 nesting
milestones.headline_en: UltraCraft 4K mass-production system launch scales HPS 4K-platform dental batch nesting
milestones.before_gap_zh: 大尺寸高分辨率齿科批量生产（隐形矫治器母模、全牙弓模型）仍多进口 EnvisionTEC/3D Systems 工业 DLP 产线 + Magics 排版；国产方案缺少同等幅面与批产效率
milestones.before_gap_en: Large-format high-resolution dental batch production (aligner molds, full-arch models) still relied on imported EnvisionTEC/3D Systems industrial DLP lines plus Magics nesting; domestic alternatives lacked comparable build volume and batch throughput
milestones.achievement_zh: 黑格发布 UltraCraft 4K 工业 DLP 量产系统，HPS 针对 4K 幅面优化多盘批量 nesting 与切片参数，成为国内齿科/鞋模等批量工厂可规模部署的国产「硬件+排版切片」替代方案
milestones.achievement_en: HeyGears released the UltraCraft 4K industrial DLP mass-production system; HPS optimized multi-plate batch nesting and slice parameters for the 4K platform, becoming a deployable domestic hardware-plus-nesting alternative for dental and footwear batch factories
milestones.still_missing_zh: 第三方开放打印机生态、Magics 级高级 QA/报告与全球服务网络仍不足
milestones.still_missing_en: Third-party open-printer ecosystem, Magics-grade advanced QA/reporting, and global service network remain insufficient

sources.title: HeyGears launches new 4K DLP 3D printer for dental applications — 3D Printing Industry

milestones.headline_zh: Streamflow 产线软件与 HPS 打通，国产齿科增材工厂排产调度替代 Magics+表格式管理
milestones.headline_en: Streamflow production software integrates with HPS, substituting Magics-plus-spreadsheet shop-floor management in domestic dental AM factories
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国内齿科增材量产线订单—排版—打印—后处理调度多依赖 Magics 手工排产 + Excel/纸质工单，缺少与国产 DLP 产线深度绑定的 MES 级排产切片一体平台
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic dental AM mass-production scheduling from order to nest to print to post-process relied on manual Magics planning plus Excel/paper work orders, without an MES-grade nest-and-schedule platform tightly bound to domestic DLP lines
milestones.achievement_zh: 黑格上线 Streamflow 数字化产线平台（官网 Software Resources），与 HPS 切片/排版及 UltraCraft 设备队列联动，实现订单驱动的批量排版、任务下发与产线状态管理，形成国产齿科工厂可复制的软件闭环
milestones.achievement_en: HeyGears shipped the Streamflow digital production platform (official Software Resources), linking HPS nesting/slicing with UltraCraft device queues for order-driven batch nesting, job dispatch, and line status management—a replicable domestic software loop for dental factories
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨品牌设备统一调度、与海外技工所开放 ERP/LIMS 标准接口及 Materialise Streamics 级多站点协同仍缺失
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-vendor unified scheduling, open ERP/LIMS interfaces with foreign lab standards, and Materialise Streamics-class multi-site orchestration are still missing

milestones.headline_zh: HOLLiAS MACS-N 核电安全级 DCS 在宁德核电 1 号机组首次商运
milestones.headline_en: HOLLiAS MACS-N nuclear safety-grade DCS enters commercial operation at Ningde NPP Unit 1
milestones.before_gap_zh: 此前中国大陆在运/新建商用核电机组仪控与安全级 DCS 长期由 AREVA Teleperm、西门子 SPPA-T2000、三菱 MELTAC 等外资方案垄断，国产厂商无 NNSA 许可的商用堆型安全级 DCS 批量投运记录
milestones.before_gap_en: Commercial NPP I&C and safety-grade DCS in mainland China had been dominated by AREVA Teleperm, Siemens SPPA-T2000, Mitsubishi MELTAC, etc.; no domestic vendor had NNSA-licensed, fleet-scale safety DCS in commercial operation
milestones.achievement_zh: 和利时自主核电 DCS「HOLLiAS MACS-N」通过国家核安全局安全审评并随 CPR-1000 机组批量部署；宁德核电 1 号机组于 2013 年 4 月投入商业运行，标志国产核电安全级 DCS 首次替代进口系统进入商运
milestones.achievement_en: Hollysys-owned HOLLiAS MACS-N passed NNSA safety review and was batch-deployed on CPR-1000 units; Ningde Unit 1 entered commercial operation in April 2013—the first domestically developed nuclear safety-grade DCS to replace imported systems at commercial scale
milestones.still_missing_zh: 四代堆/小型堆新堆型工程经验仍在积累；海外核电项目 I&C 标杆与全球服务网络弱于 Framatome/Siemens；非核流程化工 DCS 市占低于中控
milestones.still_missing_en: Gen-IV/SMR reference base still maturing; weak overseas NPP I&C references and global service vs Framatome/Siemens; lower process-chemical DCS share than SUPCON

milestones.headline_en: All six Hongyanhe NPP units run on Hollysys domestic nuclear DCS
milestones.before_gap_zh: 大型多机组核电基地此前普遍按法/美/俄技术路线进口仪控系统，单基地全系列国产安全级 DCS 尚无先例
milestones.before_gap_en: Large multi-unit nuclear bases had relied on imported I&C along French/US/Russian technology lines; no precedent for an entire base on a domestic safety-grade DCS series
milestones.achievement_zh: 红沿河核电 1–6 号机组均部署 HOLLiAS MACS-N 核电 DCS；6 号机组于 2016 年 9 月商运，形成当时国内规模最大的全自主核电仪控基地
milestones.achievement_en: Hongyanhe Units 1–6 all deployed HOLLiAS MACS-N; Unit 6 entered commercial operation in September 2016, forming the largest all-domestic nuclear I&C base in China at the time
milestones.still_missing_zh: 仪控备件与升级工具链的跨代兼容仍需工程验证；国际市场认证与出口案例缺失
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-generation spare-parts and upgrade toolchain still needs field validation; no comparable international certification or export references

milestones.headline_en: Hualong One demo Fuqing Unit 5 ships with Hollysys nuclear DCS and goes commercial
milestones.before_gap_zh: 三代自主堆型「华龙一号」示范工程的核安全级 DCS 此前无完整国产化商运先例，关键仪控仍被视为外资技术壁垒
milestones.before_gap_en: For the indigenous Gen-III Hualong One demo project, a fully domestic nuclear safety-grade DCS had no prior commercial precedent; I&C was still treated as a foreign-technology choke point
milestones.achievement_zh: 福清核电 5 号机组（全球首台华龙一号）采用和利时核电 DCS，2021 年 1 月 30 日投入商业运行，实现自主三代堆型与自主核级 DCS 的成套国产化
milestones.achievement_en: Fuqing Unit 5—the world's first Hualong One—used Hollysys nuclear DCS and entered commercial operation on 30 Jan 2021, closing the loop on indigenous Gen-III reactor plus indigenous safety-grade DCS
milestones.still_missing_zh: 海外华龙项目仪控仍需符合当地核监管；数字化孪生与预测性维护深度弱于国际新一代核电 I&C
milestones.still_missing_en: Overseas Hualong projects still face local nuclear I&C regulation; digital twin and predictive maintenance depth trail latest international nuclear I&C platforms

milestones.before_gap_zh: 2000 年代前中国大型火电与超临界机组 DCS 市场由 Honeywell TDC/Experion、Emerson Ovation、ABB Symphony 等外资产品主导
milestones.before_gap_en: Before the mid-2000s, large thermal and supercritical unit DCS in China was dominated by Honeywell TDC/Experion, Emerson Ovation, and ABB Symphony
milestones.achievement_zh: 和利时 MACS 分散控制系统在大唐托克托电厂等超大规模火电基地规模化投运，打破外资在百万千瓦级火电 DCS 的垄断，成为电力行业主流国产 DCS 之一
milestones.achievement_en: Hollysys MACS DCS scaled at Datang Tuoketuo and other mega thermal bases, breaking foreign monopoly on 1000 MW-class power DCS and becoming a mainstream domestic power-sector DCS
milestones.still_missing_zh: 百万千瓦级复杂协调控制与全厂优化仍部分借鉴进口算法与仪表；化工流程行业渗透弱于中控/Emerson
milestones.still_missing_en: Complex coordinated control and plant-wide optimization still partly rely on imported algorithms/instruments; weaker penetration in process chemicals vs SUPCON/Emerson

milestones.headline_en: MACS-K nuclear/thermal DCS passes Phytium + Kylin xinchuang compatibility certification
milestones.before_gap_zh: 此前核级与电力 DCS 工程师站/服务器长期绑定 Intel x86 + Windows，国产 CPU/OS 上无可商用的同等安全级 DCS 软件栈
milestones.before_gap_en: Nuclear- and power-grade DCS engineering stations/servers had been tied to Intel x86 + Windows with no commercially equivalent safety-grade DCS stack on domestic CPU/OS
milestones.achievement_zh: 和利时 MACS-K DCS 完成飞腾 S2500 处理器与麒麟操作系统兼容认证，工程站与服务器可在信创软硬件上部署，降低对进口通用计算平台的依赖

milestones.still_missing_zh: 信创平台长期可靠性数据少于 x86 存量；海外项目不接受信创栈

milestones.headline_zh: SINOVATION CRUX IV 自研 B-rep 内核支撑华天三维 CAD 桌面端量产
milestones.headline_en: SINOVATION CRUX IV owned B-rep kernel powers Hoteam desktop 3D CAD at production scale
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2000年代国产三维 MCAD 普遍租赁 Parasolid/ACIS 或直接使用 NX/CATIA/SolidWorks，源代码不可控，模具与装备行业高端三维建模长期依赖进口软件
milestones.before_gap_en: Through the 2000s, domestic 3D MCAD mostly leased Parasolid/ACIS or ran imported NX/CATIA/SolidWorks without source-level control; high-end 3D modeling in mold and equipment sectors relied on foreign CAD
milestones.achievement_zh: 华天软件在消化吸收日本 UEL CADmeister 技术路线基础上推出第四代自研几何内核 CRUX IV，并用于 SINOVATION/华天三维 CAD 产品线，实现 B-rep 实体曲面混合建模、参数化特征、大装配与冲压/注塑/铸造模具专业模块的自主可控桌面三维 CAD-CAM 栈
milestones.achievement_en: Building on digested UEL CADmeister lineage, Hoteam shipped the fourth-generation owned CRUX IV kernel on SINOVATION/Hoteam 3D CAD, delivering an owned desktop 3D CAD-CAM stack with hybrid B-rep solid/surface modeling, parametric features, large assemblies, and stamping/injection/die-casting mold modules
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全国品牌与装机仍弱于中望 ZW3D；高端 Class-A 曲面、超大型装配性能与公开 API 生态仍落后 CATIA/NX
milestones.still_missing_en: National brand and install base still trail ZW3D; Class-A surfacing, very large-assembly performance, and public API ecosystem still lag CATIA/NX

milestones.headline_zh: 华天 PDM 量产：国产最早一批自主产品数据管理/PLM 栈
milestones.headline_en: Hoteam PDM in production: among China's earliest owned product-data-management / PLM stacks
milestones.before_gap_zh: 1990 年代中国离散制造企业研发数据管理几乎全靠 IBM Metaphase、SDRC/I-DEAS、UGS IMAN 等进口 PDM/PLM 或项目定制，无规模化国产替代
milestones.before_gap_en: In the 1990s Chinese discrete manufacturers relied on imported PDM/PLM (IBM Metaphase, SDRC/I-DEAS, UGS IMAN) or custom projects with no scaled domestic alternative
milestones.achievement_zh: 山大华天（华天软件前身）在 1998 年前后推出自主 PDM 产品并持续迭代为 InforCenter PLM，在机械、汽车、军工客户群形成可复制的国产研发数据管理替代路径
milestones.achievement_en: Shandong University Hoteam (Hoteam Software predecessor) shipped an owned PDM product around 1998, later evolving into InforCenter PLM—a replicable domestic R&D data-management substitution path in machinery, automotive, and defense accounts
milestones.still_missing_zh: 复杂集团级多法人/全球 BOM、与 SAP/Oracle 预置深度集成、Windchill/Teamcenter 级 ISV 生态仍明显落后
milestones.still_missing_en: Complex multi-entity/global BOM, prebuilt SAP/Oracle depth, and Windchill/Teamcenter-class ISV ecosystems still lag significantly

milestones.headline_en: InforCenter microservices PLM platform launch: domestic cloud-native product lifecycle management
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2010 年代国内中大型 PLM 项目多采购 Siemens Teamcenter、PTC Windchill、Dassault ENOVIA 等单体/重客户端进口平台，国产方案多为传统 C/S 架构、SaaS 与微服务拆分能力弱
milestones.before_gap_en: Through the 2010s mid-large PLM deployments favored monolithic/heavy-client imports (Siemens Teamcenter, PTC Windchill, Dassault ENOVIA); domestic options were mostly traditional C/S with weak SaaS/microservice decomposition
milestones.achievement_zh: 华天发布 InforCenter 新一代 PLM 平台（微服务/组件化架构），覆盖项目管理、BOM、变更、工艺衔接等模块，作为华天 PLM 主品牌承接进口 PLM 国产化替换项目
milestones.achievement_en: Hoteam released the InforCenter next-gen PLM platform (microservices/componentized architecture) covering program management, BOM, change, and process linkage—serving as the main Hoteam PLM brand for import-substitution programs
milestones.still_missing_zh: 超大型集团多站点联邦治理、Active Workspace/3DEXPERIENCE 级体验、全球 OEM 认证案例公开度不足
milestones.still_missing_en: Mega-group multi-site federation governance, Active Workspace/3DEXPERIENCE-class UX, and public global OEM certification cases remain limited

milestones.before_gap_zh: 超大型跨国集团核心总账、应收应付、财审与关账长期依赖 Oracle EBS/Fusion；国产 ERP 缺乏在同等体量下经全球关账验证的量产案例
milestones.before_gap_en: Super-large multinational group GL, AR/AP, audit and period close relied on Oracle EBS/Fusion; no domestic ERP had a production-proven global close track record at comparable scale
milestones.achievement_zh: 2023-04-20 孟晚舟在华为分析师大会宣布 MetaERP 研发完成并完成旧 ERP 全量切换；覆盖销售、供应、制造、交付、人资、内控、财审等场景，月结、季结、年结零故障
milestones.achievement_en: On 2023-04-20 Meng Wanzhou announced MetaERP R&D completion and full legacy-ERP cutover at HAS; covers sales, supply, manufacturing, delivery, HR, internal control and finance audit with zero-fault month/quarter/year close
milestones.still_missing_zh: 外部行业客户复制仍处早期；复杂制造业深度集成与 Oracle/SAP 成熟生态仍有差距
milestones.still_missing_en: External industry replication remains early; deep complex-manufacturing integration still trails mature Oracle/SAP ecosystems

sources.title: 华为实现 MetaERP 研发，并完成对旧 ERP 系统的替换
Huawei achieves breakthrough in MetaERP R&D, replaces legacy ERP system

milestones.headline_zh: 国产方案首次支撑超大型集团全球多法人运营与共享交付
milestones.headline_en: First domestic stack to run super-large-group multi-entity global operations and shared services
milestones.before_gap_zh: 集团总部—数百子公司—跨洲共享交付中心的全球多法人管控与合并报表能力此前仅见于 SAP/Oracle 级国际套件
milestones.before_gap_en: HQ-to-hundreds-of-subsidiaries cross-region shared-service and multi-entity group control was previously proven only on tier-1 international suites such as SAP/Oracle
milestones.achievement_zh: MetaERP 支撑华为集团总部、300 多家子公司、30 多个全球共享交付中心在多地（含中国、欧洲、中东等）统一运行
milestones.achievement_en: MetaERP runs Huawei group HQ, 300+ subsidiaries and 30+ global shared delivery centers across regions including China, Europe and the Middle East
milestones.still_missing_zh: 第三方大型央企/民企规模化上线案例公开数据有限；跨国税务与本地化合规模板成熟度待行业验证
milestones.still_missing_en: Limited public evidence of scaled third-party SOE/private deployments; multinational tax and localization template maturity still needs industry validation

sources.title: 华为实现 MetaERP 研发，并完成对旧 ERP 系统的替换
华为 MetaERP 全球上线，实现自主可控 ERP 的研发与替换

milestones.headline_zh: 国产自研 ERP 首次覆盖华为全球销售—供应—制造—交付全链路
milestones.headline_en: Domestic self-developed ERP first covers Huawei global sales–supply–manufacturing–delivery chain
milestones.before_gap_zh: 高端制造集团端到端供应链与生产计划编排长期由 Oracle/SAP 垄断；国产方案在同等全球化复杂度下缺少全链路替换实证
milestones.before_gap_en: End-to-end supply chain and production orchestration for tier-1 manufacturing groups was long dominated by Oracle/SAP; domestic alternatives lacked full-chain replacement proof at comparable global complexity
milestones.achievement_zh: MetaERP 全量切换覆盖销售、供应、制造、交付等核心业务域，与财务/内控/人资一体化运行
milestones.achievement_en: Full MetaERP cutover spans sales, supply, manufacturing and delivery core domains, running integrated with finance, internal control and HR
milestones.still_missing_zh: 外部客户行业包与 MES/PLM 深度耦合仍弱于 SAP S/4HANA+Digital Supply Chain 成熟组合
milestones.still_missing_en: External industry packs and deep MES/PLM coupling remain weaker than mature SAP S/4HANA + Digital Supply Chain combinations

sources.title: 华为实现 MetaERP 研发，并完成对旧 ERP 系统的替换

milestones.headline_zh: 首套量产级集团 ERP 全栈运行于 openEuler + GaussDB 信创底座
milestones.headline_en: First production-tier group ERP running fully on openEuler + GaussDB indigenous stack
milestones.before_gap_zh: 高端 ERP 生产环境普遍绑定 Oracle Database、AIX/Linux 及国外中间件；国产库/OS 仅能做外围或试点，难以承载核心 ERP
milestones.before_gap_en: Tier-1 ERP production stacks were typically bound to Oracle Database, AIX/Linux and foreign middleware; domestic DB/OS could only support peripheral or pilot workloads, not core ERP
milestones.achievement_zh: MetaERP 基于华为自主可控技术体系（含 openEuler 操作系统、GaussDB 数据库等）完成研发与全球量产替换
milestones.achievement_en: MetaERP was built and globally deployed on Huawei's self-controlled stack including openEuler OS and GaussDB database
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨厂商异构信创组合（非华为全栈）兼容性认证与迁移工具链尚不成熟
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-vendor heterogeneous IT-innovation (non-Huawei full-stack) compatibility certification and migration toolchains remain immature

sources.title: 华为实现 MetaERP 研发，并完成对旧 ERP 系统的替换
Huawei achieves breakthrough in MetaERP R&D, replaces legacy ERP system

milestones.headline_zh: 华中8型高档数控系统通过国家级科技成果鉴定
milestones.headline_en: Huazhong HNC-8 high-end CNC system passes national S&T appraisal
milestones.before_gap_zh: 高档五轴联动数控系统长期由西门子840D、发那科30i、海德汉iTNC等进口系统垄断，国产系统难以覆盖航空航天级RTCP与空间误差补偿
milestones.before_gap_en: High-end 5-axis CNC with RTCP and volumetric error compensation was dominated by Siemens 840D, Fanuc 30i, and Heidenhain iTNC; domestic systems could not cover aerospace-grade needs
milestones.achievement_zh: 作为国家「04专项」核心成果，华中8型通过科技成果鉴定，鉴定结论称其整体技术达到国际先进水平，具备纳米级插补、五轴RTCP、真实机床空间误差补偿等此前主要依赖进口高档系统的核心能力
milestones.achievement_en: As a core deliverable of China's '04 Special Project', HNC-8 passed national appraisal concluding overall international-advanced capability, including nanoscale interpolation, 5-axis RTCP, and real-machine volumetric error compensation previously tied to imported high-end systems
milestones.still_missing_zh: 民用中高端市场品牌与生态仍弱于发那科/西门子；全球主机厂标配认证、超长可靠性累计数据仍不足
milestones.still_missing_en: Civilian mid-high market brand/ecosystem still trails Fanuc/Siemens; global OEM qualifications and long-run reliability datasets remain thin

sources.title: 华中8型高档数控系统通过科技成果鉴定

milestones.headline_zh: 华中8型五轴数控系统批量用于国产高端机床航空航天示范产线
milestones.headline_en: HNC-8 5-axis CNC deployed at scale on domestic machine tools for aerospace demo lines
milestones.before_gap_zh: 航空发动机叶轮、大型薄壁结构件等五轴加工产线普遍绑定进口数控系统，国产系统缺少可复制的批量示范
milestones.before_gap_en: Aero-engine impellers and large thin-wall structural 5-axis lines were typically bound to imported CNC; domestic systems lacked replicable volume demonstrations
milestones.achievement_zh: 武重机床等国产五轴主机配套华中8型进入航天、航空关键件加工示范应用，实现进口五轴数控系统在重点型号零件加工线上的可替代运行
milestones.achievement_en: Domestic 5-axis OEMs such as WZ (Wuhan Heavy) paired HNC-8 for aerospace/aviation demo production of critical parts, demonstrating replaceability of imported 5-axis CNC on priority part lines
milestones.still_missing_zh: 单台累计运行小时、全球适航/航发供应链准入仍落后于进口系统；刀具/后处理生态碎片化
milestones.still_missing_en: Per-machine runtime hours and global aero-engine supply-chain qualifications still lag imports; tooling/post-processor ecosystem remains fragmented

metrics.value: 航空航天关键件五轴加工

sources.title: 国产高档数控机床与数控系统产业化进展（中国机床工具工业协会）

milestones.headline_zh: 浪潮发布海岳品牌，GS Cloud 微服务云原生大型 ERP 正式商用
milestones.headline_en: Inspur launches Haiyue brand with production GS Cloud microservices cloud-native large-enterprise ERP
milestones.before_gap_zh: 大型集团云 ERP 长期以 SAP S/4HANA、Oracle Fusion Cloud 为架构参照，国产套件在微服务拆分、容器化弹性伸缩与混合云部署上缺乏同等量级的量产平台
milestones.before_gap_en: Large-group cloud ERP architecture was benchmarked on SAP S/4HANA and Oracle Fusion Cloud; domestic suites lacked a production-grade microservices, container-elastic, hybrid-cloud platform at comparable scale
milestones.achievement_zh: 2021-08 在 Inspur World 大会发布「海岳」企业软件品牌，GS Cloud 作为旗舰大型 ERP 以微服务、容器、DevOps 云原生架构面向央企/国资集团商用，形成可替代国际云 ERP 的国产平台
milestones.achievement_en: At Inspur World in Aug 2021 Inspur launched the Haiyue enterprise software brand; GS Cloud flagship large ERP shipped on microservices, containers and DevOps cloud-native stack for central SOE/state-owned groups as a domestic alternative to tier-1 international cloud ERP
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨国制造深度 MRP/全球税务本地化仍弱于 SAP；民营高端市场渗透有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Multinational manufacturing MRP depth and global tax localization still trail SAP; limited penetration in private-sector high-end accounts

metrics.value: 微服务 + 容器云原生

milestones.headline_zh: 中国烟草行业集团财务一体化平台采用浪潮 GS，实现跨省多级合并管控
milestones.headline_en: China Tobacco industry deploys Inspur GS for unified group finance and multi-level consolidation
milestones.before_gap_zh: 烟草行业各省公司财务系统分散，集团合并报表、预算与国资监管报送长期依赖 SAP BPC/Oracle Hyperion 等国际合并报表与集团管控套件
milestones.before_gap_en: Provincial tobacco companies ran fragmented finance stacks; group consolidation, budgeting and SASAC reporting relied on international tools such as SAP BPC and Oracle Hyperion
milestones.achievement_zh: 浪潮与中国烟草推进财务信息化一体化，以 GS 系列支撑全国烟草商业系统多级法人合并报表、全面预算与集团管控，成为垄断性央企行业可复制的国产替代样板
milestones.achievement_en: Inspur and China Tobacco advanced unified finance informatization on GS, supporting multi-entity consolidation, enterprise budgeting and group governance across the national tobacco commercial system—a replicable domestic substitute in a strategic monopoly sector
milestones.still_missing_zh: 行业外复制需深度定制；全球业务与复杂关联交易场景仍不如国际合并报表套件成熟
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-industry replication needs heavy customization; global operations and complex intercompany scenarios remain less mature than international consolidation suites

milestones.headline_zh: GS Cloud 支撑央企司库与集团总账共享，替代 Oracle/SAP 财务核心
milestones.headline_en: GS Cloud runs central-SOE treasury and group GL shared services, displacing Oracle/SAP finance cores
milestones.before_gap_zh: 央企集团司库、资金集中与总账共享中心核心系统多部署 Oracle EBS/Fusion 或 SAP ECC/S4，国产 ERP 缺乏在万亿级资金体量下通过月结/年结验证的案例
milestones.before_gap_en: Central SOE treasury, cash pooling and finance shared-service centers typically ran on Oracle EBS/Fusion or SAP ECC/S4; domestic ERP lacked production-proven month/year close at trillion-RMB fund scale
milestones.achievement_zh: 国资委推动央企司库体系建设背景下，浪潮 GS Cloud 在能源、投资、交通等央企集团上线司库与财务共享，覆盖总账、应收应付、资金计划与内控，形成面向央企财务核心的国产量产方案
milestones.achievement_en: Under SASAC's central-SOE treasury program, Inspur GS Cloud went live for treasury and finance shared services in energy, investment and transport groups—covering GL, AR/AP, cash planning and internal control as a domestic production alternative to Oracle/SAP finance cores
milestones.still_missing_zh: 超大型跨国制造全球关账与多准则并行仍弱于 Oracle；生态 ISV 与实施伙伴网络较窄
milestones.still_missing_en: Global close and parallel-GAAP operations for super-large multinationals still trail Oracle; narrower ISV and implementation partner ecosystem

metrics.value: 司库 + 财务共享 + 总账关账

milestones.headline_zh: GS Cloud 完成全栈信创适配，可在国产 OS/数据库上替代 Oracle+Linux 栈
milestones.headline_en: GS Cloud achieves full-stack IT-innovation certification, enabling replacement of Oracle-on-Linux stacks
milestones.before_gap_zh: 大型 ERP 生产环境普遍绑定 Oracle 数据库 + Red Hat/CentOS + x86 服务器，国产 OS/数据库上缺少经信创测评的大型 ERP 量产版本
milestones.before_gap_en: Large ERP production stacks were tied to Oracle DB plus Red Hat/CentOS on x86; no domestic large ERP had a certified mass-production release on domestic OS and databases
milestones.achievement_zh: 浪潮 GS Cloud 通过信创兼容认证，支持麒麟/统信操作系统与达梦、人大金仓等国产数据库及浪潮服务器，实现大型集团 ERP 软硬件全栈国产化部署
milestones.achievement_en: Inspur GS Cloud passed IT-innovation compatibility certification for Kylin/UOS OS, Dameng/Kingbase databases and Inspur servers—enabling full-stack domestic large-group ERP deployment
milestones.still_missing_zh: 极端高并发与历史 Oracle 存储过程迁移成本仍高；部分行业 ISV 插件生态未完全迁移
milestones.still_missing_en: Extreme high-concurrency workloads and legacy Oracle stored-procedure migration remain costly; some vertical ISV plugins not fully ported

metrics.value: 国产 OS + 国产 DB + 国产服务器

milestones.headline_en: IDC China EA applications market: Inspur ranked in top tier of domestic large-enterprise management software
milestones.before_gap_zh: 中国大型企业管理软件市场份额长期由 SAP、Oracle 与用友主导，国产集团型 ERP 在高端央企市场的可信度不足
milestones.before_gap_en: China's large-enterprise management software market was long led by SAP, Oracle and Yonyou; domestic group ERP lacked credibility in high-end central-SOE segments
milestones.achievement_zh: IDC 跟踪报告显示浪潮在中国企业应用软件/ERP 细分市场保持国产第一阵营份额，GS Cloud 海岳套件成为国资与集团客户替代 SAP/Oracle 的主流国产选项之一
milestones.achievement_en: IDC tracker reports place Inspur in the top domestic tier of China's enterprise application/ERP market, with Haiyue GS Cloud becoming a mainstream domestic option for SOE/group accounts replacing SAP/Oracle
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全球营收规模与跨国客户基础仍远小于 SAP；制造业深度仍落后于国际套件
milestones.still_missing_en: Global revenue and multinational installed base remain far below SAP; manufacturing depth still trails international suites

metrics.value: 国产大型 EA 第一阵营

milestones.headline_zh: 自研振镜激光切割控制系统量产，打破德国扫描控制垄断
milestones.headline_en: Mass-produced self-developed galvo laser cutting control ends German scanner-stack dominance
milestones.before_gap_zh: 振镜激光切割机长期依赖德国 SCAPS（USC/UC）与 Scanlab RTC 等进口控制卡及配套软件，国产厂商缺乏可量产的切割级轨迹控制与工艺闭环
milestones.before_gap_en: Galvo laser cutters relied on imported German SCAPS (USC/UC) and Scanlab RTC cards plus companion software; domestic vendors lacked production-grade cutting trajectory control and process closed-loop
milestones.achievement_zh: 金橙子 BSL 系列自研振镜控制卡与 CutMaker 切割软件配套量产，实现振镜激光切割控制系统的国产化批量应用
milestones.achievement_en: JCZ mass-produced BSL galvo control cards paired with CutMaker cutting software, enabling domestic batch deployment of galvo laser cutting control systems
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高端振镜本体仍多依赖 Scanlab/Cambridge 等进口；大幅面平板光纤切割仍由柏楚等主导
milestones.still_missing_en: High-end galvo heads still mostly imported (Scanlab/Cambridge); large-format flatbed fiber cutting remains led by Bochu and peers

metrics.label_zh: 招股书披露的外资竞品（振镜控制）

milestones.headline_zh: CutMaker 飞切与微连工艺上线，填补国产振镜切割 CAM 空白
milestones.headline_en: CutMaker fly-cut and micro-joint CAM closes domestic galvo-cutting programming gap
milestones.before_gap_zh: 振镜激光切割的飞行切割、微连与路径优化长期由 SCAPS USC 等进口 CAM/控制套件提供，国产切割软件多停留在标刻或简易轮廓
milestones.before_gap_en: Fly cutting, micro-joints, and path optimization for galvo laser cutting were long supplied by imported CAM/control suites such as SCAPS USC; domestic cutting software mostly covered marking or simple contours
milestones.achievement_zh: CutMaker 实现飞行切割、微连及工艺参数一体化编程，可在自研 BSL 控制栈上运行，支撑 3C/广告等振镜切割产线
milestones.achievement_en: CutMaker delivered integrated fly-cut, micro-joint, and process-parameter programming on the in-house BSL control stack for galvo cutting lines in 3C, signage, and related sectors
milestones.still_missing_zh: 复杂套料与坡口能力弱于专业 nesting 厂商；大幅面伺服切割工艺深度仍落后于柏楚 CypCut
milestones.still_missing_en: Complex nesting and beveling remain weaker than specialist nesting vendors; large-format servo cutting process depth still trails Bochu CypCut

metrics.value: 飞切 / 微连 / 视觉定位（公司披露）

milestones.headline_zh: DLC 伺服激光切割控制器与 CutMaker 协同，替代通用进口数控+第三方 CAM 组合
milestones.headline_en: DLC servo laser controller with CutMaker replaces generic imported CNC plus third-party CAM stacks
milestones.before_gap_zh: 3C 等平台式激光切割机常采用西门子/发那科等通用数控系统叠加进口或第三方 CAM，缺少面向激光工艺的国产一体化控制
milestones.before_gap_en: Platform laser cutters for 3C often used generic Siemens/Fanuc CNC plus imported or third-party CAM, lacking a domestic laser-process-integrated control stack
milestones.achievement_zh: 金橙子推出 DLC 系列伺服激光切割控制系统并与 CutMaker 协同，形成振镜+伺服双路线切割方案
milestones.achievement_en: JCZ launched the DLC servo laser cutting control family integrated with CutMaker, completing a dual galvo-plus-servo cutting portfolio
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高端多轴与厚板大幅面切割仍由柏楚及德资/日系整机方案占据；进口高端激光器与光学器件依赖未解
milestones.still_missing_en: High-end multi-axis and heavy thick-plate large-format cutting remain dominated by Bochu and German/Japanese machine bundles; dependence on imported high-end lasers and optics persists

metrics.value: 振镜 + 伺服双路线（年报/招股书披露）

sources.title: 金橙子2025年年度报告

milestones.headline_zh: 立创EDA正式上线：国产免费浏览器端全流程电路设计
milestones.headline_en: JLCEDA official launch: free domestic browser-based full PCB design flow
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国内创客、教育与中小企业普遍依赖 Altium Designer、OrCAD、PADS 等外国商业桌面 EDA，免费方案多为国外开源工具，缺少由本土制造龙头运营、规模化推广的国产在线平台。
milestones.before_gap_en: Makers, schools, and SMEs in China relied on foreign commercial desktop EDA (Altium Designer, OrCAD, PADS); free options were mostly foreign open-source tools, with no domestically operated cloud platform at comparable scale.
milestones.achievement_zh: 嘉立创集团以「立创EDA」品牌正式发布国产在线 EDA，浏览器内完成原理图、PCB 布局、3D 预览与 Gerber 导出，对个人用户免费开放，形成可替代外国中端桌面 EDA 的国产云原生入口。
milestones.achievement_en: JLC launched JLCEDA as a domestic online EDA: schematic, PCB layout, 3D preview, and Gerber export in the browser, free for individuals—establishing a cloud-native domestic alternative to foreign mid-tier desktop EDA.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高速/射频 SI-PI 签核、复杂 HDI/先进封装、企业级权限与 PLM/PDM 深度集成仍弱于 Altium 365、Cadence Allegro、Siemens Xpedition。
milestones.still_missing_en: High-speed/RF SI-PI signoff, advanced HDI/packaging, and enterprise PLM/PDM integration remain weaker than Altium 365, Cadence Allegro, and Siemens Xpedition.

sources.title: 立创EDA官网
立创EDA更新日志

milestones.headline_zh: 设计—下单一体化：EDA 内直连嘉立创 PCB/SMT 制造
milestones.headline_en: Design-to-order integration: native JLCPCB/SMT ordering inside the EDA
milestones.before_gap_zh: 外国 PCB EDA 通常止于 Gerber/BOM 导出，用户需在 EDA 外手动上传文件、对照海外或第三方元器件渠道下单国内代工，无原生「设计即下单」国产制造闭环。
milestones.before_gap_en: Foreign PCB EDA typically stopped at Gerber/BOM export; users manually uploaded files and matched parts via overseas or third-party channels before ordering domestic fabrication—no native design-to-fab closed loop.
milestones.achievement_zh: 立创EDA 与嘉立创 PCB 打样/批量及 SMT 贴片服务打通，可在设计环境内一键提交制造与组装订单，将外国 EDA 所不具备的本土代工直达能力嵌入工具链。
milestones.achievement_en: JLCEDA integrated JLCPCB prototyping/batch and SMT assembly, enabling one-click manufacturing orders from the design environment—a domestic fab-direct capability foreign EDA stacks did not offer.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 不支持外国 EMS 标准工单格式全覆盖；复杂 DFM 评审、可制造性自动签核仍不及 Cadence/Siemens 制造协同模块。
milestones.still_missing_en: Does not fully cover foreign EMS work-order formats; complex DFM review and manufacturability signoff still trail Cadence/Siemens manufacturing collaboration modules.

sources.title: 立创EDA官网
JLCPCB

milestones.headline_zh: 内嵌立创商城元器件库：BOM 与本土现货库存/价格实时联动
milestones.headline_en: Embedded LCSC parts library: BOM tied to domestic in-stock pricing
milestones.before_gap_zh: 外国 EDA 的元器件生态以 Octopart、Mouser、Digi-Key 等海外渠道为主，国内现货、国产替代料与批量采购价难以在设计阶段实时核对。
milestones.before_gap_en: Foreign EDA part ecosystems centered on Octopart, Mouser, and Digi-Key; domestic in-stock availability, local alternates, and China volume pricing were hard to verify during design.
milestones.achievement_zh: 立创EDA 深度集成立创商城（LCSC）元器件数据，设计时即可按国内现货、价格与封装选型并生成可采购 BOM，填补外国 EDA 长期缺失的本土化供应链数据层。
milestones.achievement_en: JLCEDA deeply integrated the LCSC parts database so designers could select components by domestic stock, price, and footprint and generate purchasable BOMs—filling a localization gap foreign EDA lacked.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨国大厂受控物料、车规/宇航级认证链路、与 SAP/Oracle 等企业采购系统对接仍弱于成熟 PLM/ERP 方案。
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-border controlled parts, automotive/aerospace qualified supply chains, and SAP/Oracle procurement integration remain weaker than mature PLM/ERP stacks.

sources.title: 立创EDA官网
LCSC Electronics

milestones.headline_zh: 立创EDA专业版发布：国产免费桌面离线多层板布局能力
milestones.headline_en: JLCEDA Pro release: free domestic desktop offline multi-layer PCB layout
milestones.before_gap_zh: 更复杂的多层板、离线设计与更高性能布线长期依赖 Altium Designer、PADS 等外国商业授权；国产在线版此前在性能与离线场景上不足以替代。
milestones.before_gap_en: More complex multi-layer boards, offline workflows, and higher-performance routing long depended on licensed foreign tools like Altium Designer and PADS; the earlier domestic online edition was insufficient for replacement.
milestones.achievement_zh: 立创EDA 发布专业版桌面客户端，支持离线使用并显著提升多层板布局与复杂设计能力，向外国中端商业 PCB 布局工具的功能带靠拢，且对个人用户仍免费开放。
milestones.achievement_en: JLCEDA shipped a Pro desktop client with offline use and stronger multi-layer layout for complex designs—closing toward foreign mid-tier commercial PCB layout tools while remaining free for individuals.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高端 HDI、任意阶盲埋孔、射频微波协同仿真、与 Allegro/Xpedition 同级的设计规则与团队协作治理仍有明显差距。
milestones.still_missing_en: Advanced HDI, arbitrary blind/buried vias, RF/microwave co-simulation, and team governance on par with Allegro/Xpedition still show clear gaps.

milestones.headline_zh: 金蝶云·苍穹正式发布，推出可组装企业级云 PaaS
milestones.headline_en: Kingdee Cloud Cosmic officially launched as composable enterprise cloud PaaS
milestones.before_gap_zh: 大型企业云 ERP 与云原生 PaaS 长期由 SAP S/4HANA Cloud、Oracle Fusion Cloud 等外资方案主导，国产厂商缺少可支撑集团级定制与扩展的云平台底座
milestones.before_gap_en: Large-enterprise cloud ERP and cloud-native PaaS were dominated by foreign stacks such as SAP S/4HANA Cloud and Oracle Fusion Cloud; domestic vendors lacked a group-grade composable cloud platform
milestones.achievement_zh: 金蝶在 2016 年启动苍穹大规模研发后，于 2018 年正式发布金蝶云·苍穹，定位为可组装企业级 PaaS，并逐步形成苍穹 PaaS + 星瀚大型 SaaS 的双层架构，为后续替代外资大型 ERP 提供云原生底座
milestones.achievement_en: After large-scale R&D starting in 2016, Kingdee officially released Kingdee Cloud Cosmic in 2018 as a composable enterprise PaaS, later evolving into a Cosmic PaaS plus Constellation/Xinghan large-enterprise SaaS stack that underpinned domestic replacement of foreign tier-1 ERP
milestones.still_missing_zh: 复杂跨国多法人制造场景、全球实施生态与外资巨头仍有差距
milestones.still_missing_en: Gaps remained in complex multinational multi-entity manufacturing, global implementation ecosystems, and parity with incumbent global vendors

milestones.headline_zh: 唯一入选 Gartner 产品中心型企业云 ERP 魔力象限的中国厂商
milestones.headline_en: Only Chinese vendor in Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Product-Centric Enterprises
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国际权威机构的产品中心型云 ERP 象限长期被 SAP、Oracle、Infor 等欧美厂商占据，中国本土云 ERP 缺乏可对标国际标准的第三方背书
milestones.before_gap_en: Gartner's product-centric cloud ERP Magic Quadrant had long been occupied by Western vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and Infor, with no credible third-party validation for Chinese cloud ERP
milestones.achievement_zh: 2021 年 9 月 Gartner 将金蝶纳入《产品中心型企业云 ERP 魔力象限》；金蝶年报披露其为唯一入选该象限的中国厂商，标志国产苍穹/星瀚云 ERP 在大型制造企业场景获得国际可比认可
milestones.achievement_en: In September 2021 Gartner placed Kingdee in the Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Product-Centric Enterprises; Kingdee's annual report states it is the only Chinese vendor included, marking credible international recognition for Cosmic/Constellation cloud ERP in large product-centric enterprises
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全球市场份额、行业深度套件与欧美头部客户基础仍远小于 SAP/Oracle
milestones.still_missing_en: Global market share, industry depth, and Western flagship customer bases still trail SAP and Oracle by a wide margin

milestones.headline_zh: 苍穹低代码/零代码 aPaaS 连续多年位居 IDC 中国市场第一
milestones.headline_en: Cosmic low-code/zero-code aPaaS ranked No. 1 in China by IDC for multiple consecutive years
milestones.before_gap_zh: 企业 ERP 扩展与定制开发长期依赖 SAP ABAP、Oracle APEX 或 Salesforce/Mendix 等外资低代码平台，国产大型 ERP 缺少同等可视化 aPaaS 能力
milestones.before_gap_en: ERP extension and customization relied on foreign low-code stacks such as SAP ABAP, Oracle APEX, Salesforce Platform, and Mendix; domestic large ERP lacked comparable visual aPaaS
milestones.achievement_zh: 金蝶基于苍穹 PaaS 构建低代码/零代码 aPaaS；2024 年业绩新闻稿援引 IDC 数据称已连续 4 次获得中国低代码与零代码 aPaaS 市场占有率第一，2025 业绩材料进一步表述为连续 5 年第一
milestones.achievement_en: Built on Cosmic PaaS, Kingdee's low-code/zero-code aPaaS was cited in the March 2024 results release as IDC China market-share leader for four consecutive periods, with FY2025 materials citing five consecutive years at No. 1
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨境 ISV 生态规模、全球开发者社区与平台开放标准影响力仍弱于 Salesforce 与 Microsoft Power Platform
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-border ISV ecosystem scale, global developer communities, and platform-standard influence remain weaker than Salesforce and Microsoft Power Platform

milestones.headline_zh: 苍穹/星瀚签约中石油、中国电子等央企集团，加速替代外资集团管控系统
milestones.headline_en: Cosmic/Constellation wins CNPC, China Electronics and other central SOEs, accelerating replacement of foreign group-governance ERP
milestones.before_gap_zh: 央企/国企集团财务共享、司库与多法人合并管控长期以 SAP ECC/S/4HANA 或 Oracle EBS/Fusion 为主，国产方案在超大型集团场景可信度不足
milestones.before_gap_en: Central SOE group financial shared services, treasury, and multi-entity consolidation had long relied on SAP ECC/S/4HANA or Oracle EBS/Fusion; domestic ERP lacked credibility at super-large group scale
milestones.achievement_zh: 金蝶 2024 年报新闻稿披露，紧抓大型企业国产化替代机遇，在央企、国企及 500 强领域取得显著进展；成功签约/中标中国石油天然气集团、中国电子、中国航空集团等领军企业，苍穹与星瀚合同签约额约 21 亿元、同比增长 51.9%
milestones.achievement_en: Kingdee's 2024 results release states it captured accelerated domestic-substitution demand among central SOEs, state-owned firms, and Fortune 500 accounts, signing or winning PetroChina, China Electronics, Air China Group and other flagship enterprises; Cosmic and Constellation contract value reached about RMB 2.1B, up 51.9% YoY
milestones.still_missing_zh: 超大型集团全集团全模块一次性替换外资核心仍少见；海外法人当地合规与深度制造集成案例少于 SAP
milestones.still_missing_en: Full group-wide rip-and-replace of foreign cores remains rare; overseas-entity local compliance and deep manufacturing integration cases still trail SAP

milestones.headline_zh: IDC 中国 SaaS 财务云/ERM 市场份额连续多年第一
milestones.headline_en: IDC ranks Kingdee No. 1 in China SaaS financial cloud and ERM for multiple consecutive years
milestones.before_gap_zh: 中国企业财务核算、司库与管理会计云市场长期由 SAP S/4HANA Finance、Oracle Financials Cloud 等外资财务云主导
milestones.before_gap_en: China's enterprise financial accounting, treasury, and management accounting cloud market had long been led by foreign suites such as SAP S/4HANA Finance and Oracle Financials Cloud
milestones.achievement_zh: 金蝶 2024 年业绩新闻稿援引 IDC 报告称，公司在 SaaS EA（企业应用云）、SaaS ERM（企业资源管理云）、财务云、EPM 等中国市场均排名第一；年报亦披露其在中国企业资源管理云市场多年稳居市占率第一
milestones.achievement_en: Kingdee's March 2024 results release cites IDC data ranking it No. 1 in China for SaaS EA, SaaS ERM, financial cloud, and EPM; the annual report also states multi-year No. 1 share in China's enterprise resource management cloud market
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全球合并报表准则覆盖、超复杂关联交易与跨国税务引擎仍弱于 Oracle/SAP
milestones.still_missing_en: Global consolidation standards coverage, highly complex related-party accounting, and multinational tax engines remain weaker than Oracle and SAP

milestones.headline_zh: 1000kV 特高压交流保护与控制成套国产化首投运（晋东南—南阳—荆门）
milestones.headline_en: First localized 1000 kV UHV AC protection and control suite commissioned (Jindongnan–Nanyang–Jingmen)
milestones.before_gap_zh: 特高压交流保护、测控与站控层高度依赖 ABB、Siemens、Alstom 超高压保护及进口站控，国产厂商无特高压工程成套验证
milestones.before_gap_en: UHV AC protection, measurement/control, and station-layer systems heavily relied on ABB/Siemens/Alstom EHV relays and imported station control; domestic vendors lacked UHV turnkey field proof
milestones.achievement_zh: 南瑞为晋东南—南阳—荆门世界首条商用 1000kV 交流特高压工程提供保护、测控、合并单元及站控层成套设备，2009 年 1 月投运，实现特高压控制保护核心能力的进口替代
milestones.achievement_en: NARI supplied protection, measurement/control, merging units, and station-layer equipment for the world's first commercial 1000 kV AC UHV line (Jindongnan–Nanyang–Jingmen), commissioned January 2009, localizing core UHV protection and control
milestones.still_missing_zh: 柔性直流控保、海外 EPC 总包品牌认知仍弱于 ABB/Siemens；部分高端芯片/FPGA 仍进口
milestones.still_missing_en: VSC-HVDC protection and overseas EPC brand recognition remain weaker than ABB/Siemens; some high-end chips/FPGAs remain imported

milestones.headline_en: First localized ±800 kV UHV DC control and protection commissioned (Xiangjiaba–Shanghai)
milestones.before_gap_zh: ±800kV 特高压直流换流站控保与站控长期由 ABB HVDC、Siemens 等进口方案主导，国产厂商无同等电压等级工程实绩
milestones.before_gap_en: ±800 kV UHV DC converter-station control and protection was dominated by ABB HVDC and Siemens imports; domestic vendors lacked field proof at this voltage class
milestones.achievement_zh: 南瑞为向家坝—上海 ±800kV 特高压直流示范工程提供换流站控保与监控成套设备，2010 年 7 月正式投运，打破特高压直流核心控保进口垄断
milestones.achievement_en: NARI supplied converter-station control, protection, and monitoring for the Xiangjiaba–Shanghai ±800 kV UHV DC demonstration project, commissioned July 2010, breaking import monopoly on core UHV DC control/protection
milestones.still_missing_zh: 柔性直流控保、海外 EPC 总包品牌仍弱于 ABB/Siemens；关键功率器件与部分芯片仍依赖进口
milestones.still_missing_en: VSC-HVDC protection and overseas EPC brand recognition remain weaker than ABB/Siemens; key power devices and some chips still imported

milestones.headline_zh: 收购西门子 Solid Edge 全部应用源码与测试体系，实现国产厂商对主流三维 MCAD 源码级可控
milestones.headline_en: Acquired full Siemens Solid Edge application source and test suite—first disclosed source-level control of a mainstream 3D MCAD stack by a Chinese vendor
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国内三维 CAD 以自研内核或内核 OEM 为主，尚无厂商公开取得国际主流历史造型+装配级三维 CAD 完整应用源码与知识产权，断供与授权风险制约中高端替代。
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic 3D CAD relied on in-house or OEM kernels; no vendor had publicly obtained full application source and IP of an international mainstream history-based MCAD at Solid Edge tier, leaving cut-off and licensing risk for mid-high substitution.
milestones.achievement_zh: 2022年8月与西门子完成交易，取得 Solid Edge 全部源代码、知识产权及整套软件测试系统，获开发/修改/编译/发行权，官方称源码100%可控，为后续天工CAD国产化替代奠定底座。
milestones.achievement_en: In August 2022 Newdim closed the deal for full Solid Edge source code, IP, and the complete test suite with rights to develop, modify, compile, and distribute—claimed 100% source controllability—as the base for Tiangong CAD domestic substitution.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 几何底座仍为西门子 Parasolid，非自研 B-rep；高端曲面与 NX/CATIA 级能力仍有差距。
milestones.still_missing_en: Geometry base remains Siemens Parasolid, not an owned B-rep; high-end surfacing and NX/CATIA-class capabilities still lag.

milestones.headline_zh: 取得 Parasolid 与 D-Cubed DCM 永久授权，缓解国产中高端三维 CAD 内核断供风险
milestones.headline_en: Secured perpetual Parasolid and D-Cubed DCM licenses, reducing kernel cut-off risk for domestic mid-high 3D CAD
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产 Parasolid 路线产品多依赖常规商业 OEM 授权，在出口管制与供应链波动下存在内核停供隐患，信创与政企采购对“可持续授权”要求高。
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic Parasolid-route products mostly relied on standard commercial OEM licenses vulnerable to export controls and supply shocks; xinchuang and government procurement demanded sustainable kernel licensing.
milestones.achievement_zh: 随 Solid Edge 源码交易，新迪披露对底层 Parasolid、DCM 约束求解器等内核引擎的永久授权安排，官方称解决断供风险，支撑信创场景下的可持续部署叙事。
milestones.achievement_en: Bundled with the Solid Edge source deal, Newdim disclosed perpetual licensing for underlying Parasolid and DCM constraint engines, officially framed as eliminating cut-off risk for sustainable xinchuang-era deployment.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 永久授权不等于内核自主；国产自研几何/约束内核替换仍在路线图中。
milestones.still_missing_en: Perpetual license is not kernel ownership; migration to fully domestic geometry/constraint kernels remains on the roadmap.

milestones.headline_zh: 发布新迪天工CAD，首款对标国际中高端成熟度、可商用替代的国产三维 MCAD
milestones.headline_en: Launched Newdim Tiangong CAD—the first domestic 3D MCAD marketed at international mid-high maturity for commercial import substitution
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产三维 CAD 在装配、钣金、工程图、异构互操作与企业级稳定性上与国际 Solid Edge/SolidWorks 存在明显体验与成熟度差距，难以“真买真用真替代”。
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic 3D CAD lagged international Solid Edge/SolidWorks in assembly, sheet metal, drafting, interoperability, and enterprise stability—blocking genuine buy-use-replace adoption.
milestones.achievement_zh: 2023年4月21日正式推出新迪天工CAD：融合 Solid Edge 技术传承与二十年研发积累，提供大型软件架构、丰富建模功能、多格式读写及二次开发 API，面向企业三维 CAD 正版化与国产替代。
milestones.achievement_en: On 21 April 2023 Newdim released Tiangong CAD combining Solid Edge lineage with 20 years of R&D—large-scale architecture, rich modeling, multi-format IO, and extensibility APIs for enterprise legalization and domestic substitution.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 企业级装机案例仍在快速积累；高端复杂曲面与航空级场景仍弱于达索/西门子旗舰产品。
milestones.still_missing_en: Enterprise install references still ramping; high-end complex surfacing and aerospace-grade scenarios remain weaker than Dassault/Siemens flagships.

milestones.headline_zh: 天工CAD 落地同步建模（Synchronous Technology）直接编辑，打破该能力长期依赖进口 Solid Edge 的局面
milestones.headline_en: Tiangong CAD ships Synchronous Technology direct editing—breaking long reliance on imported Solid Edge for this capability domestically
milestones.before_gap_zh: 同步建模/无历史顺序直接编辑是 Solid Edge 标志性能力（ST 自2008年引入），国内自研三维 CAD 普遍以传统特征树参数化为主，难以提供同等 ST 体验。
milestones.before_gap_en: Synchronous Technology direct editing was a Solid Edge hallmark (ST since 2008); domestic 3D CAD mostly offered classic feature-tree parametrics without equivalent ST UX.
milestones.achievement_zh: 天工CAD 继承 Solid Edge ST 技术路线，在国产桌面端提供同步建模直接编辑，使用户无需完全依赖进口 Solid Edge 即可获得历史+直接混合建模工作流。

milestones.still_missing_zh: 与 NX 同步技术、Creo Flexible Modeling 等旗舰级直接编辑生态的第三方教程/插件体量仍有差距。
milestones.still_missing_en: Third-party tutorials/plugins ecosystem still trails flagship direct-edit stacks such as NX Synchronous Technology and Creo Flexible Modeling.

milestones.still_missing_en: Civilian OEM durability/crash stacks still favor Ansys/LS-DYNA; large-assembly solver throughput, global material libraries, and third-party public benchmarks still trail flagship international tools

milestones.headline_zh: 构力科技发布 PKPM-CAE 国产通用仿真云计算平台
milestones.headline_en: CCTC launches PKPM-CAE domestic general-purpose cloud CAE platform
milestones.before_gap_zh: 通用 CAE 的云端前后处理与弹性算力长期由 Ansys Cloud、SimScale 及海外 HPC 平台主导；国产厂商缺少可面向工业装备/能源等场景的浏览器端通用仿真云底座
milestones.before_gap_en: General CAE cloud pre/post and elastic compute were led by Ansys Cloud, SimScale, and overseas HPC; no domestic vendor offered a browser-based general simulation cloud for industrial equipment and energy sectors
milestones.achievement_zh: 构力科技发布 PKPM-CAE，以自主有限元求解器为核心、Web 端完成建模-求解-后处理闭环，并与 PKPM 结构设计数据协同，形成国产通用 CAE 云服务形态
milestones.achievement_en: CCTC released PKPM-CAE with an owned FEM solver, web-based model-solve-post pipeline, and data sync with PKPM structural design—establishing a domestic general CAE cloud service model
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全球多区域云节点、第三方求解器插件生态与汽车/航空旗舰案例仍明显少于 Ansys Cloud
milestones.still_missing_en: Global cloud regions, third-party solver plug-in ecosystem, and flagship auto/aero references still trail Ansys Cloud

sources.title: 构力科技 PKPM-CAE

milestones.headline_zh: PKPM-CAE 提供自主通用三维结构有限元求解，拓展至工业装备/能源通用 CAE 场景
milestones.headline_en: PKPM-CAE delivers owned general 3D structural FEM beyond building-specific PKPM modules
milestones.before_gap_zh: 建筑行业以外及复杂通用结构仿真（压力容器、装备构件、大型钢结构细部分析等）长期依赖 ANSYS Mechanical、ABAQUS、MSC Nastran 等进口通用求解器；PKPM 结构版主要覆盖房屋建筑国标设计链
milestones.before_gap_en: Outside civil building workflows, general structural simulation (pressure vessels, equipment parts, detailed steel analysis) relied on imported solvers such as ANSYS Mechanical, ABAQUS, and MSC Nastran; PKPM Structure focused on GB-code building design
milestones.achievement_zh: PKPM-CAE 以自主通用有限元内核支持实体/壳/梁等单元与线性/非线性结构分析，将建研院仿真能力从房屋结构扩展至工业装备与能源等通用 CAE 领域
milestones.achievement_en: PKPM-CAE extends CABR simulation with an owned general FEM core (solid/shell/beam, linear/nonlinear) from civil buildings into industrial equipment and energy CAE domains
milestones.still_missing_zh: 显式动力学、高级材料本构与大规模并行效率仍弱于 ABAQUS/LS-DYNA；国际第三方基准公开案例偏少
milestones.still_missing_en: Explicit dynamics, advanced constitutive models, and large-scale parallel efficiency still trail ABAQUS/LS-DYNA; fewer published international benchmark cases

sources.title: 构力科技 PKPM-CAE
中国建筑科学研究院

milestones.headline_zh: PKPM-CAE 上线结构-热-流多物理场耦合，对标国际商业多物理场平台
milestones.headline_en: PKPM-CAE adds coupled structural-thermal-fluid multiphysics on domestic cloud
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产平台此前难以在统一云环境中提供结构-热-流耦合工业仿真；复杂多物理场长期依赖 COMSOL、Ansys Workbench、Siemens Simcenter 等进口集成环境
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic platforms lacked unified cloud environments for coupled structural-thermal-fluid industrial simulation; complex multiphysics relied on imported stacks such as COMSOL, Ansys Workbench, and Siemens Simcenter
milestones.achievement_zh: PKPM-CAE 后续版本在单一国产云平台上集成结构、热与流体等求解模块及耦合分析流程，缩小与进口多物理场 CAE 在功能覆盖上的差距
milestones.achievement_en: Later PKPM-CAE releases integrated structural, thermal, and CFD solvers with coupled workflows on a single domestic cloud—closing functional coverage gaps vs imported multiphysics CAE
milestones.still_missing_zh: 电磁场、高级湍流模型与第三方 CAE 互操作仍弱于 COMSOL/Ansys；工业用户第三方验证文献有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Electromagnetics, advanced turbulence models, and third-party CAE interoperability still trail COMSOL/Ansys; limited third-party validation literature

sources.title: 构力科技 PKPM-CAE

milestones.headline_zh: PKPM 结构产品线完成信创全栈适配，可在国产 CPU/操作系统上承担生产级设计
milestones.headline_en: PKPM Structure completes full xinchuang stack adaptation for production design on domestic CPU/OS
milestones.before_gap_zh: 龙芯/飞腾/鲲鹏+麒麟/统信环境下缺少可承担“结构建模-有限元分析-国标出图-审查对接”全流程的国产商用 CAE；设计院信创终端只能回退 Windows+Intel 运行 ETABS/SAP2000
milestones.before_gap_en: On LoongArch/Phytium/Kunpeng + Kylin/UOS stacks, no commercial CAE covered structural modeling-FEM-GB drawing-review end-to-end; xinchuang desktops had to fall back to Windows+Intel running ETABS/SAP2000
milestones.achievement_zh: 构力科技完成 PKPM 结构等核心产品对国产处理器、操作系统与基础软件适配，进入信创采购与国资设计院选型，在政府/央企项目中系统性替代 Windows 平台上的进口结构软件组合
milestones.achievement_en: CCTC completed PKPM Structure adaptation to domestic processors, OS, and base software, entering xinchuang procurement and SOE design-institute selections—systematically substituting imported structural stacks on Windows in government/central-SOE projects
milestones.still_missing_zh: GPU 加速大规模并行求解、国际项目生态与第三方插件市场仍落后于 x86+NVIDIA 国际栈
milestones.still_missing_en: GPU-accelerated large-scale parallel solving, international project ecosystem, and third-party plug-in markets still trail x86+NVIDIA international stacks

sources.title: 构力科技 PKPM
中国工业互联网研究院 信创产品名录

milestones.headline_zh: PKPM-SAUSG 支撑 2008 奥运场馆等复杂空间结构弹塑性抗震分析
milestones.headline_en: PKPM-SAUSG supports elastic-plastic seismic analysis for 2008 Olympic venues and complex spatial structures
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国家体育场等大跨度、不规则空间结构在抗震专项论证中需精细弹塑性动力分析，当时多依赖 ABAQUS、SAP2000 非线性模块或 DRAIN-3D 等进口/境外工具链，国产线性 PKPM 无法覆盖
milestones.before_gap_en: Seismic review of the National Stadium and other irregular spatial structures required fine inelastic dynamic analysis, typically via ABAQUS, SAP2000 nonlinear modules, or DRAIN-3D—beyond what linear domestic PKPM could deliver
milestones.achievement_zh: 建研院地震工程研究所自主 SAUSG 以纤维/多弹簧单元完成奥运场馆等复杂建筑弹塑性时程与性能评估，在国家级公建项目中形成可审查的国产非线性 CAE 交付能力
milestones.achievement_en: CABR's in-house SAUSG used fiber/multi-spring elements for elastic-plastic time-history and performance evaluation on Olympic venues—establishing reviewable domestic nonlinear CAE delivery on flagship public projects
milestones.still_missing_zh: 显式大变形/倒塌分析仍弱于 LS-DYNA；国际第三方基准与英文文献引用少于 ABAQUS
milestones.still_missing_en: Explicit large-deformation/collapse analysis still trails LS-DYNA; fewer international benchmarks and English citations vs ABAQUS

sources.title: 中国建筑科学研究院
构力科技 PKPM-SAUSG

milestones.headline_zh: 《超限高层建筑工程抗震设防专项审查技术要点》落地，SAUSG 成为超限审查弹塑性时程主用国产工具
milestones.headline_en: Beyond-code tall-building special review technical points issued—SAUSG becomes primary domestic tool for mandatory inelastic time-history review
milestones.before_gap_zh: 超限高层抗震专项审查要求的弹塑性动力时程与性能点论证长期由 CSI Perform3D、DRAIN 或 ABAQUS 完成，审查机构难以在国产软件上复现同等非线性分析链
milestones.before_gap_en: Mandatory elastic-plastic time-history and performance-point proofs for beyond-code tall-building special review were done in CSI Perform3D, DRAIN, or ABAQUS—hard for reviewers to reproduce on domestic software
milestones.achievement_zh: 住房城乡建设部印发超限审查技术要点（建质〔2010〕109号），明确复杂超限工程需开展弹塑性分析；建研院 SAUSG/PKPM-SAUSG 在国内超限专家论证中规模化应用，形成对进口 Perform3D 工作流的国产替代路径
milestones.achievement_en: MOHURD issued the beyond-code special-review technical points (Jianzhi [2010] No. 109), requiring inelastic analysis on complex beyond-code projects; CABR SAUSG/PKPM-SAUSG scaled in domestic expert reviews—creating a domestic substitute path for imported Perform3D workflows
milestones.still_missing_zh: 与 ETABS/SAP 双向模型联邦仍不如 CSI 原生生态；外资主导项目偶仍指定 Perform3D
milestones.still_missing_en: Bidirectional model federation with ETABS/SAP still weaker than CSI native stack; foreign-led projects occasionally still specify Perform3D

sources.title: 住房和城乡建设部
CSI Perform3D

milestones.headline_zh: 新抗规 GB50011-2010 实施，PKPM-SAUSG 支撑性能化抗震弹塑性时程国标落地
milestones.headline_en: GB 50011-2010 takes effect—PKPM-SAUSG enables national-code performance-based elastic-plastic time-history analysis
milestones.before_gap_zh: 《建筑抗震设计规范》GB50011-2010 引入基于性能的抗震设计与弹塑性分析条款后，国内设计院缺少与国标性能目标（小震/中震/大震）直接挂钩的商用非线性求解器，仍依赖进口软件后处理
milestones.before_gap_en: After GB 50011-2010 introduced performance-based seismic design and inelastic analysis, Chinese designers lacked commercial nonlinear solvers tied directly to national performance objectives—still depending on imported post-processing tools
milestones.achievement_zh: PKPM-SAUSG 提供 Pushover、弹塑性动力时程与性能点评估，并与 PKPM 结构设计模型协同，使性能化抗震分析可在国产平台闭环完成，替代“ETABS/Perform3D 分析 + 人工规范对照”流程
milestones.achievement_en: PKPM-SAUSG delivers pushover, elastic-plastic time-history, and performance-point evaluation coordinated with PKPM structural models—closing performance-based seismic analysis on a domestic platform and replacing ETABS/Perform3D plus manual code cross-check workflows
milestones.still_missing_zh: 减隔震/屈曲约束支撑等新型构件本构更新节奏仍需持续跟进新专项规程；通用显式非线性弱于 LS-DYNA
milestones.still_missing_en: Constitutive updates for isolation/BRB components still need ongoing code tracking; general explicit nonlinear remains weaker than LS-DYNA

sources.title: 国家标准全文公开系统 GB 50011-2010
构力科技 PKPM-SAUSG

milestones.headline_zh: PKPM 首版在微机上实现国产框架-剪力墙有限元分析与国标配筋设计
milestones.headline_en: PKPM v1 ships domestic frame-shear-wall FEM with GB-code member design on PCs
milestones.before_gap_zh: 1980年代国内多层/高层混凝土结构设计多依赖手工计算、Fortran 自编程序或 STAAD/SAP 等进口通用求解器；后者不含中国混凝土/抗震规范参数，无法直接完成国标构件设计与配筋
milestones.before_gap_en: In the 1980s, Chinese RC building design relied on hand calculation, in-house Fortran, or imported general solvers (STAAD/SAP); none embedded Chinese concrete/seismic code parameters for direct GB member design and reinforcement
milestones.achievement_zh: 中国建筑科学研究院发布 PKPM（Programming System for Kuang-Jia Ping-Mian），在微机上集成自主平面杆系/楼板有限元求解与中国早期国标构件验算，开启可规模化商用的国产房屋结构 CAE 路线
milestones.achievement_en: CABR released PKPM on PCs with an owned plane-frame/slab FEM solver integrated with early Chinese code member checks—launching scalable commercial domestic building-structural CAE
milestones.still_missing_zh: 复杂三维非线性、空间钢结构细部分析及国际规范版仍缺；高端超高层仍逐步引入进口专用求解器
milestones.still_missing_en: Complex 3D nonlinear, detailed spatial steel analysis, and international code editions were absent; supertall niches still adopted imported specialty solvers

sources.title: 中国建筑科学研究院官网
构力科技 PKPM

milestones.headline_zh: PKPM2000 获国家科技进步二等奖，打通建模-分析-国标施工图自动生成闭环
milestones.headline_en: PKPM2000 wins National S&T Progress Award (2nd class) — model-analyze-GB drawing automation closed loop
milestones.before_gap_zh: 1990年代即使采用 SAP2000/ETABS/STAAD 完成力学分析，工程师仍需人工对照《混凝土/钢结构/抗震规范》逐条校核并手工绘制施工图；进口软件无法输出符合国内审查习惯的参数化施工图
milestones.before_gap_en: Through the 1990s, even with SAP2000/ETABS/STAAD analysis, engineers manually cross-checked GB concrete/steel/seismic provisions and hand-drafted drawings; imported tools could not output parametric construction drawings acceptable to Chinese review practice
milestones.achievement_zh: 建研院 PKPM2000 系列获国家科学技术进步二等奖（建筑工程结构设计 CAD 软件系统 PKPM 系列），形成自主有限元内核+国标构造/配筋规则+施工图自动生成一体化，在勘察设计单位规模化替代“进口分析+手工出图”流程
milestones.achievement_en: CABR's PKPM2000 series won the National Science and Technology Progress Award (2nd class) for the PKPM structural CAD system—owned FEM core plus GB detailing rules and automated construction drawings, replacing imported-analysis-plus-manual-drafting at scale in design institutes
milestones.still_missing_zh: 欧/美规范施工图、复杂节点非线性细部及通用显式分析仍依赖国际软件
milestones.still_missing_en: Euro/US drawing automation, refined joint nonlinear detail, and general explicit analysis still relied on international tools

milestones.headline_zh: 配合施工图数字化审查试点，PKPM 成为国标自动校审与审查对接的事实标准
milestones.headline_en: With digital drawing-review pilots, PKPM becomes de-facto standard for automated GB checking and review handoff
milestones.before_gap_zh: 施工图审查长期依赖纸质蓝图与人工逐条对照规范；即便使用进口 ETABS/SAP2000 分析，审查环节仍无法自动核验配筋、抗震等级与构造是否符合国标
milestones.before_gap_en: Drawing review relied on paper blueprints and manual code cross-checks; even with ETABS/SAP2000 analysis, review could not automatically verify GB reinforcement, seismic categories, and detailing
milestones.achievement_zh: 住建部推动施工图设计文件数字化审查试点（建办〔2004〕41号）后，PKPM 将混凝土/钢结构/抗震/地基等 GB 系列规范参数化进求解与出图模块，并与各地在线审查系统对接，形成“建模-分析-规范验算-审查数据包”国产闭环，进口软件退居复杂专项或外资项目
milestones.achievement_en: After MOHURD's digital drawing-review pilot (Jianban [2004] No. 41), PKPM parameterized GB concrete/steel/seismic/foundation rules into solvers and drawings and interfaced with online review systems—domestic model-analyze-check-review loop while imports retreated to niche or foreign-led projects
milestones.still_missing_zh: 国际规范自动审图、境外业主指定求解器审查链仍弱于在位产品
milestones.still_missing_en: International-code automated review and foreign-owner mandated solver review chains remained weaker than incumbents

milestones.headline_zh: NanoSpice 系列入选工信部「2022年工业软件优秀产品」
milestones.headline_en: NanoSpice family named in MIIT '2022 Outstanding Industrial Software Products' list
milestones.before_gap_zh: 晶体管级电路仿真（SPICE/FastSPICE）长期被 Synopsys、Cadence、Siemens EDA 点工具垄断，国产方案缺少部委级工业软件名录背书
milestones.before_gap_en: Transistor-level SPICE/FastSPICE simulation was dominated by Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA point tools, with no domestic entrant on MIIT industrial-software honor rolls
milestones.achievement_zh: 工信部公布 2022 年工业软件优秀产品名单（含 CAD/EDA/ERP/PLM/MES 等 69 款），概伦 NanoSpice 系列晶体管级电路仿真器入选；官方称该系列可处理超五千万晶体管、十亿级寄生 RC 规模的高精度仿真
milestones.achievement_en: MIIT published the 2022 Outstanding Industrial Software Products list (69 products across CAD/EDA/ERP/PLM/MES); Primarius NanoSpice transistor-level simulators were selected, with vendor claims of >50M-transistor and billion-parasitic RC capacity
milestones.still_missing_zh: 名录不等于市占率；与外资工具在先进节点全芯片签核的份额对比未披露
milestones.still_missing_en: Listing does not imply market share; share vs foreign tools on advanced full-chip sign-off is undisclosed

sources.title: NanoSpice系列仿真器荣登工信部“2022年工业软件优秀产品”名单

milestones.headline_zh: 科创板招股书披露 BSIMPro 器件建模工具进入三星、台积电等国际晶圆厂客户群
milestones.headline_en: STAR Market IPO prospectus discloses BSIMPro device modeling adopted by Samsung, TSMC and other international foundries
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国内晶圆厂与设计公司的紧凑模型提取、质检与交付几乎清一色采购 Keysight IC-CAP / Silvaco Utmost / Mentor Model Explorer，本土无可对标量产交付的器件建模平台
milestones.before_gap_en: Chinese fabs and design houses relied almost entirely on Keysight IC-CAP, Silvaco Utmost and Mentor Model Explorer for compact-model extraction, QA and delivery—no domestic production-grade equivalent
milestones.achievement_zh: 概伦电子科创板招股说明书披露：BSIMPro 等器件建模产品已获三星、台积电、美光、中芯国际等国内外领先集成电路企业量产采用，标志国产器件建模软件首次在国际头部晶圆厂获得与外资工具同台量产交付能力
milestones.achievement_en: Primarius STAR IPO prospectus states BSIMPro and related device-modeling products were adopted in production by Samsung, TSMC, Micron, SMIC and other leading IC companies—first domestic platform with production-grade delivery parity at international tier-1 foundries
milestones.still_missing_zh: 招股书亦坦承模拟/数字全流程、制造类签核工具仍薄弱；单点器件建模≠完整模拟设计平台
milestones.still_missing_en: Prospectus also notes weakness in full analog/digital flows and manufacturing signoff—point device modeling ≠ complete analog design platform

metrics.label_zh: 国际头部晶圆厂客户披露

sources.title: 概伦电子首次公开发行股票并在科创板上市招股说明书

milestones.headline_zh: NanoSpice Giga 在存储器大规模后仿中取代 FastSPICE 折中方案
milestones.headline_en: NanoSpice Giga displaces FastSPICE trade-offs in large-scale memory post-layout simulation
milestones.before_gap_zh: DRAM/Flash/SRAM 等大容量存储电路后仿普遍依赖 Synopsys FineSim/HSIM、Cadence UltraSim 等 FastSPICE；在精度与容量之间被迫牺牲签核裕度
milestones.before_gap_en: Large memory post-layout flows relied on Synopsys FineSim/HSIM and Cadence UltraSim FastSPICE engines, trading accuracy for capacity on sign-off-critical nets
milestones.achievement_zh: 概伦官方案例称 NanoSpice Giga 以千兆级并行 SPICE 引擎在存储器产品设计中“强势取代 FastSPICE”，在保持 SPICE 级精度的同时覆盖更大规模网表；同期披露 NanoSpice 系列已获全球几十家主流 IC 设计公司认可并大规模用于存储器及 10nm/7nm SoC/IP 设计
milestones.achievement_en: Primarius reported NanoSpice Giga 'strongly replacing FastSPICE' in memory design with giga-scale parallel SPICE accuracy; by 2018–2019 the NanoSpice family was adopted by dozens of leading global IC designers for memory and 10nm/7nm SoC/IP flows
milestones.still_missing_zh: 公开材料未给出与具体外资工具逐网表 benchmark 数据；模拟全流程（原理图/版图/物理验证）仍非单点 NanoSpice 可覆盖
milestones.still_missing_en: Public materials lack head-to-head netlist benchmarks vs named incumbents; full custom analog flow (schematic/layout/PV) is not covered by NanoSpice alone

metrics.label_zh: 全球主流设计公司采用披露
metrics.value: Dozens of leading IC companies within ~3 years of launch (2018 OIP post)

milestones.headline_zh: NanoSpice Pro X 获「中国芯」EDA 技术创新奖，官方称打破外资全芯片 FastSPICE 垄断
milestones.headline_en: NanoSpice Pro X wins China Core EDA Innovation Award; vendor cites breaking foreign full-chip FastSPICE monopoly
milestones.before_gap_zh: 存储器/SoC 全芯片晶体管级快速仿真长期由 Synopsys FineSim、Cadence UltraSim 等外资 FastSPICE 主导，国内无同等精度与容量的一站式方案
milestones.before_gap_en: Full-chip transistor-level fast simulation for memory/SoC was led by Synopsys FineSim and Cadence UltraSim; China lacked a domestic one-stop solution with comparable accuracy and capacity
milestones.achievement_zh: 概伦「高精度大容量全芯片晶体管级电路快速仿真技术」NanoSpice Pro X 获首届「中国芯」EDA 专项「EDA 技术创新奖」；公司称经与成熟商用仿真器基准对比，该技术打破国外厂商垄断、填补国内市场空白，并在存储器电路仿真细分领域处于国际领先
milestones.achievement_en: Primarius 'high-precision, high-capacity full-chip transistor-level fast simulation' (NanoSpice Pro X) won the inaugural China Core EDA Innovation Award; the company states benchmark data vs mature commercial simulators show it breaks foreign monopoly, fills a domestic gap, and leads internationally in memory-circuit simulation

milestones.still_missing_en: Award and vendor claims are not third-party audited share data; mixed-signal co-simulation, digital front-end and manufacturing sign-off still rely on foreign tools or other Primarius products

milestones.achievement_zh: 工信部公布首批5家「双跨」工业互联网平台，树根互联根云与海尔卡奥斯、徐工汉云、富士康、阿里云等并列入选，国产装备工业互联网云首次进入国家级跨行业基础设施序列

milestones.still_missing_zh: 非装备行业渗透、全球化多区域合规运营、与外资全栈数字化线程深度集成仍弱于国际龙头
milestones.still_missing_en: Penetration outside equipment sectors, global multi-region compliance ops, and deep integration with foreign full-stack digital threads still trail international leaders

milestones.before_gap_en: Large-scale construction-equipment fleet telematics relied on foreign industrial IoT platforms or overseas telco/cloud bundles; no domestic platform had equivalent production-scale proof
milestones.achievement_zh: 2018年汉诺威工业博览会发布根云3.0，公开披露已连接超40万台高价值工业设备，以国产根云替代外资工业云承担三一系主机厂车队数据采集主平台
milestones.achievement_en: At Hannover Messe 2018 RootCloud 3.0 publicly disclosed 400k+ connected high-value machines, with the domestic RootCloud stack replacing foreign industrial clouds as the primary fleet data-acquisition platform for the Sany ecosystem
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨主机厂中立交付、非三一行业协议深度与海外合规数据中心布局仍不足

milestones.headline_zh: 根云团队核心贡献的 Apache IoTDB 晋升为 Apache 顶级项目并进入国产工业时序栈
milestones.headline_en: Apache IoTDB—co-developed by the RootCloud team—graduates to Apache TLP for domestic industrial time-series stacks
milestones.before_gap_zh: 工业设备高频时序入库与查询长期依赖 OSIsoft PI、AVEVA Historian 等国外 Historian 或通用 TSDB，缺少可大规模嵌入国产工业互联网平台的自主工业时序内核
milestones.before_gap_en: High-frequency industrial time-series ingest/query depended on OSIsoft PI, AVEVA Historian, or generic TSDBs without an owned industrial time-series core embeddable in domestic IIoT platforms
milestones.achievement_zh: 由树根互联/清华团队联合发起的 Apache IoTDB 于2020年1月成为 Apache 顶级项目，提供面向物联网的原生时序数据模型与列式存储引擎，并被根云等国产工业互联网平台采用以替代 PI 类 Historian 组件
milestones.achievement_en: Apache IoTDB, initiated by the RootCloud/Tsinghua team, became an Apache top-level project in Jan 2020 with IoT-native time-series schema and columnar storage, adopted by RootCloud and other domestic IIoT stacks to replace PI-class historian components
milestones.still_missing_zh: 流程行业存量 PI 资产迁移工具链、极端规模跨园区联邦查询生态仍弱于 OSIsoft/Aveva
milestones.still_missing_en: Legacy PI asset migration toolchains and extreme-scale cross-campus federated query ecosystems still trail OSIsoft/Aveva

milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic laser cut/engrave lines long bought imported nesting CAM (SigmaNEST, Lantek Expert, JETCAM) separate from domestic motion stacks; Ruida RDC install base lacked a vendor-owned professional nesting product
milestones.achievement_zh: 睿达科技独立研发 RDNest 套料软件，支持矩形/异形板材套料、内孔排样（水平/垂直/自动）、一键自动排料，以及 DXF/AI/PLT 零件与板材导入
milestones.achievement_en: Ruida independently developed RDNest with rectangular/irregular-sheet nesting, inner-hole nesting (horizontal/vertical/auto), one-click auto nesting, and DXF/AI/PLT part/sheet import
milestones.still_missing_zh: 来源未使用「真形」表述（仅「异形板材套料」）；无第三方市占或「进口替代」认证；钢结构厚板、共边切割与 MES 深度弱于 Lantek/SigmaNEST

milestones.before_gap_en: In the early 2000s, Chinese power and building-materials process control was dominated by imported Honeywell TDC/Experion, Emerson Ovation, and Yokogawa CENTUM DCS; domestic vendors lacked a scalable redundant DCS
milestones.achievement_zh: 科远（后更名科远智慧）推出具有自主知识产权的 NT6000 DCS，形成控制器冗余、I/O 总线冗余与历史站/工程师站分离架构，为后续在火电与水泥线进口替代奠定产品基座

milestones.still_missing_zh: 当时大型炼化全厂级集成、高端现场仪表与先进控制优化仍依赖进口方案
milestones.still_missing_en: Mega-refinery plant-wide integration, high-end field instruments, and advanced control optimization still relied on imported stacks at the time

milestones.achievement_en: SCIYON NT6000 DCS was applied to Guangdong Yudean Jinghai Power Plant's 1000 MW expansion units (#5/#6), entering service in 2008–2009—one of the landmark domestic substitutions on 1000 MW ultra-supercritical coal units

milestones.before_gap_en: Before the 2010s, cement kiln, batching, and WHR control was dominated by Siemens PCS 7, ABB, and other imported DCS/PLC stacks

milestones.still_missing_zh: 航空级质量体系、复杂多阶 BOM 逆向追溯与 Opcenter Quality 行业模板仍有差距
milestones.still_missing_en: Aerospace-grade QMS, complex multi-level BOM backward traceability, and Opcenter Quality industry templates still lag

milestones.achievement_zh: 赛意发布 SMOM 信创版本，完成与麒麟操作系统、达梦/人大金仓等国产数据库及鲲鹏等国产芯片平台的兼容认证，可在信创环境替代原外资 OS/DB 上的 MES 部署
milestones.achievement_en: SIE shipped a Xinchuang edition of SMOM with compatibility certification on Kylin OS, Dameng/Kingbase domestic databases, and Kunpeng CPUs—enabling MES deployment on domestic stacks instead of foreign OS/DB combinations
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全栈信创环境下大规模性能压测数据、与进口实时数据库/historian 互联案例仍少于主流外资组合
milestones.still_missing_en: Large-scale performance benchmarks on full Xinchuang stacks and interop cases with import historians remain fewer than mainstream foreign combinations

milestones.before_gap_en: In the 1990s Chinese machinery and equipment firms relied on imported PDM such as Metaphase/MatrixOne and Sherpa—high cost, hard customization, and data-sovereignty/operations risk

milestones.achievement_en: Shanghai SIPM Information Technology was founded and launched owned SIPM/PDM (later SIPM/PLM), enabling scaled domestic product-lifecycle data management in machinery and automotive
milestones.still_missing_zh: 复杂跨法人集团治理、全球供应链协同与高端三维原生设计一体能力仍弱于 Siemens Teamcenter/PTC Windchill
milestones.still_missing_en: Complex multi-entity governance, global supply-chain collaboration, and native high-end 3D design integration still trail Siemens Teamcenter and PTC Windchill

milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic PDM/PLM procurement and acceptance long followed de-facto checklists from Teamcenter and Windchill without a unified national technical baseline for domestic PDM
milestones.achievement_zh: 思普作为第一起草单位参与制定并发布 GB/T 35285-2017《信息技术 工业软件 产品数据管理(PDM)软件通用技术要求》，为国产 PDM/PLM 产品定义可验收的国家标准能力边界
milestones.achievement_en: SIPM as lead drafting unit helped publish GB/T 35285-2017 'Information technology — Industrial software — General technical requirements for PDM software', defining a national, testable capability baseline for domestic PDM/PLM
milestones.still_missing_zh: 国标定义的是通用基线，复杂型号研制、多站点高可用与全球协同仍依赖厂商实施深度，尚难全面对标进口旗舰套件
milestones.still_missing_en: The national standard sets a general baseline; complex program development, multi-site HA, and global collaboration still depend on vendor implementation depth and do not fully match import flagships
