milestones.before_gap_en: After CRRC was formed, subsidiaries ran mixed imported PDM (Teamcenter, Windchill, Matrix); cross-enterprise EBOM/MBOM harmonization and group change collaboration were difficult
milestones.achievement_zh: 思普 SIPM/PLM 在中国中车集团级平台建设中落地，支撑轨道交通装备多法人、多基地的统一产品数据与 BOM 管理，成为该领域可替代进口 PLM 的国产主平台之一
milestones.achievement_en: SIPM/PLM deployed in CRRC's group platform, supporting unified product data and BOM management across multi-entity rail-equipment sites—one of the credible domestic alternatives to imported PLM in this sector
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全球供应链协同、与进口高端 CAD（如 CATIA/NX）深度参数联动及超大规模数字主线仍弱于 Teamcenter 旗舰部署
milestones.still_missing_en: Global supply-chain collaboration, deep parametric linkage with import high-end CAD (CATIA/NX), and very large digital-thread scale still trail flagship Teamcenter deployments

milestones.before_gap_en: Chinese OEM group engineering change, configuration effectivity, and drawing/BOM linkage long relied on PTC Windchill or Dassault ENOVIA—high localization and self-maintenance cost

milestones.achievement_en: SIPM/PLM scaled on SAIC Motor's R&D data management platform for ECN/ECO, configuration management, and cross-functional collaboration—a replicable domestic PLM substitution path for automotive OEMs
milestones.still_missing_zh: 智能网联软件版本、全球多工厂同步变更与 MBSE 需求追溯深度仍不及 Windchill+Codebeamer 组合
milestones.still_missing_en: Connected-vehicle software versioning, global multi-plant synchronized change, and MBSE requirements traceability depth still trail Windchill+Codebeamer combinations

milestones.achievement_zh: 思普发布并完成 SIPM/PLM 在国产操作系统（麒麟等）与国产数据库（达梦、人大金仓等）上的兼容认证与量产部署，支撑关键行业 PLM 全栈国产化
milestones.achievement_en: SIPM completed compatibility certification and production deployment of SIPM/PLM on domestic OS (Kylin, etc.) and domestic databases (Dameng, Kingbase, etc.), enabling full-stack localized PLM in critical industries

milestones.headline_en: Commercial launch of CASS mapping suite closes domestic large-scale survey mapping software gap
milestones.before_gap_zh: 1990年代国内地形地籍数字化成图主要依赖 AutoCAD/Bentley 平台加零散二次开发或进口测绘模块，缺少贴合国标图式与地籍规范的一体化国产成图产品
milestones.before_gap_en: In the 1990s, domestic topographic/cadastral digitization relied on AutoCAD/Bentley plus ad-hoc customization or imported survey modules—no integrated domestic product aligned with PRC mapping and cadastral standards
milestones.achievement_zh: 南方测绘推出 CASS（Computer Aided Survey System）成图软件，将大比例尺地形图、地籍图、工程测量等流程与国标图式、编码和符号库集成，形成可规模部署的国产测绘成图方案
milestones.achievement_en: South Surveying shipped CASS (Computer Aided Survey System), integrating large-scale topographic/cadastral/engineering survey workflows with PRC symbol libraries and coding standards into a deployable domestic mapping stack
milestones.still_missing_zh: 早期仍依赖 AutoCAD 等国外 CAD 运行时；通用 GIS 分析、BIM 协同及国际项目交付能力弱于 Esri/ArcGIS
milestones.still_missing_en: Early versions still depended on foreign CAD runtimes (e.g., AutoCAD); weaker than Esri/ArcGIS for general GIS analytics, BIM synergy, and international project delivery

milestones.before_gap_zh: 国内测绘单位内业成图长期以进口 AutoCAD 及插件为主，平台授权、版本升级与信创替换成本高
milestones.before_gap_en: Survey mapping offices were long tied to imported AutoCAD and plugins, with high platform licensing, upgrade, and xinchuang migration costs

milestones.achievement_en: South Surveying released the SouthMap native mapping platform, paired with CASS to deliver an owned survey CAD kernel and workflows substituting the 'imported CAD + survey plugin' stack in domestic deployments

milestones.before_gap_en: Oblique photogrammetry and real-scene 3D modeling in PRC natural-resources and AEC projects were dominated by foreign tools such as ContextCapture and Pix4D
milestones.achievement_zh: 南方测绘推出 SmartGIS 时空地理信息平台及实景三维能力，覆盖倾斜摄影三维建模、单体化与时空数据管理，服务实景三维中国与新型基础测绘试点

milestones.still_missing_zh: 超大规模城市级网格化建模效率、全球云协作及与国际通用三维设计链（如 Revit/CityEngine）互操作仍弱
milestones.still_missing_en: City-scale mesh throughput, global cloud collaboration, and interoperability with international 3D design chains (e.g., Revit/CityEngine) remain weaker

milestones.headline_en: South Surveying core survey software passes xinchuang software evaluation for domestic substitution deployments
milestones.before_gap_zh: 测绘成图与实景三维生产链路在党政与关键行业信创环境中缺少通过权威测评、可替代进口平台的国产软件选项
milestones.before_gap_en: Survey mapping and real-scene 3D production lacked domestic, evaluation-certified alternatives to foreign platforms in government and critical-infrastructure xinchuang environments
milestones.achievement_zh: 南方测绘测绘软件产品完成信创相关软件测评（含实景三维等方向），可在国产操作系统与基础软件栈上部署，支撑测绘行业信创替代
milestones.achievement_en: South Surveying survey software products completed xinchuang-related software evaluations (including real-scene 3D), enabling deployment on domestic OS and base-software stacks for industry import substitution
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全栈信创环境下与国外高端传感器原始格式、国际项目交付标准的兼容验证仍不充分
milestones.still_missing_en: Full-stack xinchuang compatibility with high-end foreign sensor raw formats and international delivery standards remains incomplete

milestones.headline_zh: 自研结构有限元求解器实现国防航天型号批量化商用，打破高端结构CAE进口依赖
milestones.headline_en: Self-developed structural FEA solver reaches serial defense/aerospace deployment, breaking import dependence on high-end structural CAE
milestones.before_gap_zh: 高端结构仿真长期由 MSC Nastran、ANSYS Mechanical、Abaqus 等国外软件垄断；在军工航天领域还叠加出口管制与禁运，国产批量化工程求解器几乎空白
milestones.before_gap_en: High-end structural simulation was dominated by MSC Nastran, ANSYS Mechanical, and Abaqus; in defense/aerospace, export controls added embargo risk and left almost no production-grade domestic engineering solvers
milestones.achievement_zh: 招股说明书披露：公司自研结构力学仿真内核与求解器，2012 年起形成规模化软件销售收入，进入航空、航天、兵器等型号结构强度/振动/热应力分析流程，在受限领域替代进口 Nastran/Mechanical 工作流
milestones.achievement_en: IPO prospectus states Suochen shipped owned structural-mechanics kernels/solvers with scaled software revenue from 2012, entering aircraft/space/weapons structural strength, vibration, and thermo-structural workflows as a substitute for imported Nastran/Mechanical stacks in restricted sectors
milestones.still_missing_zh: 民用汽车主机厂核心耐久/碰撞仍多选 Ansys/LS-DYNA；大型通用后处理生态、材料库广度、全球第三方教材与社区远弱于国际龙头
milestones.still_missing_en: Civilian OEM durability/crash workflows still favor Ansys/LS-DYNA; general post-processing ecosystem, material libraries, and global training/community remain far behind international leaders

milestones.headline_zh: 中控在乌镇世界互联网大会发布国内首个自主 supOS 工业操作系统
milestones.headline_en: SUPCON launches supOS at WIC — China's first self-developed industrial operating system
milestones.before_gap_zh: 流程工业数字化底座依赖 GE Predix、西门子 MindSphere、PTC ThingWorx 等外资工业互联网平台，国产厂商缺少可承载 DCS/SCADA/MES 统一集成的自主工业 OS
milestones.before_gap_en: Process-industry digital stacks relied on GE Predix, Siemens MindSphere, PTC ThingWorx and other foreign IIoT platforms; no domestic industrial OS could unify DCS/SCADA/MES layers
milestones.achievement_zh: 2017 年 11 月发布 supOS 1.0，定位为自主工业操作系统与工业互联网平台底座，支持异构设备/系统接入与应用开发，为后续 PlantMart 与 supOS 生态奠定国产化平台层
milestones.achievement_en: Released supOS 1.0 in Nov 2017 as a proprietary industrial OS and IIoT platform base with heterogeneous device/system connectivity and app development — foundation for PlantMart and the supOS ecosystem
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全球生态伙伴规模、跨行业 SaaS 应用商店成熟度仍弱于 MindSphere/ThingWorx；海外部署与合规交付有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Global partner ecosystem and cross-industry SaaS marketplace maturity still trail MindSphere/ThingWorx; limited overseas deployment and compliance delivery

sources.title: 中控技术首次公开发行股票并在科创板上市招股说明书

milestones.headline_zh: supOS 2.0 发布统一命名空间，打通 OT 实时数据孤岛
milestones.headline_en: supOS 2.0 ships Unified Namespace — closes OT real-time data silo gap
milestones.before_gap_zh: 大型炼化/化工现场 DCS、PLC、仪表与 MES 数据模型割裂，统一实时数据层长期依赖 OSIsoft PI System、AVEVA Historian 等外资方案叠加进口 DCS 生态
milestones.before_gap_en: Large process plants had fragmented DCS/PLC/instrument/MES data models; unified real-time data layers relied on OSIsoft PI System, AVEVA Historian and foreign DCS stacks
milestones.achievement_zh: 2019 年发布 supOS 2.0，引入统一命名空间（Unified Namespace）与增强的边缘/应用框架，在国产平台上实现跨子系统 OT 数据统一建模与订阅，减少 PI+进口 DCS 双栈依赖
milestones.achievement_en: supOS 2.0 (2019) introduced Unified Namespace and enhanced edge/app framework for cross-subsystem OT data modeling and subscription on a domestic platform — reducing PI + import-DCS dual-stack dependency
milestones.still_missing_zh: 超大规模全厂实时库性能调优、全球第三方分析工具生态仍不及 PI System；跨企业供应链数据互联弱
milestones.still_missing_en: Mega-plant historian performance tuning and global third-party analytics ecosystem still trail PI System; weak cross-enterprise supply-chain data interop

sources.title: 中控技术首次公开发行股票并在科创板上市招股说明书

milestones.headline_zh: supOS 通过信创兼容认证，可在国产 OS/CPU 上部署工业控制软件栈
milestones.headline_en: supOS passes xinchuang compatibility — industrial control stack deployable on domestic OS/CPU
milestones.before_gap_zh: DCS/SCADA/HMI 工程站与服务器长期绑定 Windows + x86，国产麒麟/统信 OS 及飞腾/鲲鹏 CPU 上缺少可量产的流程工业控制软件栈
milestones.before_gap_en: DCS/SCADA/HMI engineering stations were tied to Windows + x86; no production-grade process-control software stack existed on domestic Kylin/UOS OS and Phytium/Kunpeng CPUs
milestones.achievement_zh: supOS 多版本完成与国产操作系统、国产芯片的信创兼容互认证，支撑 DCS/工业互联网应用在信创环境规模化部署
milestones.achievement_en: Multiple supOS releases completed xinchuang mutual certification with domestic OS and CPUs, enabling scaled DCS/IIoT deployment on IT-innovation infrastructure
milestones.still_missing_zh: 部分高端工程工具链、实时数据库驱动与外资设备驱动的信创适配仍在补齐
milestones.still_missing_en: Some high-end engineering toolchains, real-time DB drivers and foreign-device drivers still being adapted for xinchuang stacks

milestones.headline_zh: 中控发布流程工业时序大模型 TPT，落地百余套装置
milestones.headline_en: SUPCON launches process-industry time-series model TPT on 100+ units
milestones.before_gap_zh: 流程工业优化依赖人工经验与碎片化 APC 模型，缺少跨装置、跨工况的统一 AI 时序基座
milestones.before_gap_en: Process optimization relied on expert rules and fragmented APC models — no cross-unit time-series AI foundation
milestones.achievement_zh: 发布流程工业时序大模型 TPT（Time-series Pre-trained Transformer），在氯碱/热电/石化等装置完成闭环优化验证；镇海炼化油品切换由 6–7h 缩至 2h 内
milestones.achievement_en: Shipped process-industry time-series foundation model TPT (Time-series Pre-trained Transformer) with closed-loop validation in chlor-alkali/thermal/petrochemical units; Zhenhai refinery product switch cut from 6–7h to under 2h
milestones.still_missing_zh: TPT 2 仍处商业早期；开源 LLM 无法直接替代 OT 级闭环控制的安全认证与确定性
milestones.still_missing_en: TPT 2 still early commercial; open LLMs cannot replace OT-grade closed-loop safety certification and determinism

milestones.headline_zh: MWorks.Sysplorer 科技成果鉴定：国产 Modelica 系统建模仿真达国际先进水平
milestones.headline_en: MWorks.Sysplorer S&T appraisal: domestic Modelica system modeling rated internationally advanced
milestones.before_gap_zh: 航天/国防复杂装备系统建模与仿真长期依赖 Dymola、MATLAB/Simulink 等进口闭源环境，存在禁运、审计与源代码不可控风险
milestones.before_gap_en: Aerospace/defense complex-system modeling relied on imported closed stacks (Dymola, MATLAB/Simulink) with embargo, audit, and source-control risks
milestones.achievement_zh: 中国自动化学会组织科技成果鉴定，认定深圳同元“复杂产品系统建模与仿真工业软件（MWorks.Sysplorer）”整体达到国际先进水平，多领域统一建模与高效仿真求解达到国际领先，形成可替代进口 Modelica 环境的国产商用平台
milestones.achievement_en: CAA-organized appraisal certified Tongyuan’s MWorks.Sysplorer complex-product modeling & simulation software as internationally advanced overall, with leading unified multi-domain modeling and efficient simulation—establishing a commercial domestic substitute for imported Modelica environments
milestones.still_missing_zh: 汽车 OEM 级 Amesim/Simulink 工具链深度集成、第三方商业 Modelica 库生态与全球渠道仍明显弱于 Dassault/MathWorks
milestones.still_missing_en: Automotive OEM-grade Amesim/Simulink toolchain depth, third-party commercial Modelica libraries, and global channels still trail Dassault/MathWorks

metrics.value: 国际先进水平（部分国际领先）

milestones.headline_zh: MWorks.Sysplorer 在国际 Modelica 大会发布，确立国产 Modelica 建模仿真产品线
milestones.headline_en: MWorks.Sysplorer presented at Modelica Conference, establishing domestic Modelica modeling line
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2015 年前国内无成熟可商用的自主 Modelica 图形化建模与求解环境，复杂系统仿真项目只能采购 Dymola/SimulationX
milestones.before_gap_en: Before 2015 China lacked a mature commercial owned Modelica graphical modeling/solver environment; complex system simulation projects procured Dymola/SimulationX
milestones.achievement_zh: 同元在 Modelica Association 国际年会发表 MWorks.Sysplorer 技术论文，公开完整 Modelica 建模、编译求解与仿真流程，标志国产平台进入国际 Modelica 主流技术共同体
milestones.achievement_en: Tongyuan published MWorks.Sysplorer architecture at the Modelica Association international conference, documenting full Modelica modeling, compilation, and simulation—marking entry of a domestic platform into the mainstream Modelica community
milestones.still_missing_zh: 与 Dymola 20+ 年积累的航空/车辆行业模型库、培训认证体系仍有差距
milestones.still_missing_en: Gap remains vs Dymola’s 20+ years of aerospace/automotive libraries and certified training ecosystem

milestones.headline_zh: 同元入选 Modelica Association 成员单位，参与开放模型互操作生态
milestones.headline_en: Tongyuan joins Modelica Association, enabling open model interoperability
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国产仿真厂商长期游离于 Modelica/FMI 国际标准生态之外，难以与 Dymola、OpenModelica 及国外 CAE 工具交换模型
milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic simulation vendors sat outside the Modelica/FMI standards ecosystem, blocking model exchange with Dymola, OpenModelica, and foreign CAE tools
milestones.achievement_zh: 深圳同元软控列入 Modelica Association 官方成员名单，与 Dassault、Siemens 等并列参与 Modelica 标准与模型库生态，为 MWorks 与进口工具链的模型级互操作提供制度与技术基础
milestones.achievement_en: Shenzhen Tongyuan listed as an official Modelica Association member alongside Dassault and Siemens, participating in Modelica standards and libraries—institutional basis for model-level interoperability between MWorks and imported toolchains
milestones.still_missing_zh: FMI 联合仿真在实时 HIL 场景下的性能与认证覆盖仍不及 Simulink + dSPACE 成熟组合
milestones.still_missing_en: FMI co-simulation performance and certification coverage for real-time HIL still trail mature Simulink + dSPACE stacks

milestones.headline_zh: MWorks.Syslab 发布：国产科学计算与算法开发环境对标 MATLAB
milestones.headline_en: MWorks.Syslab launch: domestic scientific computing environment vs MATLAB
milestones.before_gap_zh: MBSE/系统仿真团队算法原型、后处理与脚本自动化普遍依赖 MATLAB，与 Sysplorer 建模环境割裂且受出口管制约束
milestones.before_gap_en: MBSE/system-simulation teams depended on MATLAB for algorithm prototyping, post-processing, and scripting—disconnected from modeling environments and subject to export controls
milestones.achievement_zh: 同元发布 MWorks.Syslab，在同一 MWorks 平台内提供国产科学计算、矩阵运算、绘图与脚本语言环境，与 Sysplorer 联合仿真闭环，减少对 MathWorks MATLAB 的并行依赖
milestones.achievement_en: Tongyuan shipped MWorks.Syslab on the MWorks platform with domestic matrix math, plotting, and scripting integrated with Sysplorer co-simulation—reducing parallel dependence on MathWorks MATLAB
milestones.still_missing_zh: Toolbox 生态（信号处理、优化、代码生成）、Simulink 框图式建模与高校教材渗透率仍远落后于 MATLAB
milestones.still_missing_en: Toolbox ecosystem (signal processing, optimization, codegen), Simulink block-diagram modeling, and university penetration still far behind MATLAB

milestones.headline_zh: MWorks 支持 Modelica 模型 C 代码生成与 FMI 联合仿真，切入 HIL/V&V 工作流
milestones.headline_en: MWorks Modelica-to-C codegen and FMI co-simulation for HIL/V&V workflows
milestones.before_gap_zh: 装备电控与能源系统 HIL、快速控制原型普遍采用 Simulink Embedded Coder + dSPACE/NI 进口链路，国产建模环境缺少可验收的代码生成与实时联合仿真接口
milestones.before_gap_en: Equipment control and energy-system HIL/RCP workflows used Simulink Embedded Coder + dSPACE/NI import chains; domestic modeling stacks lacked certifiable codegen and real-time co-simulation interfaces
milestones.achievement_zh: MWorks.Sysplorer 提供 Modelica 模型向 C 代码自动生成及 FMI 1.0/2.0 联合仿真导出，可在国产实时仿真机/下位机环境完成硬件在环验证，替代部分 Simulink 代码生成+HIL 进口组合
milestones.achievement_en: MWorks.Sysplorer ships Modelica-to-C automatic code generation and FMI 1.0/2.0 co-simulation export for hardware-in-the-loop on domestic real-time targets—substituting part of the Simulink codegen + HIL import stack
milestones.still_missing_zh: ISO 26262/DO-178C 工具鉴定证据链、AUTOSAR 与主流 HIL 厂商预集成度仍弱于 MathWorks + dSPACE
milestones.still_missing_en: ISO 26262/DO-178C tool-qualification evidence and AUTOSAR/pre-integration with major HIL vendors still weaker than MathWorks + dSPACE

milestones.headline_zh: 维宏成立并启动国产雕刻机专用数控系统研发
milestones.headline_en: Weihong founded and begins R&D of domestic engraving-machine CNC systems
milestones.before_gap_zh: 2000年代初中低端雕刻机普遍采用美国 ArtSoft Mach3 + PC 并口运动卡或零散进口板卡，缺少可规模化交付、带本土工艺支持的国产一体化数控
milestones.before_gap_en: In the early 2000s, low/mid engraving machines mostly used US ArtSoft Mach3 on PCs with parallel-port motion cards or fragmented imported boards—no scalable domestic integrated CNC with local process support
milestones.achievement_zh: 招股说明书披露公司 2003 年 3 月在上海成立，专注运动控制系统（数控系统）研发、生产与销售，面向雕刻机等设备推出自主 NK 系列硬件与 NcStudio 软件栈，形成可 OEM 批量配套的国产雕刻数控方案
milestones.achievement_en: The IPO prospectus states Weihong was established in Shanghai in March 2003, focusing on motion-control CNC R&D and sales, shipping the in-house NK controller family plus NcStudio software as a mass-OEM engraving CNC stack
milestones.still_missing_zh: 当时高档加工中心、精密模具加工仍由发那科/西门子主导；五轴与纳米级精度尚未覆盖
milestones.still_missing_en: High-end machining centers and precision die/mold work remained Fanuc/Siemens territory; 5-axis and nanoscale precision were not yet in scope

milestones.headline_zh: NK300 雕刻数控系统在国产雕刻机 OEM 集群规模化装机
milestones.headline_en: NK300 engraving CNC reaches volume deployment on domestic engraving OEM clusters
milestones.before_gap_zh: 山东、广东等雕刻机产业带主机厂长期标配进口或台湾数控板卡，或继续捆绑 Mach3 工控机方案，系统稳定性、售后与工艺库本土化不足
milestones.before_gap_en: Engraving OEM clusters in Shandong/Guangdong long shipped imported or Taiwan control boards, or Mach3 PC bundles, with weak stability, service, and localized process libraries
milestones.achievement_zh: 维宏推出 NK300 系列一体化雕刻数控系统（控制器 + NcStudio），在木工、广告、玉石等雕刻机细分形成批量标配，使国产雕刻机出厂默认控制器由进口/Mach3 架构转向维宏等国产一体化方案
milestones.achievement_en: Weihong shipped the integrated NK300 engraving CNC (controller + NcStudio), becoming a factory-default option across woodworking, signage, and craft engraving OEM lines—shifting default machine architecture away from imported/Mach3 stacks
milestones.still_missing_zh: 高端雕铣、金属模具加工仍多选发那科/西门子；多轴联动与空间误差补偿能力弱于进口高档系统
milestones.still_missing_en: High-end die-milling and metal mold machines still favored Fanuc/Siemens; multi-axis RTCP and volumetric compensation lagged imported high-end systems

milestones.headline_zh: 创业板上市招股说明书确认雕刻机数控国产占主导、维宏为龙头厂商
milestones.headline_en: ChiNext IPO prospectus documents domestic dominance in engraving CNC with Weihong as a leading vendor
milestones.before_gap_zh: 招股说明书指出高档数控机床市场仍主要由发那科、西门子、三菱等国际品牌占据，雕刻机细分长期存在对进口数控与国外工控软件的依赖
milestones.before_gap_en: The prospectus notes high-end CNC remained dominated by Fanuc, Siemens, and Mitsubishi, while the engraving segment had relied on imported CNC and foreign PC control software
milestones.achievement_zh: 2016 年 4 月创业板上市；招股说明书「行业竞争格局」明确：我国数控雕刻机市场发展迅速，在数控雕刻机、雕铣机领域国产数控系统市场占有率较高，维宏为国产雕刻数控重要参与者，标志着国产雕刻数控由替代进口进入资本市场公开验证阶段
milestones.achievement_en: Listed on ChiNext in April 2016; the prospectus competition section states rapid growth in China's engraving CNC market with high domestic share in engraving/die-milling machines and Weihong as a major domestic player—public capital-markets validation of import substitution in engraving CNC
milestones.still_missing_zh: 招股说明书同时承认在高端数控机床领域与国际知名品牌相比仍有差距；航空航天级高档数控非其主战场
milestones.still_missing_en: The same filing acknowledges gaps vs international brands in high-end CNC; aerospace-grade controllers were outside its core battlefield

milestones.before_gap_zh: 汽车天窗、建筑幕墙等玻璃五轴铣削、钻孔装备长期绑定西门子、发那科等进口五轴数控与 RTCP 功能
milestones.before_gap_en: 5-axis glass milling/drilling for auto sunroofs and curtain walls was typically bound to imported 5-axis CNC with RTCP from Siemens or Fanuc
milestones.achievement_zh: 维宏发布 WHV 系列五轴玻璃机数控系统，提供五轴联动插补与玻璃专用工艺，配套国产玻璃加工主机实现进口五轴数控在玻璃细分场景的可替代运行
milestones.achievement_en: Weihong released the WHV 5-axis glass-machine CNC with 5-axis interpolation and glass-specific processes, pairing with domestic glass machines to demonstrate replaceability of imported 5-axis CNC in the glass niche

milestones.before_gap_en: In the 1990s Chinese plants and utilities relied on imported configuration/HMI stacks such as Wonderware InTouch, Intellution iFIX, and Citect—expensive licenses, weak local support, and widespread piracy
milestones.achievement_zh: 北京亚控成立并发布组态王，提供图形化组态、实时数据库与驱动接口的国产化方案，成为中小企业监控项目可采购的本土替代选项

milestones.still_missing_en: Full-plant object models, mission-critical redundancy, and tight coupling with foreign DCS stacks still lagged behind AVEVA System Platform / WinCC integrated offerings

milestones.headline_zh: 发布 KingHistorian 工业实时历史库，对标 OSIsoft PI 数据归档层
milestones.headline_en: KingHistorian industrial real-time/historian database shipped as domestic PI-class archive layer
milestones.before_gap_zh: 流程与电力行业历史数据归档长期被 OSIsoft PI System、Wonderware Historian 等进口历史库垄断，组态层国产后数据层仍依赖外资
milestones.before_gap_en: Process and power plants archived historian data mainly on OSIsoft PI System and Wonderware Historian—domestic HMI could localize graphics while the data layer stayed foreign
milestones.achievement_zh: 亚控推出 KingHistorian，提供高吞吐实时采集、压缩存储与查询接口，与组态王配套形成 SCADA+历史库国产栈
milestones.achievement_en: Wellintech released KingHistorian with high-throughput acquisition, compressed storage, and query APIs—pairing with KingView to form a domestic SCADA-plus-historian stack
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨集团多站点联邦分析、与第三方高级分析/APM 生态及 PI AF 级资产框架集成仍落后于 PI System
milestones.still_missing_en: Multi-site enterprise federation, third-party advanced analytics/APM ecosystems, and PI AF-class asset frameworks remained weaker than PI System

metrics.value: 独立工业实时历史数据库

milestones.headline_zh: 科创板申报稿披露组态王连续居国内组态软件市场占有率第一
milestones.headline_en: STAR Market IPO filing documents KingView as China's #1 domestic configuration-software vendor by share
milestones.before_gap_zh: 石化、电力、市政等行业虽已有国产组态装机，但缺乏第三方/监管口径的市占与收入量化，外资品牌在华存量仍被默认为默认选项
milestones.before_gap_en: Although domestic configuration tools were installed in petrochemical, power, and municipal sectors, third-party or regulatory-grade share data was scarce and foreign brands were still treated as the default
milestones.achievement_zh: 亚控科技科创板获受理并披露申报稿，明确组态王在国产组态软件细分市场领先，列举电力、化工、石油、水利等二十余行业规模化装机，构成对 InTouch/WinCC 的正式国产替代叙事
milestones.achievement_en: Wellintech's STAR Market acceptance and draft prospectus formally positioned KingView as the leading domestic configuration-software vendor across 20+ industries—institutionalizing the substitution narrative versus InTouch/WinCC
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全球高端流程客户、云原生 SCADA 与 OT 安全合规矩阵仍弱于 AVEVA / Siemens
milestones.still_missing_en: Global-tier process accounts, cloud-native SCADA, and OT security/compliance matrices remained weaker than AVEVA / Siemens

metrics.value: 国内组态软件市场占有率第一

milestones.headline_zh: 组态王信创版完成麒麟/统信与国产 CPU 适配
milestones.headline_en: KingView Xinchuang edition certified on Kylin/UOS and domestic CPUs
milestones.before_gap_zh: 信创替代推进中，SCADA 运行环境仍大量绑定 Windows + x86 + 进口 WinCC/InTouch，国产 OS/CPU 上缺少成熟组态运行时
milestones.before_gap_en: During Xinchuang push, SCADA runtimes remained tied to Windows + x86 + imported WinCC/InTouch with few mature configuration runtimes on domestic OS/CPU stacks
milestones.achievement_zh: 亚控发布并完成组态王在麒麟、统信 UOS 及飞腾/鲲鹏/海光/龙芯等平台的兼容认证，使监控软件可进入党政、能源、水利等信创采购目录场景
milestones.achievement_en: Wellintech shipped and certified KingView on Kylin, UOS, and Phytium/Kunpeng/Hygon/Loongson platforms—enabling SCADA procurement in government, energy, and water Xinchuang catalogs
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全国产工控机生态下的实时驱动覆盖、与外资 PLC 专有协议的长期维护及等保三级大规模交付经验仍待积累
milestones.still_missing_en: Real-time driver coverage on fully domestic IPC ecosystems, long-term maintenance of proprietary foreign-PLC protocols, and large-scale Class-3 security deployments still maturing

milestones.headline_zh: 尚品宅配招股书披露圆方 FDM 生产管理系统实现定制家居 APS 排产
milestones.headline_en: Shangpin IPO prospectus discloses YFway FDM production system with APS for custom furniture
milestones.before_gap_zh: 全屋定制订单件号多、交期短，行业普遍依赖人工排产或通用外资 ERP/MES，无法与参数化拆单结果实时联动
milestones.before_gap_en: Whole-home custom orders have high SKU variety and tight lead times; the industry relied on manual scheduling or generic foreign ERP/MES that could not sync in real time with parametric split-order output
milestones.achievement_zh: 招股说明书明确披露发行人自研圆方信息化体系中的 FDM 生产管理系统，承接审单拆单结果并自动生成生产计划与车间调度，支撑尚品宅配 C2M 大规模定制
milestones.achievement_en: The IPO prospectus states the issuer’s self-developed YFway IT stack includes an FDM production-management system that ingests reviewed/split orders and auto-generates production plans and shop scheduling, underpinning Shangpin’s C2M mass customization
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨集团多工厂中立调度、与第三方异构 MES 的标准互操作仍弱于西门子 Opcenter 等平台
milestones.still_missing_en: Neutral multi-plant orchestration across groups and standard interoperability with third-party heterogeneous MES remain weaker than platforms like Siemens Opcenter

milestones.headline_zh: 圆方 FDM 链路实现参数化设计到动态制造 BOM 与 CNC 程序自动生成
milestones.headline_en: YFway FDM chain auto-generates dynamic manufacturing BOMs and CNC programs from parametric design
milestones.before_gap_zh: 定制家居制造数据多依赖进口设计/拆单软件或手工拆单，BOM 与加工程序难以随订单实时更新
milestones.before_gap_en: Custom furniture manufacturing data often depended on imported design/splitting tools or manual takeoff; BOMs and NC programs could not be updated in real time per order
milestones.achievement_zh: 尚品宅配上市披露材料显示，圆方系统将三维设计、自动拆单、板件清单与加工指令贯通，使每件定制订单生成唯一制造 BOM 并下发开料/封边/钻孔设备
milestones.achievement_en: Shangpin listing disclosures show the YFway stack connects 3D design, automatic order splitting, panel lists, and machining instructions so each custom order yields a unique manufacturing BOM dispatched to cutting/edge-banding/drilling equipment
milestones.still_missing_zh: 通用机械装配 BOM、多版本工程变更与 PLM 级配置管理仍不及 Teamcenter/Windchill
milestones.still_missing_en: General mechanical assembly BOM, multi-revision ECO, and PLM-grade configuration management still trail Teamcenter/Windchill

metrics.label_zh: 软件体系模块（招股书披露）

milestones.headline_zh: 尚品宅配南海工业4.0基地以圆方系统联通定制家居数控产线
milestones.headline_en: Shangpin Nanhai Industry 4.0 base links custom furniture CNC lines via YFway system
milestones.before_gap_zh: 板式家具数控设备多由进口或通用 DNC 孤岛控制，MES 难以采集开料、封边、钻孔全流程状态
milestones.before_gap_en: Panel furniture CNC equipment was often controlled by imported or standalone DNC islands; MES could not capture full cutting, edge-banding, and drilling status
milestones.achievement_zh: 公开报道与年报披露，尚品宅配南海智能制造基地投产，圆方生产管理系统与柔性产线联动，实现订单驱动的设备数据回传与进度可视
milestones.achievement_en: Public reports and annual disclosures state the Nanhai smart manufacturing base went live with YFway production management linked to flexible lines, enabling order-driven machine data feedback and progress visibility
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨品牌设备统一物模型、边缘协议网关与大型离散行业级 Historian 能力仍弱
milestones.still_missing_en: Unified cross-vendor equipment models, edge protocol gateways, and large-discrete historian depth remain limited

metrics.value: Industry 4.0 flexible custom furniture plant (Nanhai, Foshan)

milestones.headline_zh: FDM 体系支撑定制板件条码级生产追溯与分拣防错
milestones.headline_en: FDM stack enables barcode-level traceability and sortation error-proofing for custom panels
milestones.before_gap_zh: 定制家居单订单板件成百上千，外资通用质量追溯系统缺少板件级拆单语义，现场防错依赖人工
milestones.before_gap_en: A single custom furniture order can involve hundreds of panels; generic foreign traceability systems lacked split-order semantics, leaving error-proofing to manual checks
milestones.achievement_zh: 上市材料描述圆方信息化系统覆盖生产、仓储、配送全流程，板件在产线节点扫码流转，支撑定制订单分拣与交付追溯
milestones.achievement_en: Listing materials describe the YFway IT system covering production, warehouse, and delivery end-to-end, with panels scanned at line nodes to support custom-order sortation and delivery traceability
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨工厂 SPC 统计过程控制、供应商质量协同与医疗级批次召回仍不及专业 QMS
milestones.still_missing_en: Cross-plant SPC, supplier quality collaboration, and medical-grade lot recall remain below dedicated QMS suites

sources.title: 尚品宅配：首次公开发行股票并在创业板上市招股说明书

milestones.headline_zh: 圆方对外输出 FDM20 智能制造方案，形成可复制的国产设计—制造一体化
milestones.headline_en: YFway commercializes FDM20 smart manufacturing as replicable domestic design-to-production stack
milestones.before_gap_zh: 泛家居中小企业多采购进口设计或通用管理软件，设计、排产、制造、仓储数据割裂
milestones.before_gap_en: SME furniture makers often bought imported design or generic management software with disconnected design, scheduling, manufacturing, and warehouse data
milestones.achievement_zh: 圆方官网与尚品宅配后续年报披露，公司将审拆单、APS、MES、WMS 一体的 FDM 智能制造能力产品化并向行业客户输出
milestones.achievement_en: YFway’s site and Shangpin follow-on annual reports state the company productized integrated review/split-order, APS, MES, and WMS FDM smart-manufacturing capabilities for external industry customers
milestones.still_missing_zh: 中立第三方大规模交付、跨行业生命周期治理与全球生态集成仍有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Neutral large-scale third-party delivery, cross-industry lifecycle governance, and global ecosystem integration remain limited

milestones.headline_zh: 远光电力财务管理信息系统在国网/南网及五大发电集团规模化部署，招股说明书披露对进口财务软件的替代路径
milestones.headline_en: YGSOFT power-sector FMIS scales across SGCC, CSG and major generators; IPO prospectus documents domestic substitution of imported finance software
milestones.before_gap_zh: 各省电力公司财务核算长期依赖 Oracle Financials、SAP R/3 等外资套件或异构本地系统，难以支撑全网统一科目、预算与管控
milestones.before_gap_en: Provincial power utilities relied on Oracle Financials, SAP R/3 or fragmented local systems, unable to support unified nationwide chart-of-accounts, budgeting and control
milestones.achievement_zh: 招股说明书披露：远光已成为国家电网、中国南方电网及五大发电集团财务管理信息化核心供应商，以自主 FMIS/电力 ERP 支撑大型央企集团总账、预算与财务管控
milestones.achievement_en: IPO prospectus discloses YGSOFT as a core FMIS/utility-ERP vendor for State Grid, China Southern Power Grid and the five major power generators, supporting SOE group GL, budgeting and financial control
milestones.still_missing_zh: 通用制造业供应链/生产模块仍弱于国际一线套件；海外大型集团多法人税务与本地化模板成熟度有限
milestones.still_missing_en: General manufacturing supply-chain/production modules remain weaker than tier-1 international suites; multinational tax and localization templates are less mature

sources.title: 远光软件首次公开发行股票招股说明书

milestones.headline_zh: 国网 SG186 统一财务管控工程全国推广，远光承建核心财务应用模块
milestones.headline_en: State Grid SG186 unified financial control rolled out nationwide with YGSOFT as core finance application vendor
milestones.before_gap_zh: 国网「十一五」信息化前，总部—省—地市—县多级财务系统割裂，部分单位仍运行外资 ERP 或定制系统，无法全网一体化关账与管控
milestones.before_gap_en: Before SGCC 11th-FYP informatization, HQ–province–prefecture–county finance systems were siloed; some units still ran foreign ERP or bespoke systems without nationwide close and control
milestones.achievement_zh: 作为国网 SG186 工程财务管控子系统主要承建方，远光支撑全网统一财务应用推广，实现省级公司财务业务标准化、一体化运行，在电力央企场景形成对 SAP/Oracle 式集团财务平台的国产主供地位
milestones.achievement_en: As a primary implementer of SGCC SG186 financial-control subsystems, YGSOFT supported nationwide rollout of unified finance applications, standardizing provincial finance operations and establishing domestic primacy over SAP/Oracle-style group finance platforms in the power SOE segment
milestones.still_missing_zh: 非电力行业复制案例有限；复杂跨国并购与多准则并行核算深度仍不及国际旗舰产品
milestones.still_missing_en: Limited replication outside power; depth in cross-border M&A and parallel accounting standards still trails international flagship products

milestones.headline_zh: 南方电网财务共享服务中心上线，远光承建集团财务共享与合并管控平台
milestones.headline_en: CSG financial shared service center goes live on YGSOFT-built group FSSC and consolidation platform
milestones.before_gap_zh: 大型电网集团财务共享与合并报表多依赖 SAP FICO + SAP BPC/Oracle Hyperion 及跨国 SI 实施，国产方案缺乏超大型央企共享中心量产案例
milestones.before_gap_en: Large grid-group financial shared services and consolidation often relied on SAP FICO plus SAP BPC/Oracle Hyperion with global SIs; domestic stacks lacked production-proven mega-SOE shared-service centers
milestones.achievement_zh: 远光作为南方电网财务共享服务中心核心系统供应商，支撑五省区财务共享、统一核算与集团管控，在电网行业形成对国际共享服务+合并报表组合方案的国产替代
milestones.achievement_en: YGSOFT served as core system vendor for CSG's financial shared service center, supporting five-region shared finance, unified accounting and group control—substituting international shared-service plus consolidation stacks in the grid sector
milestones.still_missing_zh: 跨行业民企/外企总部共享中心标杆较少公开；与全球税务引擎和复杂股权架构的集成深度仍待验证
milestones.still_missing_en: Few public benchmarks in private or foreign HQs; integration depth with global tax engines and complex equity structures remains to be proven

milestones.headline_zh: 发布「远光九天」企业数字化云原生技术平台，支撑电力央企新一代国产云化底座
milestones.headline_en: YGSOFT launches Jiutian enterprise digital cloud-native platform as next-gen domestic cloud foundation for power SOEs
milestones.before_gap_zh: 央企集团新一代财务/业务系统云化多选型 Oracle Cloud、SAP S/4HANA Cloud 或国外 PaaS，国产电力行业缺少可承载核心 ERP 的云原生自主平台
milestones.before_gap_en: SOE next-gen finance/business cloudification often chose Oracle Cloud, SAP S/4HANA Cloud or foreign PaaS; domestic power lacked a cloud-native platform able to host core ERP workloads
milestones.achievement_zh: 2020年11月远光在年度技术大会上正式发布「远光九天」云原生企业数字化平台，以微服务、容器化与国产技术栈支撑集团财务、共享、管控等应用云化部署
milestones.achievement_en: In November 2020 YGSOFT officially released the Jiutian cloud-native digital platform at its tech conference, using microservices, containerization and domestic stacks to cloud-host group finance, shared services and control applications
milestones.still_missing_zh: 多云跨地域灾备与全球订阅商业模式仍处演进；非电力行业云生态与 ISV 规模弱于国际云 ERP
milestones.still_missing_en: Multi-cloud geo-disaster recovery and global subscription models are still evolving; non-power cloud ecosystem and ISV scale trail international cloud ERP

milestones.headline_zh: 入选爱分析信创 ERP 标杆厂商，全栈适配鲲鹏/麒麟等国产基础软硬件
milestones.headline_en: Named iResearch Xinchuang ERP benchmark vendor with full-stack Kunpeng/Kylin domestic hardware-software adaptation
milestones.before_gap_zh: 信创环境下大型集团 ERP 仍多依赖 SAP/Oracle on x86+国外数据库；国产软硬件栈缺少经央企财务关账验证的 ERP 全栈方案
milestones.before_gap_en: Under Xinchuang, large-group ERP still leaned on SAP/Oracle on x86 and foreign databases; domestic HW/SW stacks lacked ERP full-stack solutions proven through SOE financial close
milestones.achievement_zh: 远光软件入选《爱分析·信创 ERP 市场厂商评估报告》代表厂商，核心产品完成鲲鹏、飞腾、麒麟、达梦等信创全栈适配，可在国产环境部署电力/国资集团财务与管控系统

milestones.still_missing_zh: 信创环境复杂制造业深度模块与全球供应链协同仍弱；与国际 ERP 第三方生态和人才储备存在差距

milestones.headline_zh: YJK 1.0 发布自主建筑结构有限元内核
milestones.headline_en: YJK 1.0 ships owned building-structural FEM kernel
milestones.before_gap_zh: 复杂高层建筑弹塑性动力分析、静力弹塑性（Pushover）及大自由度非线性求解在工程实践中长期依赖 CSI ETABS、SAP2000、MIDAS Gen 等国外商业求解器
milestones.before_gap_en: Elastoplastic dynamic analysis, pushover, and large-DOF nonlinear solving for complex high-rise buildings relied on foreign commercial solvers such as CSI ETABS, SAP2000, and MIDAS Gen
milestones.achievement_zh: 盈建科发布全新自主开发的 YJK 建筑结构设计软件 V1.0，以自研有限元内核覆盖线弹性/弹塑性静动力分析、反应谱与时程分析等高层结构核心 CAE 能力，形成对 ETABS/SAP2000 同类功能的国产商用替代
milestones.achievement_en: YJK released V1.0 with a fully owned FEM core covering elastic/elastoplastic static-dynamic analysis, response spectrum, and time-history for high-rise structures—commercial domestic alternative to ETABS/SAP2000-class solvers
milestones.still_missing_zh: 国际规范版、桥梁与工业专项、外资项目指定国际求解器审查链仍弱于在位产品
milestones.still_missing_en: International code editions, bridge/industrial niches, and foreign-owner mandated international-solver review chains remain weaker than incumbents

sources.title: 盈建科：首次公开发行股票并在创业板上市招股说明书

milestones.headline_zh: 千万自由度级大型建筑模型并行求解落地
milestones.headline_en: Parallel solver enables 10M-DOF-class building models
